01900001.name: Ancient Clothing Map
01900001.description: Land at the Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea. Head West from the landing point.

archives.location: Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea

discovery.name: Ancient Clothing
discovery.description: Ancient garments. They vary in materials, colours, and construction from place to place. It's possible to trace the transfer of cultures by comparing these styles.

01900002.name: Ancient Burial Map
01900002.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. Proceed inland to Giza. Inside the ruins.

discovery.name: Ancient Grave Burial Items
discovery.description: Various items that were buried with the dead. In ancient civilizations, everyday things, including weapons and ornaments, were buried with the deceased, so that they could be used in the after-life.

01900003.name: Ancient Burial Map
01900003.description: Land at the Egypt North Coast. Near the ruins to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Ancient Human Bone
discovery.description: Human bones excavated from ancient ruins. The condition of these finds allow us certain insights into the conditions of the times.

01900004.name: Ancient Money Map
01900004.description: Outside the gates of Calais, northwest corner.

discovery.name: Shell Money
discovery.description: Cowry and other shells. Commonly used as currency in many ancient civilizations. Shell remains can be found in several places.

01900005.name: Ancient Settlement Map
01900005.description: Outside the gates of Nantes, southwest corner.

discovery.name: Livestock Bones
discovery.description: Bones of cows, horses, and other domesticated animals. Goats and sheep were kept in many places around the world, but horses are not found in many civilizations.

01900006.name: Ancient Settlement Map
01900006.description: Outside the gates of Athens (West) Western most point.

discovery.name: Broken Glass
discovery.description: A fragment of an ancient glass vessel. Glass had varying colours and transparencies, depending on the technology of the cultures who created it.

01900007.name: Ancient Burial Map
01900007.description: Land at the Africa Northwest Coast. The Northeast corner.

discovery.name: Wooden Coffin
discovery.description: A wooden coffin, used for burials from ancient times. These coffins range from rectangular boxes to some made into intricate human forms.

01900008.name: Old Greek Relic Map
01900008.description: Outside the gates of Athens (Northwest) Southeast corner.

discovery.name: A Slate in Greek
discovery.description: Stone tablet with Greek characters inscribed upon it. The inscription seems to have been written to last a long time.

01900009.name: Ancient Money Map
01900009.description: Northwest from out the gates of Candia.

discovery.name: Ancient Gold
discovery.description: Ancient money, made from gold and its alloys. Gold has been considered precious since ancient times.

01900010.name: Ancient Money Map
01900010.description: West after heading out the gates of Genoa.

discovery.name: Ancient Silver
discovery.description: Ancient money, made from silver. Normally second in value to gold, in ancient times it was more scarce than gold and valued more highly.

01900011.name: Celtic Relic Map
01900011.description: Outside the gates of Dublin, northeast corner.

discovery.name: Celtic Jewellery
discovery.description: Accessories used by Celts. Celtic jewellery used much gold and sported unique writing and designs.

01900012.name: Ancient Settlement Map
01900012.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. Near the large boulder to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Ancient Stone
discovery.description: Masonry used in stone structures from ancient civilizations. Some of them are very large and it is a mystery how they were transported and erected.

01900014.name: Ancient Burial Map
01900014.description: Land at the Egypt North Coast. Near the human bones to the Southwest.

discovery.name: The Golden Grave Burial Items
discovery.description: Golden grave burial items, buried along with the deceased. In many cases, items used while alive or exceptional items were interred to ease their life after death.

01900015.name: Ancient Tools Map
01900015.description: Land at the Turkey West Coast. The Northeast corner.

discovery.name: Bronze
discovery.description: Bronze vessels used by ancient civilizations. Bronze was easy to work with, and used by many ancient cultures.

01900017.name: Ancient Burial Map
01900017.description: Bend of the Boyne in the outskirts of Dublin. Within some ruins.

discovery.name: Sarcophagus
discovery.description: Stone coffin used to bury the dead. The coffins of important people had intricate reliefs carved into them.

01900018.name: Prehistoric Sites Map
01900018.description: Land at Central Nile. Near the table boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: Stone Tools
discovery.description: Prehistoric tools carved out of stone. Thought to have been tied to sticks and made into spears or used as knives.

01900019.name: Prehistoric Sites Map
01900019.description: Outside the gates of Athens (Northwest) Near the giant dead tree in the interior in the north.

discovery.name: Traces of a Prehistoric Bonfire
discovery.description: Remains of the use of fire by humans. Fire is the symbol of cultural development, and where you find it, you can guess that humans were active.

01900021.name: Ancient Text Map
01900021.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. Proceed inland to Giza. Near the building to the West.

discovery.name: Papyrus Scrolls
discovery.description: Ancient Egyptian books. Made from beaten, stretched out stalks of papyrus, on it are recorded hieroglyphs, the sacred letters of ancient Egypt.

01900022.name: Ancient Burial Map
01900022.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. Proceed inland to Giza. Inside the ruins.

discovery.name: The Golden Coffin
discovery.description: A gold coffin. Thought to have belonged to an ancient royal, or noble family. It's exquisite ornamentation gives some indication of the power of the one buried.

01900023.name: Ancient Text Map
01900023.description: Western outskirts of Athens, near a large monument of the Olympia region.

discovery.name: Parchment Archives
discovery.description: A book written on parchment made from sheep skin. It is stable and lasts for a long time. In the middle ages, books were all copied by hand, so they were incredibly valuable.

01900024.name: Old Greek Relic Map
01900024.description: North-western outskirts of Athens, near a large monument of the Phocis region.

discovery.name: Ancient Greek Vase
discovery.description: This is an urn thought to have been made in ancient Greek times. Several scenes from Greek mythology are painted on it.

01900025.name: Ancient Tools Map
01900025.description: Land at the Turkey West Coast. Near the giant dead tree just west of the center.

discovery.name: Painted Pottery
discovery.description: Earthenware decorated with designs. Developed by many ancient civilizations, each with their own unique designs. A study of these designs is thought to be useful in clarifying the interactions between cultures.

01900026.name: Old Egyptian Relic Map
01900026.description: Land at Upper Nile. Proceed inland to South Aswan. Inside the temple.

discovery.name: Slate of Hieroglyphs
discovery.description: A stone slate inscribed with ancient Egyptian hieroglyphs. Birds, beasts, and parts of the body are all displayed in characters. What could they mean?

01900028.name: Old Accessories Map
01900028.description: At the relics in Campania On the outskirts of Naples.

discovery.name: Glass Jewellery
discovery.description: Glass produced for ornamental use. Seen in many cultures, they are characterised by different colours and shapes. Glass is a material that has been used since ancient times.

01900029.name: Ancient Goldwork Map
01900029.description: Outside the gates of Athens (West) Near the ruins on the north.

discovery.name: Ancient Gold Bowl
discovery.description: Vessels made from gold or plated with gold. Not for everyday use. Used only for festivals and special occasions.

01900030.name: Ancient Silverwork Map
01900030.description: Land at the Bay of Biscay South Coast. Near the lone cedar to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Ancient Silver Bowl
discovery.description: Bowls made from silver. Not for everyday use. Used only for festivals and special occasions.

01900031.name: Ancient Food Map
01900031.description: Land at the Indian Ocean East African Coast. Near the white flowers to the North.

discovery.name: Ancient Coffee
discovery.description: Coffee was originally produced in Ethiopia and drunk as medicine from ancient times. At the time, the beans were dried, boiled, and drunk.

01900032.name: Old Bronze Ware Map
01900032.description: Slightly west out of the gates of Candia.

discovery.name: Bronze Armour
discovery.description: Ancient armour made out of bronze. Easy to work with, bronze was used by many ancient cultures, but was soft and not suitable for war.

01900033.name: Prehistoric Sites Map
01900033.description: Outside the gates of Nantes Westernmost point.

discovery.name: Bone Tools
discovery.description: Tools made in prehistoric times from bones and animal horns. Bones were not suited to blades, but were good for arrow heads, spears, and needles. They were also used as talismans and accessories.

01900034.name: Ancient Script Relic Map
01900034.description: Land at the Gulf of Bothnia West Coast. Near the large boulder to the West.

discovery.name: A Runic Stone
discovery.description: A stone inscribed with runes used in Northern Europe at that time. Many record achievements or commemorate deeds. Stones such as these were in common usage at that time.

01900035.name: Ancient Text Map of Egypt
01900035.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. Proceed inland to Giza. Near the diagonal boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: The Book of the Dead
discovery.description: A spell book for the dead, inserted with the body into the coffin in ancient Egyptian funerals. It was thought that if they carried this book, they would be found innocent when judged by Osiris in the afterlife.

01900036.name: Egyptian Murals Map
01900036.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. Proceed inland to Giza. Inside the ruins.

discovery.name: Egyptian Murals
discovery.description: Murals often seen in ancient Egyptian temples and graveyards. Many of them are beautifully coloured, with sacred texts eulogizing gods or pharaohs.

01900037.name: Celtic Relic Map
01900037.description: At the relics of Bend of the Boyne In the outskirts of Dublin.

discovery.name: Statue of a Celtic God
discovery.description: A statue of a god worshipped in the Celtic culture. Made of bronze, with a large head and small limbs it has a peculiar shape.

01900038.name: Ancient Goldwork Map
01900038.description: At the relics in Campania on the outskirts of Naples.

discovery.name: Gold Jewellery
discovery.description: Jewellery made from gold. Shape and usage differ depending on culture, which gives clues to the interaction and spread of ancient cultures.

01900039.name: Ancient Silverwork Map
01900039.description: Near the pointed rock southwest from the outer gates of Candia.

discovery.name: Silver Jewellery
discovery.description: Jewellery made from silver. Not just for ornamentation, there are many charms and amulets and pieces with special purposes.

01900040.name: Ancient Settlement Map
01900040.description: Land at the Turkey West Coast. Proceed inland to the Hisarlik Hill. At the northern edge.

discovery.name: Ancient Rug
discovery.description: Rugs used in ancient civilizations. Woven with hemp and animal hair.

01900041.name: Ancient Tools Map
01900041.description: Near the cross grave towards the northwest from the gates of Candia.

discovery.name: Ancient Pottery
discovery.description: Pottery baked with natural glaze. As technology developed, various different colours and patterns appeared.

01900042.name: Ancient Tools Map
01900042.description: Land at the Persian Gulf North Coast. At the southern edge.

discovery.name: Ancient Farming Tool
discovery.description: Tools used for agriculture. There are many different kinds depending upon the culture.

01900043.name: Ancient Jewellery Map
01900043.description: Land at the Turkey West Coast. Proceed inland to the Hisarlik Hill. The southeastern corner.

discovery.name: The Lapidary Jewellery
discovery.description: Accessories decorated with a variety of jewels. In ancient civilizations, jewels were believed to have special powers and so were used as talismans.

01900044.name: Old Persian Relics Map
01900044.description: Outside the gates of Beirut, northwest corner.

discovery.name: Ancient Lebanon Cedar
discovery.description: This lumber was used frequently from the Ancient middle east to Persia. It's of high quality and has many uses in the construction of buildings and ships. Because of deforestation, it is rarely seen today.

01900047.name: Cuneiform Relic Map
01900047.description: Outside the gates of Jaffa towards the southwest.

discovery.name: A Clay Tablet in Cuneiform
discovery.description: Clay tablets inscribed with Cuneiform. Used in everyday life, large quantities have been excavated. Locations with many gathered in one place were likely libraries.

01900048.name: Ancient Iron Ware Map
01900048.description: Land at the Arabian Sea Northeast Coast. Near the upturned boulder to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Iron Armour
discovery.description: Ancient iron armour. In the age of bronze, anyone who could have used hard iron would have been invincible. The only people to have iron smelting, the Hittites, became powerful.

01900049.name: Old Greek Spear Map
01900049.description: Outside the gates of Athens (West) near the ruins on the west.

discovery.name: Phalanx's Spear
discovery.description: A phalanx was an ancient Greek corps of close-ranked, hoplite infantry. They used long spears and wore armour, helmets and shin protectors, and charged their enemies.

01900050.name: Old Roman Shield Map
01900050.description: Outside the gates of Genoa north west corner.

discovery.name: Shield of Ancient Roman Militia
discovery.description: In ancient Rome, citizens joined the army. Citizens who joined paid for their own equipment and attended training. Equipment were made from bronze.

01900051.name: Old Indian Seal Map
01900051.description: Land at the West Indian Coast. Near the table boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: The Indus Style Square Seal
discovery.description: A triangular seal of the Indus civilization. It is inscribed with geometric patterns, animals, and Indus symbols.

01900052.name: Coloured Tiles Map
01900052.description: Land at the Red Sea East Coast. Near the large boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: Painted Brick
discovery.description: Bricks in beautiful colours. Made in many different colours to be put together into patterns on doors and walls.

01900053.name: Ancient Tools Map
01900053.description: Land at the Red Sea East Coast. Near the large boulder to the South.

discovery.name: Inlaid Bronze
discovery.description: Bronze vessels with elaborate inlays. Perhaps due to the precious metals, jewels and the high quality of workmanship needed, it is frequently used for royal burial accessories or the furnishings of affluent families.

01900055.name: Prehistoric Sites Map
01900055.description: Land at the Bay of Biscay South Coast. Head South.

discovery.name: Prehistoric Wall Paintings
discovery.description: Prehistoric wall paintings found often in caves and burial mounds. Featuring animals and people, they shed some light on the way of life of that time.

01900056.name: Ancient Burial Map
01900056.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. Proceed inland to Giza. Inside the ruins.

discovery.name: A Mummy
discovery.description: A body that has been embalmed and wrapped in order to preserve it. Ancient Egypt, in particular, believed in the resurrection of the dead, so these techniques are extremely advanced.

01900057.name: Ancient Cart Map
01900057.description: Land at the Red Sea East Coast. Near the diagonal boulder to the East-Northeast.

discovery.name: Ancient Cart
discovery.description: Made to carry large amounts of luggage at a single time. Used in cultures that had developed the wheel. Civilizations without wheels used rollers.

01900058.name: Ancient Tools Map
01900058.description: Land at the Turkey West Coast. Near the giant dead tree to the Southwest.

discovery.name: Ancient Harness
discovery.description: Equipment for looking after horses. Until bits, stirrups, and saddles were invented, horses were only used for carrying cargo, ploughing, and pulling chariots.

01900059.name: Enter Underground Map
01900059.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. Head Southwest.

discovery.name: The City of the Dead
discovery.description: Also called a Necropolis, it was a vast mass grave. The form and burial rituals were dependent on the culture, but this type of city of the dead can be seen in many different cultures.

01900060.name: Greek Goddess Map
01900060.description: Western outskirts of Athens, Olympia region immediately northwest.

discovery.name: The Statue of Athena
discovery.description: A statue of the Greek goddess Athena, the goddess of industry, art, knowledge, and war. Known as Minerva in Roman theology. Athena was the guardian of the city state of Athens and the Parthenon was her temple.

01900062.name: Egyptian Goddess Map
01900062.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. At the northern edge.

discovery.name: The Statue of Bastet
discovery.description: A statue of Bastet, an ancient Egyptian female deity with the form of a cat, or the head of a cat. Because of their ability to catch snakes, cats were highly valued. Eventually they were worshipped as gods. Bastet is the guardian of cats and also the goddess of love.

01900063.name: Greek Goddess Map
01900063.description: Western outskirts of Athens, near Olympia region's large monument structure.

discovery.name: The Statue of Hestia
discovery.description: A Statue of Hestia, the Greek goddess of the hearth. She is the older sister of Zeus and widely worshipped in ancient Greece. Known as Vesta in Roman mythology.

01900064.name: Greek Gods Statue Map
01900064.description: North east corner, outside the gates of Candia.

discovery.name: The Statue of Hephaestus
discovery.description: A statue of the Greek god of fire and blacksmiths. Said to have an unsightly appearance, his wife was the most beautiful goddess of all, Aphrodite. His workshop is thought to have been underground on the Island of Sicily.

01900065.name: Indian Goddess Map
01900065.description: South east corner, outside the gates of Calicut.

discovery.name: The Statue of Ushas
discovery.description: A statue of the ancient Indian goddess Ushas. She is the goddess of the dawn, with deep crimson clothes and a golden veil. She is said to be the most beautiful of all in the Rigveda and was the wife of the sun god Surya.

01900066.name: Ancient Shrine Map
01900066.description: Land at the Turkey West Coast. Proceed inland to the Hisarlik Hill. Head North.

discovery.name: Ancient Altar
discovery.description: An altar used for religious sacrifices. Depending on the culture and religion, there are many different kinds.

01900067.name: Indian Scripture Map
01900067.description: Land at the West Indian Coast. At the northern edge.

discovery.name: Buddhist Sutras
discovery.description: Books containing the teachings of Siddhartha Gautama Buddha. Of these sacred scriptures, the Sutta Nipata is said to be the oldest and closest to his original words. Over time many sects have emerged and there are many versions existing.

01900068.name: Indian Bodhisattva Map
01900068.description: Near the swamp on the northeast, outside the gates of Calicut.

discovery.name: The Statue of Bodhisattva
discovery.description: A Buddhist statue. Bodhisattva was originally used to refer to the pre-enlightenment Buddha. However, the interpretation changed and it now refers to those near enlightenment, who choose to not yet become a Buddha.

01900070.name: African God Statue Map
01900070.description: Land at the Africa Southwest Coast. At the northern edge.

discovery.name: The Statue of Nyame
discovery.description: A statue of Nyame, the supreme god, worshipped in West Africa. Worshipped over a wide area, he has many other names, as well. Nyame first lived on the earth but ascended to the heavens to distance himself from people. There are many similar myths.

01900072.name: Indian Gods Statue Map
01900072.description: Land at the West Indian Coast. Near the table boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: The Statue of Hanuman
discovery.description: A statue of Hanuman, a monkey god that appears in Indian mythology. Widely worshipped for his role in the Ramayana of helping the main character Rama. Because he has white fur, white furred monkeys in India are protected as the messengers of Hanuman.

01900073.name: Ancient Text Map of India
01900073.description: Outside the gates of Calicut, north-eastern corner.

discovery.name: The Sanskrit Scroll
discovery.description: A scroll written in Sanskrit characters. The characters were originally used in general for the Sanskrit language, but over time, they began to be used more for religious writings.

01900074.name: Religious Painting Map
01900074.description: Inside the church in Genoa. Near the altar in the back.

discovery.name: The Annunciation
discovery.description: An altar piece by Simone Martini. Said to have been part of a large scale work comprised of multiple pictures. For religious paintings of its time, the people have rich facial expressions, making many believe this was the advent of a new age.

01900075.name: Religious Painting Map
01900075.description: Inside the church in Naples. By the wall on the left.

discovery.name: The Coronation of the Virgin
discovery.description: Part of an altarpiece by Fra Angelico. His name means angelic, and it was used to describe him after his death. He was a very pious monk, who created many wall paintings and altarpieces. The perspective style he used was considered at the forefront of the techniques of the day.

01900076.name: Tapestry Map
01900076.description: Inside the church in Venice. By the wall on the left.

discovery.name: Tapestry of the Old Testament
discovery.description: One of a series of tapestries based on the work Moses Saved from the Waters by Simon Vouet. Taken from the Old Testament, there are eight works in all. It is a gorgeous and extravagant Gobelin tapestry.

01900077.name: Religious Painting Map
01900077.description: Inside the church in Genoa. By the wall on the left in the back.

discovery.name: Paradise Lost
discovery.description: Fresco by Masaccio. Full title is The Expulsion from the Garden of Eden. One of several works by different artists displayed on the walls of Brancacci Chapel. Through his lines of perspective, Masaccio brought to life his paintings in a way previously unseen.

01900078.name: Tapestry Map
01900078.description: Inside the church in Nantes. By the wall on the left.

archives.discovery: Tapestry of the History of Scipio

discovery.name: Tapestry of the History of Scipio
discovery.description: One of a series of tapestries woven based on a piece by Giulio Romano. It shows a scene from the ancient Roman Punic Wars, following Scipio's achievements.

01900079.name: Small Religious Painting map
01900079.description: Inside the church in Famagusta. Near the altar in the back.

discovery.name: Icon
discovery.description: An icon used for worship in the Orthodox Church. It depicts holy saints and important religious scenes.

01900081.name: Religious Painting Map
01900081.description: Inside the church in Genoa. By the wall on the left.

discovery.name: The Coronation of the Virgin
discovery.description: An altarpiece by Fra Filippo Lippi. He created expressive pieces with unique colours the likes of which had never been seen before. He had a major influence on many renowned painters such as Botticelli and Da Vinci.

01900082.name: Caryatides Map
01900082.description: Western outskirts of Athens immediately northwest entering Olympia region.

discovery.name: The Erechtheion Statues of Girls
discovery.description: Standing near the Parthenon, the Erechtheion temple has the Caryatids, six draped female figures with an atmosphere of elegance, as supporting pillars.

01900083.name: Holy Church Vessel Map
01900083.description: Inside the church in Bordeaux. By the wall on the left in the back.

discovery.name: The Ivory Ark
discovery.description: The sculptor is unknown, and the ivory tabernacle stands at around 30 cm in height. It is possible that it was made for worshipping at home. The right and left boards can be folded in. The Virgin and Child in the centre are embossed carvings, rather than full sculptures.

01900084.name: Beautiful Urn Map
01900084.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. At the southern edge.

discovery.name: The Alabaster Vase
discovery.description: A vase carved from alabaster. The transparent alabaster gives it a unique beauty.

01900085.name: Opulent Jewellery Map
01900085.description: Outside the gates of Dublin, southeast corner.

discovery.name: Broken Brooch
discovery.description: A broken brooch. Some of the jewels have fallen off, and the clasp is broken. Before it broke, it must have been a sight to behold.

01900086.name: Opulent Jewellery Map
01900086.description: Land at the Egypt North Coast. Head Southwest.

discovery.name: Necklace Worn Off Plating
discovery.description: A beautifully crafted gilded necklace that is probably not too valuable. The gilding is peeling off, so it's looking pretty bad now.

01900087.name: Beautiful Urn Map
01900087.description: Land at the Baltic Sea,South-West. Near the ruins to the East.

discovery.name: The Relief Vase
discovery.description: A jar decorated with a beautiful relief. This is probably for decoration only and not for use.

01900089.name: Opulent Jewellery Map
01900089.description: Land at the Egypt North Coast. The southeastern corner.

discovery.name: Small Bejewelled Box
discovery.description: A beautiful box decorated with colourful jewels. One wonders if it's the jewellery box of a noble woman.

01900090.name: Tapestry Map
01900090.description: Land at the Turkey West Coast. The southeastern corner.

discovery.name: Tapestry with Gold Threads
discovery.description: A gorgeous piece of cloth to hang on the wall. The gold thread gives it a fine texture, and it looks very much like a painting.

01900091.name: Fantastic Weapon Map
01900091.description: Land at the France Northwest Coast. At the bottom of the large tree to the South.

discovery.name: Rusty Treasured Sword
discovery.description: A fancy sword with a rusted blade. Decorated with jewels and gold. Since the blade is not that good, it was likely used for decoration only.

01900092.name: Marble Relief Map
01900092.description: Outside the gates of Athens (West) towards north.

discovery.name: Sculptured Marble Tiles
discovery.description: A marble tile with a relief. Used to decorate walls and floors.

01900093.name: Female in Bronze Map
01900093.description: Northwest corner from the outer gates of Candia.

discovery.name: Bronze Statue of a Woman
discovery.description: A bronze statue of a woman. Thought to be comparatively recent. A beautiful statue fashioned in the Greek style.

01900094.name: Male in Bronze Map
01900094.description: Southwest corner from the outer gates of Candia.

discovery.name: Bronze Statue of a Man
discovery.description: A bronze statue of a man. A statue fashioned with the dignity of the ancient Greek style. It is likely this was crafted recently, and not during the era when that style was common.

01900095.name: African Accessory Map
01900095.description: Land at the Africa South-Southwest Coast. Near the large boulder to the North.

discovery.name: Zulu Jewellery
discovery.description: Accessories from inhabitants of southern Africa. They show intricate patterns made from coloured beads. The name Zulu means people of paradise. They are an extremely brave people.

01900097.name: Silverwork Armour Map
01900097.description: Land at the British Isles East Coast. Near the cross grave just to the North.

discovery.name: Silver Armour
discovery.description: A suit of armour over which the bare metal has been decorated with silver. Although silver is not a strong metal, it is believed that it contains the power to repel evil, so it was likely used for festivals.

01900098.name: Fantastic Weapon Map
01900098.description: Near the white flower in the north from the outer gates of Dublin.

discovery.name: Short Sword for Rituals
discovery.description: A ritualistic dagger. Decorated with gorgeous jewels and gold, it appears to have limited practical use.

01900099.name: Marble Goods Map
01900099.description: North-western outskirts of Athens near a monument structure of the Phocis region.

discovery.name: Marble Table
discovery.description: A gorgeous marble table, beautifully decorated. Without considerable financial wealth, one can't acquire furnishings such as these.

01900100.name: Beautiful Urn Map
01900100.description: Land at the Red Sea East Coast. The southwestern corner.

discovery.name: Persian Style Vase
discovery.description: A beautiful jar bearing patterns particular to Persia. There are many depictions of plants, since in the Islamic faith, they avoid drawing images of living creatures.

01900101.name: Opulent Jewellery Map
01900101.description: Land at the Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea. Near the large boulder to the Southeast.

archives.location: Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea
Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea

discovery.name: Amulet with Gold Inlay
discovery.description: A large charm with golden incrustations. With its precise sculpting, it is valuable as a religious artifact as well as a work of art.

01900102.name: Luxurious Clothing Map
01900102.description: Inside the church in Venice. Near the middle row of the pews on the left side.

discovery.name: Gentlewoman's Dress
discovery.description: Gorgeous clothes that use an abundance of silk and jewels. With exquisite stitching, this is likely worn by a noble woman.

01900103.name: Splendid Armour Map
01900103.description: Outside the gates of Nantes, southeast corner.

discovery.name: Inlayed Armour
discovery.description: This armour is inlayed with gold and silver work. It seems likely that this was created for festivals and purely decorative purposes.

01900104.name: Female in Marble Map
01900104.description: North-western outskirts of Athens at the bottom of the dead tree in the northeast of Phocis region.

discovery.name: Marble Statue of a Woman
discovery.description: A marble statue of a woman. It has beautiful, rounded lines and does not appear to be that old.

01900105.name: Marble Man Map
01900105.description: North-western outskirts of Athens at the bottom of the dead tree in the northwest of Phocis region.

discovery.name: Marble Statue of a Man
discovery.description: A marble statue of a man. Here we can see the Greek style being emulated, and the physical beauty is wonderfully expressed.

01900106.name: Ivory Statue of Goddess Map
01900106.description: Land at the Egypt North Coast. Near the ruins to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Ivory Statue of Goddess
discovery.description: A statue of a goddess carved from ivory. An unbelievably detailed piece of work.

01900107.name: Opulent Jewellery Map
01900107.description: Land at Upper Nile. Near the pointed boulder to the East.

discovery.name: The Turquoise Amulet
discovery.description: A charm with a huge turquoise set in the center. Turquoise is used as a charm by many civilizations.

01900108.name: Hidden Treasure Map
01900108.description: Land at the Madagascar West Coast. At the bottom of the large tree to the North.

discovery.name: Hidden Treasure
discovery.description: A box full of precious metals, jewels, and other treasure. Did some aristocrat or rich family hide this away during a time of war?

01900109.name: Green Gem Ore Vein Map
01900109.description: Land at the Bay of Bengal Northeast Coast. At the eastern edge.

discovery.name: Jade
discovery.description: A perfect jade with fantastic clarity. Bright green with no scratches. It is hard to find gems such as these; it clearly has a very high value.

01900110.name: Blue Gem Ore Vein Map
01900110.description: Land at the Arabian Sea Northeast Coast. The southwestern corner.

discovery.name: Cornflower Blue
discovery.description: A superlative sapphire. Known as cornflower due to its vivid blue colour, it can only be found in a specific areas.

01900114.name: Pink Gem Ore Vein Map
01900114.description: Land at the Africa South Coast. Head North.

discovery.name: Pink Diamond
discovery.description: A pink diamond. The higher the clarity and the better the color, the higher the value.

01900115.name: Blue Gem Ore Vein Map
01900115.description: Land at the Africa South-Southeast Coast. At the western edge.

discovery.name: Blue Diamond
discovery.description: A blue diamond. A beautiful blue diamond is extremely rare and very hard to find.

01900116.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900116.description: Near the rocks immediately west of the gates of Tunis.

discovery.name: Giant Egg Shaped Stone
discovery.description: A strange stone shaped like an egg. It looks so real with its egg-shell. No living thing could lay an egg of this size. Could it be a dragon's egg?

01900117.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900117.description: Land at the Africa North Gulf of Guinea. The southwestern corner.

discovery.name: Snail Patterned Stone
discovery.description: A very large stone shaped like a big sea snail. If a shellfish gets too big...does it turn to stone? It was also found on land which is even more mysterious.

01900118.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900118.description: Land at the Morocco West Coast. Head Southeast. Near the pointed boulder.

discovery.name: Fossilized Insect Shape of Shoe
discovery.description: A flat stone shaped like an insect. It looks a little like a sea louse, but it's too big. Does anything similar live near here? And why does this stone have such a peculiar design?

01900119.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900119.description: Land at the Africa Northwest Coast. Head Southeast. Near the stacked boulders.

archives.discovery: Bones of Lizard with Two Feet
Bones of Lizard with Two Feet
Bones of Lizard with Two Feet

discovery.name: Bones of Lizard with Two Feet
discovery.description: This stone bears the outline of a large lizard's bone. It appears that it stood on two legs. Although smaller than a human, it would be very unwise to attack such a creature. Could this really be out there somewhere?

01900120.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900120.description: Land at the Africa North Coast. At the southern edge.

archives.discovery: The Stone of an Eerie Flower
The Stone of an Eerie Flower

discovery.name: The Stone of an Eerie Flower
discovery.description: This stone bears the design of a weird looking plant. Its shape is wavy and lined. I've never seen such an odd flower before, is it really out there growing somewhere?

01900122.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900122.description: Land at the Morocco West Coast. Near the ruins to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Bones Half Dragon Half Fish
discovery.description: The bones of a creature with a long neck like a dragon and fins like a dolphin. The bone has petrified. But why would bone turn to stone...? Was there magic involved?

01900123.name: Red Flower Map
01900123.description: Outside the gates of Tripoli near the table rock in the north.

discovery.name: Carnations
discovery.description: A plant whose flower blooms with many pleats. It has a nice fragrance. It has also been bred for gardening.

01900124.name: Beautiful Tree Map
01900124.description: Outside the gates of Naples, east from the gates.

discovery.name: Norway Maple
discovery.description: A deciduous tree whose leaves turn red and yellow as winter approaches. With many trees, this can be a beautiful scene. The seeds have small wings allowing them to fly on the wind.

01900125.name: White Flower Map
01900125.description: Outside the gates of Genoa towards southwest.

discovery.name: Gypsophila
discovery.description: A plant with many small white flowers when it blooms. It is beautiful simply as it is, but when added to a bouquet, it can look wonderful.

01900126.name: White Flower Map
01900126.description: Outside the gates of Salonika near the solitary cedar on the east.

discovery.name: Daisy
discovery.description: A plant that blooms with thick, small petals all bunched together. If you open it up to look at each petal individually, you will see that each has a stamen and pistil.

01900127.name: Fruit Tree Map
01900127.description: Land at the Turkey West Coast. The northwestern corner.

discovery.name: Cherry
discovery.description: A deciduous tree that blooms with light pink flowers in spring. The leaves and flowers bloom at the same time, and after the flower, the tree bears an edible fruit.

01900128.name: Beautiful Tree Map
01900128.description: Land at the Baltic Sea North. Near the diagonal boulder to the West.

discovery.name: Birch
discovery.description: A deciduous tree with a white trunk. Unseen in warmer climates, it thrives in the cold. Silver birch woods are a beautiful site.

01900129.name: White Flower Map
01900129.description: Outside the west gate of Athens. The southeastern corner.

discovery.name: Daffodils
discovery.description: A lovely plant that blooms with yellow and white flowers. The bulbs themselves multiply allowing many to grow at once. Despite its appearance, it carries a powerful poison that can kill if ingested.

01900130.name: Large Tree Map
01900130.description: Outside the gates of Calicut, westernmost point.

discovery.name: Lime Tree
discovery.description: A deciduous tree that grows to great heights. It can be found in many places, but it seems to differ slightly depending on the area. In the West, the leaves are sometimes used as a herb. In India, it is believed that Buddha was enlightened beneath this tree.

01900131.name: Red Flower Map
01900131.description: Land at the Turkey West Coast. The northeastern corner.

discovery.name: Cyclamen
discovery.description: A plant with large petals that bloom downward. The flowers can be pink or bright red, and it looks graceful and beautiful.

01900132.name: White Flower Map
01900132.description: Outside the gates of Salonika, northwest corner.

discovery.name: Irises
discovery.description: A plant that blooms with gorgeous purple or violet-blue flowers. Particularly good for the garden.

01900133.name: Red Flower Map
01900133.description: Land at the Turkey West Coast. The southwestern corner.

discovery.name: Tulips
discovery.description: A plant with a pot-like flower that comes in many different colours such as red and yellow. The plants grow from a bulb. It has grown quite popular recently, and has been improved through breeding.

01900134.name: White Flower Map
01900134.description: Outside the gates of Nantes near the layered rock on the east.

discovery.name: Madonna Lily
discovery.description: A plant that blooms with beautiful, cylindrical flowers. It has a powerful fragrance. In Christian festivals, white lilies' are often used. The pollen clings to your clothes and it's difficult to remove.

01900135.name: White Flower Map
01900135.description: Outside the gates of Genoa, southeast corner.

discovery.name: Snowdrops
discovery.description: Also known as Galanthus. A lovely flower that blooms with white petals. It is thought to herald the coming of spring as it blooms when the snow melts.

01900138.name: Poisonous Insect Map
01900138.description: Land at the Red Sea West Coast. At the southern edge.

discovery.name: Poisonous Scorpion
discovery.description: An insect with a poison in a stinger at the tip of its tail. The body resembles a prawn. The poison is extremely powerful and has been known to kill humans. Although it is usually found in deserts, it does have a nasty habit of popping up in unusual places.

01900139.name: White Bird Map
01900139.description: Land at the Scandinavia West Coast. The southwestern corner.

discovery.name: Swan
discovery.description: A large waterfowl known for its long, graceful neck and beautiful white wings. It's a migratory bird and moves every six months. The gray birds that accompany them are their young.

01900140.name: White Bird Map
01900140.description: Land at the Africa West Coast. Near the stacked boulders to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Pelican
discovery.description: A waterfowl with a large sack under its beak. It's considerably large. Perhaps it uses the sack under its beak to catch fish?

01900141.name: Black Waterfowl Map
01900141.description: South-southwest of Sofala, near the coast.

discovery.name: African Penguin
discovery.description: A penguin with an unusual design from its head to its throat. It lives in South Africa, and there are countless masses of them.

01900142.name: Tailless Rodent Map
01900142.description: Outside the gates of Beirut Northeast corner.

discovery.name: Golden Hamster
discovery.description: A rat with a reddish brown back, a white belly, and virtually no tail. It moves slowly and lives above ground, but it does dig its own nesting holes. It has very big cheek pouches, allowing it to carry large amount of food and nesting material.

01900143.name: Rock Dwellers' Map
01900143.description: Land at the Africa Southeast Coast. The northwestern corner.

discovery.name: Hyrax
discovery.description: An animal with a round body that lives in rocky areas. They dig their own nesting holes and live as a community; however, we don't know much about their ecology as they are extremely timid.

01900144.name: Map of Creepy Animal
01900144.description: Outside the gates of Tunis near the ruins on the northwest.

discovery.name: Giant Toad
discovery.description: A large frog. It has a lot of lumps like warts on its body. If it feels threatened, it can shoot a white venom from behind its ears. If this gets on your skin, it can be painful and itchy.

01900145.name: Small Carnivores Map
01900145.description: Land at the Baltic Sea South-East. The southwestern corner.

discovery.name: Ferret
discovery.description: Also known as a ferret. Because it has longer hair than ordinary weasels, it can look lovely. However, since it is a weasel, it can release an overpowering stink. It must be clear to the crew that they are not to bring one onboard!

01900146.name: Golden Animal Map
01900146.description: Land at the Africa South Coast. The southeastern corner.

discovery.name: Golden Mole
discovery.description: An animal that digs tunnels and lives beneath the earth. It has small eyes and can't see very well. It has well developed toes on its front feet, allowing it to easily dig up the earth.

01900147.name: Small Organisms Map
01900147.description: Land at the Scandinavia West Coast. The northeastern corner.

discovery.name: Lemming
discovery.description: A type of short and fat rat. It has a black line on its back. Periodically, they appear in immense numbers and travel in groups. At that time, many will perish when they come across rivers, seas, or valleys, as they are unable to prevent themselves from diving in.

01900148.name: Small Carnivores Map
01900148.description: Land at the France Northwest Coast. Near the red flowers to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Stoat
discovery.description: A small animal that looks like a weasel. In the winter, it sheds its hair and turns white. Carnivorous, it eats rats and small birds.

01900150.name: Jerboa Map
01900150.description: Land at the Arabian Sea Northwest Coast. The southeastern corner.

discovery.name: Jerboa
discovery.description: A rat with long hind legs allowing it to leap through the air. It has long ears, a short nose, and very large eyes.

01900152.name: Burrowing Animals Map
01900152.description: Land at the Gulf of Bothnia West Coast. The northeastern corner.

discovery.name: Badger
discovery.description: A short and plump animal like a Japanese raccoon or a bear. It digs holes and lives in groups, its nests are too big to search.

01900153.name: Herds of Deer Map
01900153.description: Land at the British Isles East Coast. Just north of the cross grave at the southern edge.

discovery.name: Red Deer
discovery.description: An animal found across a large region from temperate to subarctic zones. The male has large horns, while the female is more diminutive.

01900154.name: Wild Goats Map
01900154.description: Land at the Morocco West Coast. Head Northeast. Near the pointed boulder.

discovery.name: Barbary Sheep
discovery.description: An animal that seems to be a cross between a sheep and a goat, and it lives on rocky hills. The groups tend to consist of one male and multiple females.

01900155.name: Wild Goats Map
01900155.description: Outside the gates of Famagusta near the large tree on the west.

discovery.name: Mouflon
discovery.description: An animal that resembles a sheep. It has horns similar to those of a sheep. It is thought to be the ancestor of the domesticated sheep. It's a very cautious animal and difficult to approach.

01900156.name: Lynx Cats Map
01900156.description: Land at the Gulf of Bothnia, West Coast. Just north of the giant dead tree at the southern edge.

discovery.name: Lynx
discovery.description: As large as a mountain cat, it is dappled and has decorative hair at the tip of its ears. It can be seen over a large area.

01900157.name: Weird Skin Animal Map
01900157.description: Land at the Africa Southeast Coast. Near the upturned boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: Zebra
discovery.description: An animal with black and white stripes all over its body. It has the body of a small horse. It is known to live in large groups.

01900158.name: Wild Dogs Map
01900158.description: Land at the Africa South-Southeast Coast. Head Northwest. Around the human cactus.

discovery.name: Hyena
discovery.description: An animal that looks like a dog. It hunts for carcasses that have been left by other carnivores, but it's also a pretty good hunter in its own right. They tend to live in packs.

01900159.name: Deer-like Animals Map
01900159.description: Land at the Africa Southeast Coast. The southeastern corner.

discovery.name: Impala
discovery.description: An animal like a deer that has long, twisted horns. The horns don't branch out like a deer. It lives in groups and runs by leaping.

01900160.name: Wild Dogs Map
01900160.description: Land at the Africa North Coast. Head Southeast from the stacked boulders, to the Southwest.

discovery.name: Jackal
discovery.description: A carnivore that looks like a dog or a fox. It's a little bigger than a fox, and there seem to be several different types of body colour.

01900162.name: Deer-like Animals Map
01900162.description: Land at the Africa Southeast Coast. Near the upturned boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: Thomson's Gazelle
discovery.description: A small animal that looks like a deer. It lives in large groups. It has short horns. The entire species is horned, both male and female.

01900163.name: Arabian Animals Map
01900163.description: Land at the Red Sea East Coast. A short walk to the East.

discovery.name: Arabian Oryx
discovery.description: An animal with long horns like a cow. It lives in desert regions. Not particularly large. It's often seen making holes in the ground to sit in. Could be they use this technique to control their temperature.

01900164.name: Indian Animals Map
01900164.description: Land at the West Indian Coast. A short walk to the North.

discovery.name: Black Buck
discovery.description: An antelope from India. It looks like a cow, but is thinner. It has large, twisted horns.

01900165.name: Burrowing Animals Map
01900165.description: Land at the Africa Southwest Coast. Near the giant dead tree to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Aardvark
discovery.description: An animal with an elongated face, long ears, and a short, plump body. It's a bit of a slow mover, but can dig a hole at lightning speed. It has a very long tongue that it uses to eat ants.

01900166.name: Large Monkey Map
01900166.description: Outside the gates of Massaua, southernmost point.

discovery.name: Hamadryas
discovery.description: A monkey that stays in large groups on rocky hills. The males stand out with their long, decorative hair. It has large teeth and is dangerous to approach.

01900168.name: Wild Boar Map
01900168.description: Land at the Baltic Sea North. Near the table boulder to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Wild Boar
discovery.description: An animal with short, sharp fangs and a short, plump body. It's ferocious and has no qualms about attacking humans. It's likely the ancestor of today's pig.

01900169.name: Large Deer Map
01900169.description: Land at the Scandinavia West Coast. Near the pointed boulder to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Reindeer
discovery.description: A large deer found in cold climates. The males have huge antlers. Some are even kept as cattle.

01900170.name: Humpback Animal Map
01900170.description: Land at the Egypt North Coast. Just north of the oasis in the central area.

discovery.name: Dromedary
discovery.description: A camel with one hump. It is domesticated, and used to carry passengers and transport goods and so on. An important animal in desert regions.

01900171.name: Water Buffaloes Map
01900171.description: Outside the gates of Calicut, near the swamp on the northeast.

discovery.name: Water Buffalo
discovery.description: A cow with huge horns growing out of the right and left of its head. It lives on the waterfront. While some live in small groups, others gather together in larger groups of more than 1000. These larger groups are usually made up of females and their offspring.

01900172.name: Herds of Cattle Map
01900172.description: Land at the Africa Southeast Coast. The southwestern corner.

discovery.name: Wildebeest
discovery.description: An animal like a cow that lives throughout Africa. They are known to travel over vast stretches of terrain, and when they migrate many herds join together until their numbers reach the hundreds of thousands.

01900173.name: Large Horn Animal Map
01900173.description: Land at the Africa South-Southeast Coast. The northwestern corner.

discovery.name: Rhinoceros
discovery.description: A large herbivore with a horn on its snout. This animal can grow to up to 4m. Some of them live in groups while others prefer a solitary existence.

01900174.name: Poisonous Fish Map
01900174.description: On the sea around the island east of Aden.

discovery.name: Striped Catfish Eel
discovery.description: A sea fish similar to a loach or a catfish. Its back is covered in venomous spines. It can cause serious problems if touched carelessly while out fishing. The young fish are more dangerous than the adults as they live in groups.

01900175.name: Area Rich in Corals Map
01900175.description: On the sea northwest of Candia.

discovery.name: Coral
discovery.description: A beautiful creature found throughout tropical seas. At first glance you might think it's a plant, but if you look closer you will see that it's actually made up of many tiny sea anemones. Locals say it grows very quickly.

01900176.name: Shiny Shellfish Map
01900176.description: On the sea east-northeast of Mombasa.

discovery.name: Cowrie
discovery.description: A shellfish with a wonderful sheen that was used instead of money in ancient times. It can often be found in warm seas.

01900177.name: Colourful Fish Map
01900177.description: On the sea southwest of Goa.

discovery.name: Oriental Butterfly Fish
discovery.description: A beautifully coloured fish found in tropical seas. It has a flat body and pointed mouth. There are many different colours and designs to be found.

01900178.name: Thorny Fish Map
01900178.description: On the sea east-southeast of Syracuse.

discovery.name: Porcupine Fish
discovery.description: This fish puffs itself up and sticks out its needles when it feels any pressing danger. It may be a type of blowfish. Often found in warm seas.

01900179.name: Jumping Fish Map
01900179.description: On the sea north of Casablanca.

discovery.name: Dolphin
discovery.description: A large fish often spotted in warm water. For some reason it can't actually breathe under water. Instead, it breathes through a hole on its back...it may not be a fish after all...

01900180.name: Poisonous Fish Map
01900180.description: On the sea southwest of Cochin.

discovery.name: Lionfish
discovery.description: A fish with a fan-like fin usually seen in warm seas. The back fin and pectoral fins are exceptionally large. The tips of the fins contain venomous spines, that could kill you if they sting you.

01900181.name: Poisonous Clams Map
01900181.description: The most southerly point of the island chain, south-southwest of Cochin.

discovery.name: Cone Shell
discovery.description: At first glance it appears to be just a sea snail, but is in fact poisonous. It fires venomous spines into unsuspecting fish that swim to close, killing and eating them. Its sting is fatal to many humans.

01900183.name: Large Shellfish Map
01900183.description: On the sea around the island chain south-southwest of Cochin.

discovery.name: Triton's Trumpet
discovery.description: A large sea snail that can grow larger than 40cm. In India and the Orient, they use this shell as a whistle. Apparently it emits a deep, booming sound that can be heard far and wide.

01900184.name: Spooky Fish Map
01900184.description: On the sea west of Lisbon.

discovery.name: Monkfish
discovery.description: A large fish that lives in the ocean's depths. It has a huge, flat mouth, and lures in its prey using a projection that sticks out of the top of its head and dangles down in front of its mouth, very much like a fishing line.

01900185.name: Spooky Fish Map
01900185.description: On the sea far south of Cochin.

discovery.name: Pelican Eel
discovery.description: An odd looking fish that lives in the deep sea. It has a long, slender body like a snake, and an unbelievably large mouth. The tip of its tail appears to emit a glow.

01900186.name: Unfinished Map
01900186.description: The small island southwest of Syracuse.

discovery.name: The Island of Malta
discovery.description: An island to the south of the Italian peninsula and Sicily. Due to its location between Italy and North Africa, the controlling power has often changed. The island has been inhabited since prehistoric times.

discovery.name: Cape Roca
discovery.description: A cape to the north of Lisbon and the westernmost point of the Iberian Peninsula. After leaving Lisbon, and rounding this cape, you come to Porto.

01900188.name: Unfinished Map
01900188.description: The strait south of the island where Calvi is located.

discovery.name: The Strait of Bonifacio
discovery.description: A strait south of Genoa between the islands of Corsica and Sardinia. When heading from Naples to Barcelona, it may be quicker to pass through this strait.

discovery.name: The Island of Sao Tome
discovery.description: An island in the Gulf of Guinea in central West Africa. The island is near the equator, giving it a tropical, rainforest climate.

01900190.name: Unfinished Map
01900190.description: The river that flows into the sea near Cairo.

discovery.name: The River Nile
discovery.description: A large river flowing through Africa and on into the Mediterranean sea. At the same time every year it causes a catastrophic flood, but through this, fertile soil is brought to the banks of the river. It's extremely long making it almost impossible to pin point the river's source.

01900191.name: Unfinished Map
01900191.description: The island where Famagusta is located.

discovery.name: Cyprus
discovery.description: A huge island in the eastern Mediterranean sea. It is known as Kypros in Greek and Kibris in Turkish. Civilization has prospered here since prehistoric times, and due to its geographic location it has been ruled by various powers.

01900192.name: Unfinished Map
01900192.description: The river mouth northwest of Cape.

archives.location: Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea
Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea
Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea

discovery.name: The Orange River
discovery.description: A large river that flows from east to west in southern Africa. Apparently the watershed contains an abundance of ore deposits, but with a huge waterfall right in the middle, water transportation is very difficult.

discovery.name: Socotra
discovery.description: An island to the east of Aden. It has an ancient history and holds important military value.

01900194.name: Unfinished Map
01900194.description: The strait between Ceylon and India.

discovery.name: The Palk Strait
discovery.description: A strait between Ceylon and India. Because Ceylon has many special products and trade has prospered, this strait sees a lot of ships coming and going.

01900195.name: Unfinished Map
01900195.description: The archipelago far east of the island of Ceylon.

discovery.name: The Andaman Island
discovery.description: Islands aligned in almost a straight line on the east of the Bay of Bengal. The indigenous people are around 140cm tall, and appear to be primarily hunter gatherers. Details are few though as they avoid contact with outsiders.

01900196.name: Unfinished Map
01900196.description: The island near the tip of the peninsula, far west of Jamaica.

discovery.name: The Island of Cozumel
discovery.description: An island located to the west in the Caribbean Sea. This island has some beautiful coral reefs, and tropical fish can be seen everywhere. The sea is so clear, you can see down to 30m. It is like paradise on earth.

01900197.name: Unfinished Map
01900197.description: The island far west-northwest of Havana.

discovery.name: The Pine Islands
discovery.description: Islands running east to west to the north of Cuba. The sea is shallow and filled with beautiful coral; the climate is warm throughout the year. It is said that the beautiful white sands came from the crushed coral.

01900198.name: Ancient Tools Map
01900198.description: Land at the Bay of Biscay South Coast. A short walk to the South.

discovery.name: Ancient Millstones
discovery.description: A stone mortar made for milling grains and beans into powder form. In this form, they are easier to store and cook. They have been found at historical sites around the world.

01900398.name: Religious Painting Map
01900398.description: Inside the church in Genoa. By the wall on the right in the back.

discovery.name: The Annunciation
discovery.description: A painting by Leonardo Da Vinci. Painted using perspective but there are places where it goes astray, such as Mary's right hand. This may have been deliberate. The flowers on the ground are drawn in great detail, and the angel's wings show anatomical research into birds' feathers.

01900399.name: Religious Painting Map
01900399.description: Inside the church in Naples. By the wall on the right near the entrance.

discovery.name: Mary, Child, Young John
discovery.description: A painting by Raphael. It differs from Raphael's previous works on the Virgin, in that in this one she is bursting with life. There is a rumour that the model was his lover, Margherita.

01900400.name: Religious Painting Map
01900400.description: Inside the church located in the western area of Marseille. By the wall on the left near the entrance.

discovery.name: St. John the Baptist
discovery.description: A painting of John the Baptist by Leonardo Da Vinci. It is thought that pointing towards heaven is an allusion to salvation through baptism. He has a mysterious and enigmatic smile.

01900401.name: Landscapes Map
01900401.description: The tavern in Gijon. Near the fireplace in the back.

discovery.name: The View of Toledo
discovery.description: A landscape by El Greco. Landscape paintings of the time were not valued, but it is clear to all that this is a magnificent painting. This painting was not commissioned, but rather was done of the painter's own volition. It is dark, yet bright, and altogether mysterious.

01900402.name: Map of Man's Figure
01900402.description: Inside the church in Naples. By the wall on the left near the entrance.

discovery.name: Moses
discovery.description: A marble statue by Michelangelo. One of the statues created for the grave of Julius II. He holds the slate bearing the Ten Commandments, and gazes into the distance with a tense expression.

01900403.name: Mid Size Monkey Map
01900403.description: Land at the Atlantic Ocean Central West Coast. Near the giant dead tree to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Chimpanzee
discovery.description: A black monkey that is generally smaller than humans. They live in packs and are very intelligent. There are even a few that can use tools. It is thought they are near relatives to humans.

01900404.name: Long Neck Animal Map
01900404.description: Land at the Africa North Gulf of Guinea. At the northern edge.

discovery.name: Giraffe
discovery.description: A tall animal that lives in the Savanna zone of Africa. It has a very long neck and reaches a height of over 5m. It eats leaves from high branches that other animals cannot reach. Its body is covered in a unique pattern and it has two short horns on its head.

01900405.name: Sea Turtles Map
01900405.description: On the sea northwest of Calicut.

discovery.name: Hawksbill Turtle
discovery.description: A small sea turtle. Its upper beak is curved like that of a hawk. It's said they use the shell for craftwork in the Orient.

01900408.description: Land at the Persian Gulf North Coast. Head South.

01900409.name: Bear's Hat Map
01900409.description: Outside the southern gates of Pondicherry towards southeast.

01900424.description: Map indicating the location of treasure hidden east of Havana.

01900428.description: Chart showing the location of the ship sunk by pirates in the Baltic Sea.

01900429.name: Croc-like Bone Map
01900429.description: Land at the Amazon River Upstream. North of the diagonal boulder to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Giant Crocodile like Bones
discovery.description: Bones from a giant animal something like a crocodile, well over 10 meters long. It was found in the Amazon. The forest land that stretches out far and wide might have been under water long ago.

01900430.name: Lizard Bone Map
01900430.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Head Northwest. Near the large boulder.

archives.discovery: Bones of a Long Necked Lizard

discovery.name: Bones of a Long Necked Lizard
discovery.description: Bones from a giant, long-neck lizard. It's over 10 meters long. About the time that this animal was alive, there must have been many other large lizards walking around as well.

01900431.name: Fish Stone Map
01900431.description: Land at the South America Northeast Coast. Head Southeast from the giant dead tree in the central area.

discovery.name: Giant Fish Shaped Stone
discovery.description: A stone shaped something like a fish. You can make out what looks like a fin, but it gives an impression that it is somehow different from fish today. I wonder if all fish looked like this during the time of this fish.

01900432.name: Beast's Bone Map
01900432.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Near the red flowers to the Northwest.

archives.discovery: Bones of a Giant Clawed Beast

discovery.name: Bones of a Giant Clawed Beast
discovery.description: Bones of a large, taloned animal. The shape resembles that of a bear but it's size is much larger than any bear alive today. It makes you wonder how terrifying that animal really was.

01900433.name: Lizard Bone Map
01900433.description: Land at the South America Northeast Coast. Head Northeast from the red flowers to the Southwest.

archives.discovery: The Bones of a Lizard like Bird

discovery.name: The Bones of a Lizard like Bird
discovery.description: Overall its shape resembles that of a lizard, but its head is narrow like a bird's beak. Also, there is no evidence of wings. It appears to be somewhere between a bird and a lizard.

01900435.name: Crafted Flower Map
01900435.description: Land at the South America Northeast Coast. To the Northwest.

discovery.name: Ice Blue
discovery.description: A plant with a white bract containing a lot of blue on a cylindrical column; it's beautiful like a work of art. It grows to a height of approximately 1 meter.

01900436.name: Violet Flower Map
01900436.description: Outside the southern gates of Vera Cruz south from the gates.

discovery.name: Cattleyas
discovery.description: Flower petals of differing shapes radiate outward from the centre of the dark-coloured tubular flower petals. They are bright, and very beautiful.

01900437.name: Red Leaved Plant Map
01900437.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. To the West.

discovery.name: Poinsettias
discovery.description: The red leaves are a type of bract and have small yellow flowers in their center. This plant is known more for its leaves than its flowers.

01900438.name: Yellow Flower Map
01900438.description: Outside the gates of Merida northwest from the gates.

discovery.name: Marigolds
discovery.description: This blooms with strongly fragrant, yellow flowers. The refreshing flowers are often used as a die.

01900439.name: Large Red Flower Map
01900439.description: Outside the gates of Merida west from the gates.

discovery.name: Dahlias
discovery.description: Yellow, tube-shaped flowers appear in the centre of the petals that have several layers. The larger ones can be over 20 cm tall.

01900440.name: Horned Insects Map
01900440.description: Outside the gates of Merida south from the gates.

discovery.name: Treehopper
discovery.description: The large, square projections on the top of this insect are hard enough to puncture skin. Ants are known to protect treehopper eggs in exchange for honey.

01900441.name: Giant Spider Map
01900441.description: Land at the South America North Coast Plateau. To the Southeast.

discovery.name: Tarantula
discovery.description: A giant spider growing red and black hair. To protect itself from predators, the bristly hair over its stomach stands on end.

01900442.name: Long-leg Insects Map
01900442.description: Land at the South America North Coast Plateau. To the Southeast.

discovery.name: Rhinoceros Beetle
discovery.description: This insect has upper and lower pairs of long horns, and extremely long front legs. When fighting for food, it uses these long front legs to turn its opponent around and run it off.

01900443.name: White Butterfly Map
01900443.description: Outside the gates of Merida southwest from the gates.

discovery.name: White Angled-Sulphur
discovery.description: The bright yellowish front wings are truly beautiful. Also, there is one black patch outlined in yellow on each of the white wings.

01900444.name: Spotted Butterfly Map
01900444.description: Land at South America Northeast Coast. Near the red flowers to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Queen Cracker
discovery.description: This has light-blue patch patterns over deep and rich blue on its wings. This insect emits a clicking sound when it flies.

01900445.name: Rare-spotted Butterfly Map
01900445.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. On the trail stretching from the central area to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Callicore
discovery.description: There is a spiral pattern that looks like a number on the back side of its wings. Its colouring varies with reds and light blues.

01900446.name: Long Leg Animals Map
01900446.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Near the red flowers to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Rare
discovery.description: A large bird resembling an ostrich. This particular bird is unable to fly, and lives in the grasslands and brush-lands, and eats leaves and seeds from plant life.

01900447.name: Birds with Fans Map
01900447.description: Land at the Amazon River Upstream. In the central area.

discovery.name: Hawk Headed Parrot
discovery.description: A bird that lives in tropical forests. When excited or surprised, this bird raises the feathers over its entire head upward into a fan shape.

01900448.name: 7 Coloured Bird Map
01900448.description: Land at the South America Northeast Coast. Near the red flowers to the Southwest.

discovery.name: Rainbow Macaw
discovery.description: Its head and neck are yellow, but its color changes to orange closer to the chest. Its back is green. Its wings and narrow, pointed tail have various colours. It generally lives in groups of more than a dozen.

01900449.name: Marsupial Animals Map
01900449.description: Outside the southeast gates of Vera Cruz, northeast from the gates.

discovery.name: Opossum
discovery.description: This animal has a pouch in its stomach for raising its young. It looks like a mouse, and hangs in trees using its hairless tail. If it feels danger, it plays dead.

01900450.name: Red Tortoise Map
01900450.description: Land at the South America Northeast Coast. Near the giant dead tree in the central area.

discovery.name: Red-footed Tortoise
discovery.description: This turtle has red patches on its chest. It prefers humid environments and eats tree leaves and fruit. When it grows, the centre of the shell becomes constricted.

01900451.name: Horned Frogs Map
01900451.description: Land at the Amazon River Upstream. To the Northeast.

discovery.name: Horned Frog
discovery.description: This frog has horn-shaped projections above its wide mouth and eyes. It buries part of its body to wait for its prey. During mating season, the males will try to find a mate with their cow-like cry.

01900452.name: Rodent-like Animal Map
01900452.description: Land at the Amazon River Upstream. Head Southeast from the central area.

discovery.name: Capybara
discovery.description: An animal like a giant rat. It lives in forests near lakes and rivers. It acts in groups to protect itself from enemies.

01900453.name: Large Weasel Map
01900453.description: Land at the Amazon River Upstream. Near the giant dead tree on the way to the central area.

discovery.name: Giant Otter
discovery.description: A large mink that lives in the Amazon river region. It can grow to 1.5 meters long, and eats fish and crabs.

01900454.name: Red Eyed Frogs Map
01900454.description: Outside the southeast gates of Vera Cruz North from the gates.

discovery.name: Red-eyed Tree Frog
discovery.description: This amphibian has large red eyes, a green body and blue and white pin stripes under its limbs. To hide such a brightly coloured body, it rests by folding its limbs on leaves.

01900455.name: River Dolphins Map
01900455.description: A map that shows a dolphin habitat in the Amazon River.

discovery.name: Amazon River Dolphin
discovery.description: A porpoise that lives in the Amazon river. Its body has patches of pink and grey and it sports a long, hairy snout. It eats crabs and turtles.

01900456.name: Lynx Cats Map
01900456.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. Near the stacked boulders to the North.

discovery.name: Bobcat
discovery.description: A kind of mountain cat. It has a striped and spotted design and is not very large. It has characteristic long hair on its cheeks and a short tail.

01900457.name: Jerboa Map
01900457.description: Outside the gates of Merida south from the gates.

discovery.name: Kangaroo Rat
discovery.description: A rat that can use its overly developed hind legs to jump. For a rat, its pretty big.

01900458.name: Long Limb Monkey Map
01900458.description: Land at the South America Northeast Coast. Head Southeast.

discovery.name: Spider Monkeys
discovery.description: A monkey with a black body, and very long hands, feet, and tail. When it leaps from tree to tree using its hands, feet, and tail it looks like a huge spider. Although its hands look like a humans and are just as dexterous, this monkey doesn't have any thumbs.

01900459.name: Mesoamerican Vessel Map
01900459.description: Outside the gates of Vera Cruz (south) near the table rock south from the gates.

discovery.name: Tetrapod Vessel
discovery.description: A bowl-shaped container with four legs. It has a lid like the head of a dog. The dog is thought to have been a companion to Mayan kings making their journey to the afterlife.

01900460.name: Mesoamerican Vessel Map
01900460.description: Outside the gates of Vera Cruz (south) southwest from the gates.

discovery.name: Tripod Vessel
discovery.description: A cylindrical container with three legs. Most are made from earthenware or porcelain. None are made from metal. Many are made with intricate engravings.

01900461.name: Mesoamerican Cup Map
01900461.description: Outside the gate of Merida. Near the stacked boulders to the West.

discovery.name: Jade Bowl
discovery.description: A large cup made from jade. The ability to make such a large cup must have meant that jade was richly available.

01900462.name: Sports Accessories Map
01900462.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. Near the stacked boulders to the South.

discovery.name: Acha
discovery.description: A rock with its surface covered in pigment. It was apparently used in the ancient game of Tlachtli."

01900463.name: Strange Lump Map
01900463.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. Near the stacked boulders to the South.

discovery.name: Rubber Ball
discovery.description: A rubber ball used in the ancient ball game Tlachtli. Tlachtli was played with protective gear since the ball was extremely heavy and injury could result if playing unprotected.

01900464.name: Mesoamerican Pot Map
01900464.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. Near the halfway point of the trail, to the South.

discovery.name: Nonstriated Pot
discovery.description: A pot without any markings. Most of the pots found in Azteca are earthenware.

01900465.name: Mesoamerican Pot Map
01900465.description: Land at the South America Northeast Coast. To the Northeast.

discovery.name: Relief Decorated Pot
discovery.description: A wide-mouthed pot with a relief drawn on it. It is made out of earthenware. This picture may tell some kind of story.

01900466.name: Sports Equipment Map
01900466.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. Head West. Near the pointed boulder.

discovery.name: Yoke
discovery.description: Protective gear used in the ancient ball game of Tlachtli. Tlachtli was performed sometimes as an act of war or as a prayer dance to the gods.

01900467.name: Mesoamerican Clay Pot Map
01900467.description: Land at the South America Northeast Coast. To the Northwest.

discovery.name: White Patterned Earthenware
discovery.description: Geometric patterns are added to white earthenware pots. This white colour may have been made by mixing quartz.

01900468.name: Mesoamerican Relics Map
01900468.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. To the Southwest.

discovery.name: Incense Burner
discovery.description: An earthenware incense burner found in the Aztec land. Perhaps it was used as a shrine accessory.

01900469.name: Mesoamerican Clay Pot Map
01900469.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. On the trail stretching from the central area to the Southwest.

discovery.name: Decorated Earthenware
discovery.description: An earthenware item painted with various coloured pigments. The people who made it must have possessed extremely advanced technology.

01900470.name: Mesoamerican Sculpture Map
01900470.description: Land at the South America Northeast Coast. Head Southeast from the central area.

discovery.name: Clay Work Statue
discovery.description: A detailed clay statue found in the western part of the Maya region. Many types exist. Perhaps they depict various gods?

01900471.name: Mesoamerican Sculpture Map
01900471.description: Interior Yucatan peninsula on the outskirts of Merida, near the relics.

discovery.name: The Statue of Kukulkan
discovery.description: Kukulcan was the Mayan name for the Aztec God Quetzalcoatl. Also called Kukumatz by people of the highlands. He was a god who was especially revered at Chichen Itza.

01900472.name: Ceremonial Tools Map
01900472.description: Outside the gates of Merida near the flowers on the west.

discovery.name: Cylindrical Ceremonial Cup
discovery.description: A richly decorated and coloured cylindrical cup. Thought to have been presented by nobility or kings for ceremonies.

01900473.name: Mesoamerican Sculpture Map
01900473.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. Head Southeast from the central area.

discovery.name: The Statue of Huitzilopochtli
discovery.description: The Aztec god of war, also the sun god. This god appears in the East and sinks into the evening darkness in the West, only to again reawaken in the East. The movement of the sun is actually the movement of this god According to myth.

01900474.name: Mesoamerican Sculpture Map
01900474.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. Near the stacked boulders to the Southeast.

discovery.name: The Statue of Xiuhcoatl
discovery.description: The fire serpent god from Aztec mythology. According to the Aztec calendar, it is responsible for carrying the sun up from sunrise to the top of the sky.

01900475.name: Strange Skull Map
01900475.description: Interior Yucatan peninsula on the outskirts of Merida, near the building on the northern tip.

discovery.name: Decorated Skull
discovery.description: A beautifully adorned skull found in Mesoamerica. Abundant turquoise is used in the decorations. It seems as if the entire surface was originally covered.

01900476.name: Mesoamerica Ceremonial Vessel Map
01900476.description: Outside the gates of Vera Cruz (south), near the layered rocks on the south.

discovery.name: The Mesoamerican Ritual Utensil
discovery.description: A ceremonial earthenware vessel. In Mesoamerican beliefs, prayers and ceremonies are highly honoured and many such ceremonial vessels can be found.

01900477.name: Mesoamerica Ceremonial Vessel Map
01900477.description: Outside the gates of Vera Cruz (south), near the table rock on the south.

discovery.name: The Mosaic Disk
discovery.description: A mosaic disk made from turquoise. It was made using extremely advanced techniques. Turquoise seems to have been used in ceremonies in Azteca for its sacred colour.

01900478.name: Aztec Warrior Spear Map
01900478.description: Tenochtitlan, the inland of Southeast Veracruz. Head to the back, on the right.

discovery.name: The Spear of Cuauhtemoc
discovery.description: This is said to be a spear owned by Cuauhtemoc, the nephew of the emperor Moctezuma of the Aztec empire. As a falcon warrior, he was always noble on the battlefield.

01900479.name: Goldwork Map
01900479.description: Outside the gates of Vera Cruz (south), towards the southern tip.

discovery.name: The Earring of Mixtec
discovery.description: Gold earrings worn by the Mixtec people said to have existed in the heart of central America. They had a very high gold processing technology that was as good as any in Europe. I'll bet it was someone from the royal family that could wear something so precious.

01900480.name: Unfinished Map
01900480.description: The gulf in front of Veracruz.

discovery.name: The Bay of Campeche
