discovery.description: The sea bordered by the Yucatan peninsula and the continent. Known from antiquity as a good, natural port, the people living in the New World and the Spanish have contested over its maritime control for a long time.

01900481.name: Unfinished Map
01900481.description: The river that flows north of Portobelo.

discovery.name: The Co Co River
discovery.description: The river flowing to the peninsula south of the Yucatan peninsula. It is said that when Admiral Colon reached this land, he landed at the mouth of this river.

discovery.name: Punta Gallinas
discovery.description: The cape at the leading edge of the peninsula that projects into the west coast of the Venezuelan bay. In recent years, more and more Europeans are settling here.

01900483.name: Unfinished Map
01900483.description: The gulf in front of San Antonio.

discovery.name: The Gulf of San Matias
discovery.description: A bay at the southeast coast of South America. The sea currents flowing nearby are cold, making this a comparatively cold region. To the north flows a mysterious river whose waters are black.

01900484.name: Unfinished Map
01900484.description: The gulf southwest of San Antonio.

discovery.name: The Gulf of San Jorge
discovery.description: A semi-circular bay at the southeast coast of South America. The air temperature remains low all year long because of the nearby cold currents and the strong winds blowing from the west. On land spreads an inhospitable, low-temperature region.

01900485.name: Unfinished Map
01900485.description: The peninsula south of San Antonio.

discovery.name: The Valdes Peninsula
discovery.description: A peninsula projecting into the Atlantic from the south of South America. You can find sea lions on the coast and whales on the South Atlantic side; it is truly a paradise for life.

01900486.name: Unfinished Map
01900486.description: The mountain range on the coast south of Rio de Janeiro.

discovery.name: Serra do Mar
discovery.description: A mountain range on the east coast in the south of South America. It stands majestically, blocking the winds from the sea.

01900487.name: Bandits Notes
01900487.description: Outside the gates of Gia Dinh, near the giant dead tree to the west.

01900489.name: Nobleman's Attire Map
01900489.description: Outside the gates of Gia Dinh, near the giant dead tree to the west.

01900490.name: Bandits Notes
01900490.description: Outside the gates of Gia dinh, northwest from the gates.

01900491.name: Female Warrior Dress Map
01900491.description: Outside the gates of Gia dinh, northwest from the gates.

01900492.name: Female Warrior Dress Map
01900492.description: Outside the gates of Gia dinh, northwest from the gates.

01900494.name: Bandits Notes
01900494.description: Land at the Island of Java North Coast. Near the ruins to the Northwest.

01900495.name: Bandits Notes
01900495.description: Outside the gates of Pegu, near the giant dead tree.

01900496.name: Nobleman's Hat Map
01900496.description: Outside the gates of Pegu, near the giant dead tree.

01900497.name: Nobleman's Hat Map
01900497.description: Outside the gates of Pegu, near the giant dead tree.

discovery.name: The Sunda Strait
discovery.description: The strait passing between the island of Sumatra and Java. The sea lane is very narrow, so sailing it is extremely difficult. Small islands, including volcanic islands, are numerous in the vicinity.

discovery.name: The Java Sea
discovery.description: The sea spreading out between the Java and Borneo islands. It has shoals and is a good fishing ground, so many of the local fishing vessels sail the area. The small islands in the Java sea are generally low lying, and there are many salt fields.

discovery.name: The Karimata Strait
discovery.description: The strait stretching west of Borneo. There are shoals but the waves are tranquil. In recent years, there have been many reports of pirates lurking in the area.

discovery.name: The Makassar Strait
discovery.description: The strait passing between Borneo and Celebes. It has been an important point of trade since ancient times. Makassar has a particularly enormous bay, so it has prospered as a base for trade.

discovery.name: The Banda Sea
discovery.description: The sea southeast of Celebes Island. It is said that there are more than 200 small islands in the area. One of these islands may hold the source of those treasured spices.

01900503.name: Unfinished Map
01900503.description: The bay at the western edge of the island, east of Run.

discovery.name: Berau Bay
discovery.description: A narrow bay sandwiched between two land projections shaped like a bird's beak. Innumerable islands can be seen to the west.

01900504.name: Unfinished Map
01900504.description: The gulf located at the northwestern part of the island east of Run.

discovery.name: Cenderawasih Bay
discovery.description: A bay to the southeast of New Guinea. There is an island in a position like a lid. In that area sailors must be constantly vigilant against pirate attacks.

discovery.name: Bangka Island
discovery.description: An island positioned east of the Strait of Malacca. As with other islands in this area of the sea, beautiful coral reefs expand to envelop the island.

01900506.name: Small Flower Map
01900506.description: Outside the gates of Gia dinh, near the giant dead tree on the northwest.

discovery.name: Torenias
discovery.description: A small flower whose diameter is only 2 cm. It has petals that cover the centre. There are a variety of colours, such as powder blue, pink, and yellow.

01900507.name: Horned Insects Map
01900507.description: Outside the gates of Gia dinh, near the red flower on the northwest.

discovery.name: Five Horned Beetle
discovery.description: The insect has one long horn growing out, and four short horns. It has a long trunk, and the wings have a brownish colour.

01900508.name: Scissor Hand Insect Map
01900508.description: Land at the Island of Java, North Coast. Head South. Near the diagonal boulder.

discovery.name: Giraffe Stag Beetle
discovery.description: A large insect that can grow to exceed 10 cm. The long scissors on the head are powerful and are used to intimidate and attack its enemies.

discovery.name: Giant Cicada
discovery.description: The highest class of cicada that can grown up to 10 cm, and when its wings are spread, can be as big as 20 cm.

01900510.name: Strange Lizard Map
01900510.description: Outside the gates of Pegu, near the giant dead tree on the east.

discovery.name: Tokay Gecko
discovery.description: A lizard with a blue body and orange spotted patterns. Its call sounds like Tokkei. It eats tree insects and mice.

01900511.name: Jumping Frog Map
01900511.description: Land at the Island of Celebes East Coast. Near the pointed boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: Flying Frog
discovery.description: Different from other frogs, this one has webs on its front feet, too. With them, it is able to glide quite a long distance when it jumps from the top of a tree. It has four long legs, and is adapted perfectly to climbing trees.

01900512.name: Long Hand Animal Map
01900512.description: Outside the gates of Gia dinh, northwest from the gates.

discovery.name: Gibbon
discovery.description: A monkey that lives primarily in the trees. Its large hands grasp branches so it can swing from place to place using its body like a pendulum. It eats fruit.

01900513.name: Cow-like Animals Map
01900513.description: Land at the Island of Java North Coast. Near the ruins to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Banteng
discovery.description: A cow over 2 meters long. It comes in various colours, like white and brown and male horns can grow as long as 70 cm. It is also raised as livestock.

01900514.name: Box-like Fish Map
01900514.description: On the sea north of Jakarta. Between two islands.

discovery.name: Long Horned Cowfish
discovery.description: This fish's body is angular and shaped like a box. It has small projections above its eyes. It blows water into the sand on the sea floor to chase out prey for food.

01900515.name: Ancient Settlement Map
01900515.description: Outside the gates of Gia dinh, near the large rock on the northwest.

discovery.name: The Ancient Rice Paddies
discovery.description: Many rivers with large volumes of water flow along the coast of the Indo-China peninsula, making this a region perfect for growing rice since ancient times. It is not possible to identify the time period, but we might be able to tell when people began living in this region.

01900516.name: Ancient Codes Map
01900516.description: Outside the gates of Pegu, near the giant dead tree.

discovery.name: Wagaru Dhammath
discovery.description: The oldest laws of Indo-China, compiled by King Wareru of the Pegu dynasty. The writings are organized in an extremely easy to understand manner, and still have affect today.

01900517.name: Ancient Clay Pot Map
01900517.description: Outside the gates of Gia dinh, near the red flower.

discovery.name: Patterned Water Jar
discovery.description: There is a lot of earthenware to be found inland on the Indo-China peninsula. Earthenware has been very common since ancient times. This one has a smooth shape and is not only a superior work of art, it is very easy to use as a tool for daily use.

01900518.name: Mesoamerican Relics Map
01900518.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. Head Southwest. Near the pointed boulder.

discovery.name: Teotihuacan Tomb Furnishings
discovery.description: A burial item of the Teotihuacan civilization that flourished in the central highlands of Mexico. Because similar burial goods are found in the Mayan and Aztecan regions as well, it is thought that they were greatly influenced by this area in ancient times.

01900519.name: Old Codes Map
01900519.description: In the town of Lop Buri. Near the tavern.

discovery.name: The Middle Way
discovery.description: A work by Nagarjuna. It describes the path of Buddhism. Rather than a general treatise of Buddhist faith, it is full of poetry. It has tremendous value as an artistic work.

01900520.name: Old Codes Map
01900520.description: Outside the gates of Pegu, east from the gates.

discovery.name: The Flower Adornment Sutra
discovery.description: One of the Buddhist scriptures. It is written about the world of enlightenment seen by Buddha.

01900521.name: Old Codes Map
01900521.description: Outside of the gate of Gia Dinh, the Siem Reap Outskirts. To the Northwest.

discovery.name: The Vimalakirti Sutra
discovery.description: One of the Buddhist scriptures. Much of the content is similar to the Prajnaparamita, but it is composed of stories such as the way to ultimate enlightenment through the conversations between Vilmalakirti and Manjusri.

01900522.name: Old Codes Map
01900522.description: Land at the Island of Java North Coast. Proceed inland to the Java Island Interior. To the Northwest.

discovery.name: The Lotus Sutra
discovery.description: One of the Buddhist scriptures. It teaches that everything comes through karma, and it described unique causal relationships with Buddhism itself.

01900523.name: Religious Painting Map
01900523.description: Inside the church in Antwerp. By the wall on the left in the back.

discovery.name: St.Veronica
discovery.description: A piece by Roberto Campin. He was one of the first painters to use oil-based colours. This work shows Saint Veronica wiping the face of Jesus and the image of Jesus appearing on the cloth.

01900524.name: Small Flower Map
01900524.description: Land at the Island of Java, North Coast. Head South.

discovery.name: Aerides
discovery.description: A plant with a hanging stem and small grain like flowers attached. The flowers come in pink, white, and yellow. They give off a powerful aroma.

01900525.name: Spotted Butterfly Map
01900525.description: Outside the gates of Brunei, west from the gates.

discovery.name: Idea Lynceus
discovery.description: A beautiful butterfly, which is large and flies in an elegant manner. It lives near water in forests.

01900526.name: Large Butterfly Map
01900526.description: Outside the gates of Brunei, near the red flower on the south.

discovery.name: Common Green Birdwing
discovery.description: A butterfly with wings sporting large, black patterns with golden edges. When it spreads its wings, it can be as large as an adult's palm.

01900527.name: Black Bird Map
01900527.description: Land at the Island of Celebes East Coast. Head Northwest.

discovery.name: Palm Cockatoo
discovery.description: This bird lives in tropical rain forests and open forests. They are covered in black feathers. You can see red skin on the cheeks. The top of the head has a long crest. It has a long, strong beak and is able to crack the hard shells of palm fruit for food.

01900528.name: Wild Dogs Map
01900528.description: Outside the gates of Pegu, near the red flowers on the north.

discovery.name: Dhole
discovery.description: They live in troupes of about 10 in forests and grasslands. They track their prey by sense of smell and capture and eat wild hogs and antelope.

01900529.name: Wild Deer Map
01900529.description: Land at the Island of Sumatra Southwest Coast. Head West from the central area. Near the water.

discovery.name: Sambar Deer
discovery.description: A deer with a dark brown coat of fur. Males have antlers that branch into three sections that are one meter long. They are nocturnal and eat a variety of plants.

01900531.name: Unfinished Map
01900531.description: The sea region south of Makassar.

discovery.name: The Flores Sea
discovery.description: The sea spreading south of Celebes. The waters are warm, and the waters have a high salinity, which has given birth to many unique forms of marine life. There are many unusual and intriguing animals on the small islands in the region.

01900532.name: Unfinished Map
01900532.description: The sea east-southeast of the island where Dili is located.

discovery.name: The Arafura Sea
discovery.description: The shallow sea located southwest of New Guinea. They say that if you head south from this sea, you will encounter a very large land mass.

01900533.name: Pirates Notes
01900533.description: Map indicating the location of treasure hidden by pirates east of Havana.

01900534.name: Pirates Notes
01900534.description: Map indicating the location of treasure hidden by pirates east of Havana.

01900535.name: Unfinished Map
01900535.description: Land at the Colorado Plateau. Near the pointed boulder to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Balance Rock
discovery.description: A large boulder in the inlands of western North America. Most likely due to erosion after many years, it appears unstable but it still stands.

01900536.name: Unfinished Map
01900536.description: The bay at the northern edge of the island where Wanganui is located.

discovery.name: The Bay of Plenty
discovery.description: The bay at the north of Aotearoa. It has capes on both the east and west. The waves are quiet, and there is an abundant amount of fish to be caught.

discovery.name: The Tasman Sea
discovery.description: The sea across the southeast of Australia. There are warm currents nearby, so it's a pleasant temperature on the coast, but it is very windy.

discovery.name: Tiwi
discovery.description: An island in the northern part of Australia. After passing Van Diemen's bay, you come to Amhem Land. Melville island to the east and Bathurst island to the west are collectively known as Tiwi. The Tiwi people live there and protect their unique culture.

01900541.name: Unfinished Map
01900541.description: The island located in the western part of the gulf, east of Kakadu.

discovery.name: Groote Eylandt
discovery.description: An island north of Australia. In Dutch, it means large island. As suggested by its name, this is the largest island in the Gulf of Carpentaria.

01900542.name: Unfinished Map
01900542.description: The island located in the eastern part of the gulf, east of Kakadu.

discovery.name: Mornington Island
discovery.description: An island at the far south of the Gulf of Carpentaria, northeast of Australia. There are also inlets to several mid-sized rivers in the south making it a good fishing spot.

01900543.name: Unfinished Map
01900543.description: The frozen valley, north of Bergen.

discovery.name: Glacier
discovery.description: Glaciers are formed out of snow that accumulates between mountains and then repeatedly melts and freezes or that turns to ice due to its own weight and which compacts over the space of many years. Glaciers move down at an extremely slow speed.

01900544.name: Fish Stone Map
01900544.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. To the Northwest.

discovery.name: Stone Shaped like a Fish
discovery.description: A stone that looks like two fish are trapped. How long would it take for fish to be like this?

01900545.name: Delicate Flowers Map
01900545.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. Near the upturned boulder to the South.

discovery.name: Grevillea
discovery.description: An evergreen that grows in Australia. The leaves and flowers are delicate, and the flowers are red and white.

01900546.name: Large Plants Map
01900546.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. To the Southeast.

discovery.name: Wattle
discovery.description: A tree that lives in the highlands on the coast of Australia. It has thorns and can grow as high as 10 meters.

01900547.name: White Bird Map
01900547.description: A bird that inhabits the island, east of Kakadu.

discovery.name: Kagu
discovery.description: A bird that lives in New Caledonia. When threatened, it raises its crest and spreads its wings to intimidate its enemies. Although it has large wings, it can't fly.

01900548.name: Vivid Colour Birds Map
01900548.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. To the Northwest.

discovery.name: Rainbow Lorikeet
discovery.description: A brightly coloured bird. Individuals vary in appearance and make a lot of noise when in groups.

01900549.name: Red Bird Map
01900549.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. To the East.

discovery.name: Crimson Rosella
discovery.description: A bird whose body is bright red and cheeks are blue. It stands out against its surroundings and so builds its nest in safe places like the hollow of a tree.

01900550.name: Map of a Small Bird
01900550.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. To the North.

discovery.name: Brown Hawk Owl
discovery.description: A small, stout owl. It becomes active at night-fall, and eats insects and mice.

01900551.name: Map of a Small Bird
01900551.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. Near the white flowers to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Gouldian Finch
discovery.description: A bird that lives in Australia. The colour of its head varies according to the individual, and it uses termite mounds for its nest.

01900552.name: Armoured Animals Map
01900552.description: Land at the Island of New Guinea South Coast. Near the red flowers to the Northeast.

archives.location: Island of New Guinea South Coast

discovery.name: Crocodile Lizard
discovery.description: A lizard with a triangular, bony head. One male lives with several females, and hides in fallen leaves.

01900553.name: Cat-like Animals Map
01900553.description: Outside the gates of Hobart, northeast from the gates.

discovery.name: Quoll
discovery.description: A marsupial that looks like a cat. It is nocturnal and eats insects and small animals.

01900554.name: Ant Eating Animals Map
01900554.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. To the East.

discovery.name: Numbat
discovery.description: A marsupial that eats ants. It uses its large, front-leg claws to destroy ant nests.

01900555.name: Rodent-like Animal Map
01900555.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. Procced inland to Uluru. To the Southwest.

discovery.name: Bandicoot
discovery.description: A marsupial that looks like a mouse, and has a long nose. It's nocturnal and eats insects.

01900556.name: White Mole Map
01900556.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. Head Northwest from the white flowers to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Southern Marsupial Mole
discovery.description: A marsupial that looks like a mole. It lives in the desert and moves by digging into the ground. It eats any living thing it finds.

01900557.name: Squirrel-like Animal Map
01900557.description: Land at the Island of New Guinea South Coast. Near the large boulder to the Southeast.

archives.location: Island of New Guinea South Coast

discovery.name: Common Striped Possum
discovery.description: A black and white striped marsupial. It sprays a sickeningly smelly liquid. They eat fruit and so on.

01900558.name: Long Neck Animal Map
01900558.description: Around the gulf southwest of Kakadu.

discovery.name: Eastern Long-Neck Turtle
discovery.description: A long-necked aquatic turtle. Its long neck cannot even fit inside its shell.

01900559.name: Venomous Snake Map
01900559.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. To the North.

discovery.name: Tiger Snake
discovery.description: A snake with characteristically bright yellow lined patterns. It has a powerful venom and uses it while hunting prey.

01900560.name: Mesoamerica Ceremonial Vessel Map
01900560.description: Interior Yucatan peninsula on the outskirts of Merida, near the relics on the west.

discovery.name: Festival Mask
discovery.description: A mask used by the nobility as a burial good or as a ceremonial item. Many such masks are found in Mesoamerica and they are made from a variety of materials such as stone, clay, shells, or gemstones.

01900561.name: Strange Skull Map
01900561.description: Land at the South America Northeast Coast. Near the stacked boulders to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Skull with a Hole
discovery.description: A skull, many of which can be found in South America. Was the hole made in the skull for a ritual after the person died, or was it made while the person was alive...?

01900562.name: Hero's Epitaph Map
01900562.description: In the town of Lop Buri. To the North.

discovery.name: The Ramkhamhaeng Stele
discovery.description: Inscriptions said to have been written by the Sukho Thai king Ramkhamhaeng. It describes the Sukho Thai period. It is written in a spoken language and therefore easy to read, and so it spread far and wide to reach many people.

01900563.name: Golden Navel Map
01900563.description: Land at the Rapa Nui West Coast. Proceed inland to the Rapa Nui Interior. Near the red flowers.

discovery.name: Te Pito Kura
discovery.description: A place known as the navel of light. The Moai stand around it staring at the white, smooth oval stone. Although the meaning is not completely known, it does seem to be sacred.

01900564.name: Ancient Script Map
01900564.description: Land at the Rapa Nui West Coast. To the North.

discovery.name: Rongorongo
discovery.description: A tablet written with the characters of Rongo-rongo, the unique script of Rapa Nui. The name means the trees that speak. With the Rapa Nui island people, only people of a certain craft could read these characters. There are fewer, so the number of people that can read it gradually decrease each year.

01900565.name: Ancient Weapons Map
01900565.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. Near the stacked boulders in the central area.

discovery.name: Ancient Boomerang
discovery.description: A boomerang used by the aboriginal tribes for hunting. They are made of wood and polished smooth. They cut down on air resistance and fly beautifully. The natives are said to have lived on this big area of land as hunters and gatherers.

01900566.name: Clappers Map
01900566.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. To the Northwest.

discovery.name: Hunting Sticks
discovery.description: A set of sticks used to keep rhythm for the didgeridoo during the ceremonies of the Australian aborigines. Clapsticks were held by the singer who was singing the ceremonial songs.

01900567.name: Festival Clay Pot Map
01900567.description: Land at the Island of New Guinea South Coast. Near the water in the central area.

archives.location: Island of New Guinea South Coast

discovery.name: Washikuku Ceremonial Pottery
discovery.description: Pottery used in rituals in the Washikuku region. No liquids were ever put in them. It was a object of worship similar to an idol. The same face is painted on the front, back, and both sides. Its round pupils and somewhat smiling mouth are designs not often seen in Europe.

01900568.name: Festival Pedestal Map
01900568.description: Land at the Island of New Guinea South Coast. Near the red flowers to the Northeast.

archives.location: Island of New Guinea South Coast
archives.discovery: Pedestal with a Statue of a God

discovery.name: Pedestal with a Statue of a God
discovery.description: A pedestal for a spiritual hall. During gatherings, sound was produced by hitting it. All of the many tribes, both large and small, in New Guinea had a spiritual hall for spirit worship.

01900569.name: Stone Axe Map
01900569.description: Outside the gates of Wanganui, near the layered rocks.

discovery.name: Stone Axe
discovery.description: A weapon that uses stone at the top of an axe. Similar weapons have been found in all regions around the world from ancient times. Metals were not used in New Guinea; weapons for fighting were made from stone, bone, and wood.

01900570.name: Strange Drum Map
01900570.description: Outside the gates of Hobart, near the swamp.

discovery.name: Slit Drum
discovery.description: An instrument that produces sound by hitting a hollowed out log. It can be found everywhere across the world. New Guinea's slit drum is used in rituals and to signal friends.

01900571.name: Male Tribal Wear Map
01900571.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. Near the mammal bones to the Northeast.

01900572.name: Male Tribal Wear Map
01900572.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. Near the mammal bones to the Northeast.

01900573.name: Female Tribal Wear Map
01900573.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. Near the mammal bones to the Northeast.

01900574.name: Female Tribal Wear Map
01900574.description: Land at the Australia Northwest Coast. Near the mammal bones to the Northeast.

01900575.name: Odd Shaped Plant Map
01900575.description: Land at the Island of New Guinea South Coast. Near the swamp to the Northwest.

archives.location: Island of New Guinea South Coast

discovery.name: Common Staghorn Fern
discovery.description: A strange plant that grows from tree trunks in forests. Its leaves branch out like deer's antlers. At first, it was thought to be dying leaves, but it is in fact a different plant.

01900576.name: Headgear Map
01900576.description: Land at the Island of New Guinea South Coast. Near the swamp to the Northwest.

archives.location: Island of New Guinea South Coast

discovery.name: Warrior's Headdress
discovery.description: Head decorations worn by warriors of the tribes of New Guinea in battle. This headware is made from special feathers of the bird-of-paradise. These special feathers only appear during a certain period. This headdress, the chest decorations that hold the blessings of the spirits, and the body paint are said to increase morale.

01900577.name: Water-level Gauge Map
01900577.description: Land at Upper Nile. Proceed inland to South Aswan. To the South.

discovery.name: Nilometer
discovery.description: Facilities for measuring water level setup all around the Nile river. Once a year, the Nile river floods the region dealing a heavy blow to farms downstream, so it is necessary to detect the flood as early as possible. However, it is said that these floods bring rich, black earth from downstream.

01900578.name: Folk House Map
01900578.description: Outskirts of Naples, Campania region, inland towards the east.

discovery.name: The Bread of Pompeii
discovery.description: Bread found in Pompeii after the city was destroyed by a volcanic eruption. This bread was covered by volcanic ash and miraculously preserved. It is dried and completely black, and appears to have been cut with a knife into eight equal parts. Perhaps they were just about to have dinner...

discovery.name: Banquet for the Prodigal Son
discovery.description: A painting of a figure by Rembrandt. Said to be based on the Biblical story of the Prodigal son spending money on prostitutes. The dark and unclear touch which is uncharacteristic of Rembrandt gives the impression he is actually looking at something realistic beyond his subject.

01900580.name: Spooky Fish Map
01900580.description: On the sea north of K'gari.

discovery.name: Moray Eel
discovery.description: It lives in warm, shallow waters. It is long and narrow with small fins, and looks like a fat snake. When an enemy approaches, it will open its mouth wide to intimidate them and can bite with very sharp teeth. There is no fixed body pattern or colouring and there are many different types.

01900581.name: Unfinished Map
01900581.description: The archipelago northeast of the large island, east of Run.

discovery.name: The Bismarck Archipelago
discovery.description: Islands in the waters northeast of New Guinea. The largest island is New Britain that stretches from the south to the east of the archipelago. Most of the islands are volcanic and damage from eruptions is common.

01900583.name: Insect Eating Plant Map
01900583.description: Land at the Black Sea East Coast. Near the large tree to the South.

discovery.name: Common Sundew
discovery.description: This plant lives in warm bogs. The leaves exude a sticky liquid from the many hairs that grow on it. Insects get stuck on the sticky liquid and the leaf slowly contracts to close in around the insect. The insect, trapped inside, is slowly dissolved.

01900584.name: Map of El Dorado
01900584.description: A map that shows the location of El Dorado, said to be located in Northwest Copiapo.

01900585.name: Lost Settlement Map
01900585.description: A map fragment of the forgotten settlement in North Lima.

01900586.name: Map of El Dorado
01900586.description: A map that shows the location of El Dorado said to be in the South America Northwest Coast.

01900589.name: Hidden Treasure Map
01900589.description: A map that shows the location of the treasure, said to be hidden in Northeast Lima by a royal family.

01900590.name: Shrine Map
01900590.description: A map of the ruins of an old shrine in Northeast Lima.

01900592.name: Lost Settlement Map
01900592.description: A map fragment of the forgotten settlement in North Lima.

01900594.name: Andean Ceremonial Tool Map
01900594.description: Cusco, the inland of North Lima. A spot between stairways.

discovery.name: Gold Discus
discovery.description: A yellow gold disk patterned on the sun god Inti of the Quechuan tribe governed by the Incan Empire. This disk was found at the Qurikancha, the temple to the sun god, in every region of the Inca empire. The disk was also worn as an ornament by the king.

01900595.name: Andean Ceremonial Tool Map
01900595.description: Cusco, the inland of North Lima. Go up the right stairs. On the side.

discovery.name: Festival of Goldwork
discovery.description: A ceremonial bowl made using a lot of gold. Although the Incas didn't pay it much heed, it is so valuable that heartless people from foreign countries would steal it.

01900596.name: Sophisticated Map
01900596.description: Near the pointed rock north of Lima.

discovery.name: Shell
discovery.description: The main Incan towns were high in elevation, and were quite far from the sea. However, the Chasqui delivered fresh marine products high into the mountains. Also, the shells from shellfish had beautiful colours, so they were used for this kind of ornamentation.

01900597.name: Andean Ceremonial Tool Map
01900597.description: Machu Picchu, the inland of Northeast Lima. Head North from the gate.

discovery.name: Ceremonial Earthenware
discovery.description: An earthenware vessel said to have been used as a sacred vessel in Andes temples. Perhaps this served the corn based alcohol called chicha.

01900598.name: Andean Ceremonial Tool Map
01900598.description: Machu Picchu, the inland of Northeast Lima. Near the water.

discovery.name: Ceremonial Cup
discovery.description: In each of the farming villages of the Andes, this cup was shared as a rite for promising union. The two cows at the bottom of the cup were said to increase the strength of the people promising their union.

01900599.name: Sculpture Map
01900599.description: Land at the South America Northwest Coast. Head Southwest from the large boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: Illas
discovery.description: Similar to the Konopa, the illas was an idol of animals that were sacrificed to their gods. They were smaller than the Konopa and simplified. Many are made of white stone, and do not have much detailed adornment, but are adorable. This makes you understand just how close domestic animals were.

01900600.name: Sophisticated Map
01900600.description: Outside the gates of Lima (northeast), near the giant dead tree in the north.

discovery.name: Pin
discovery.description: Metal pins that held back a woman's cape or shawl. Pins worn by people with high status were highly decorated and had rich decorations.

01900601.name: Rare Bracelet Map
01900601.description: Land at the South America Northwest Coast. Near the swamp to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Gold Bracelet
discovery.description: A bracelet made using ample amounts of gold. Seems like it may have been owned by an aristocrat. It does not seem to be old, but made quite recently.

01900603.name: Goldwork Map
01900603.description: Outside the gates of Lima (north), near the upturned rock on the east.

discovery.name: Gold Bowl
discovery.description: A gold bowl found outside of Cusco. In locations where gold is abundant, not only the emperor, but also aristocrats as well dined out of gold bowls and cups. It seems that people of the general classes did not enjoy such privilege.

01900604.name: Goldwork Map
01900604.description: Outside of the north gate of Lima, Head North.

discovery.name: Gold Goblet
discovery.description: Such metal items can be found all over the Andes. It is certain that the manufacture of metal objects was established a very long time ago. You can find regional styles and clear differences in the gold work in every region.

01900605.name: Subtle Goldwork Map
01900605.description: Outside the gates of Lima (northeast), across the suspension bridge.

discovery.name: Golden Arms
discovery.description: A gold crafted arm said to have been made as a burial item. Bird and beast patterns are formed on the arm, and a soldier pattern appears on the shield. The workmanship is extremely detailed. We can see from the traces in the deep metal work that they had a high technical level.

01900606.name: Goldwork Map
01900606.description: Land at the South America Northwest Coast. Near the swamp to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Gold Headdress
discovery.description: An elaborate head adornment made of gold and turquoise. It seems to be for ceremonies or rituals. By placing the pale blue turquoise on his head, perhaps the wearer has the power to drive off evil powers.

01900607.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900607.description: Land at the South America Southwest Coast. Head East.

archives.prerequisite: Bones of a Lizard with Two Legs
archives.discovery: Stone like Egg of a Lizard

requirements.name: Bones of a Lizard with Two Legs

discovery.name: Stone like Egg of a Lizard
discovery.description: An egg-shaped rock that can fit on the palm of your hand. Maybe this is because nearby there is a rock that looks like the bones of a lizard, but this looks exactly like a lizards egg.

01900608.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900608.description: Land at the South America Southwest Coast. Cross the suspension bridge, to the East.

archives.discovery: Bones of a Lizard with Two Legs

discovery.name: Bones of a Lizard with Two Legs
discovery.description: A stone resembling lizard bones of a length of approximately 40 cm. However, its back legs are unusually long. If an animal had such long back legs, it would be faster for it to walk on just two legs, and not four.

01900609.name: Shade Blossom Map
01900609.description: Interior Yucatan peninsula on the outskirts of Merida, near the layered rocks on the east.

discovery.name: Brazilian Red Cloak
discovery.description: A plant that blossoms with an abundance of bright red flowers at the tips of its branches. The connection of the tubular flowers makes it looks like a bundle of flames. The large ones can grow as big as 4 meters tall, as high as a tree. It lives in tropical forests in central America.

01900610.name: Vibrant Flower Map
01900610.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Near the red flowers to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Jacaranda
discovery.description: A tree with purple flowers that grows in tropical areas in South America. The larger ones can be over 15 meters tall. When the flowering season arrives, the entire plant blossoms with many beautiful flowers, making the whole thing look light purple. The flower's name means beautiful song in Spanish.

01900611.name: Star Flower Map
01900611.description: Land at the South America Southwest Coast. Near the giant dead tree to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Malesherbia
discovery.description: This flower can be found only in dry regions in southwest Central America. The flower petals are shaped like stars, and bloom white and purple.

01900612.name: Vibrant Flower Map
01900612.description: Outskirts of Panama, near the red flowers.

discovery.name: Lady's Purse
discovery.description: A low bushy plant whose bag-shaped flower petals are its main characteristic. The flowers come in a number of colors; yellow, red, orange and even some with mixed colours. They are mainly found throughout warm regions in Central and South America. The flower is also known as Lady's Purse or slipper flower. Calceolarias is Latin for small shoe.

01900613.name: Creeper Flower Map
01900613.description: Land at the South America Southwest Coast. Cross the suspension bridge, to the East.

discovery.name: Chilean Glory Flower
discovery.description: This plant has stems growing straight, and it blossoms bright red and orange, tubular-shaped flowers. It grows by crawling along the ground or walls, like ivy. They are quick growers, hibernate in warm regions.

01900614.name: Sack-like Plant
01900614.description: Land at the South America Southwest Coast. Head East.

discovery.name: Goldcap
discovery.description: A plant with two flowers shaped like small purses on the end of long, narrow stems. It grows in Patagonia on the continent of South American.

01900615.name: Unfinished Map
01900615.description: A map that shows the location of the cape, north of Lambayeque.

discovery.name: Punta Parinas
discovery.description: The cape at the westernmost tip of the South American continent. It is very dry there because of the cold air currents that flow nearby and quite barren.

01900616.name: Unfinished Map
01900616.description: A map that shows the sea region, east of Acapulco.

discovery.name: The Gulf of Tehuantepec
discovery.description: The gulf spreading out south of the Isthmus of Tehuantepec in Central America. They say many civilizations have prospered along this coast since ancient times.

01900617.name: Old Defence Gear Map
01900617.description: Outside the gates of Tunis, south of ruins.

discovery.name: Golden Breastplate
discovery.description: A breastplate thought to have been taken as a war trophy when the Carthaginian army fought the Roman army. Even elite Roman soldiers of the day were only given bronze equipment, so only people with a high rank wore this.

01900619.name: Glasswork Map
01900619.description: Outside the gates of Tunis, northwest of table rock.

discovery.name: Phoenician Glass Jar
discovery.description: The Phoenicians were very talented, and created many artworks for trade. They made many glass products from their silicon rich sand. It is thought that they learned glass production from Egypt, which indicates a close relationship with the same.

01900620.name: Sophisticated Map
01900620.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. Head West.

discovery.name: Crystal Pitcher
discovery.description: A crystal carafe given to a Caliph of the Fatimid dynasty. It is made so thin you can hardly believe that it is made of crystal; the carvings are exquisite. You can clearly see the high technology of Islam.

01900621.name: Old Idols Map
01900621.description: Outside the gates of Copiapo, proceeding west from the human remains.

discovery.name: The Statue of Lanzon
discovery.description: An idol with the head of a jaguar, hair of snakes, and the body of a human. To the Incan people, the jaguar was a deity, but it was never drawn combined with a human. Perhaps some other tribe in the vicinity of Lima had a high civilization prior to the Inca.

01900622.name: African God Statue Map
01900622.description: Land at the Africa Northwest Coast. Near the stacked boulders to the South.

discovery.name: The Statue of Nonmo
discovery.description: Nonmo is the god of creation for the Dogon people that live in the northeast area of Africa. The upper torso is human, the lower is depicted as that of a snake.

01900623.name: Old Writings Map
01900623.description: Outside the gates of Jaffa, around the large rock in the north.

discovery.name: The Book of Enoch
discovery.description: One of the Apocrypha of the Old Testament. Enoch was the great grandfather of Noah, and has the meaning he who follows. According to the Book of Enoch, Enoch was taken into heaven by God and was then transformed into the angel Metatron.

01900624.name: Hero's Statue Map
01900624.description: Inside the mansion close to the Genoa Merchant Guild. On the left, in the back.

discovery.name: Equestrian Statue Gattamelata
discovery.description: Gattamelata was a condottiere active in the latter half of the 12th century to the first half of the 13th century. He had many military glories such as defeating Venice in the battle with Visconti. This bronze statue pays tribute to his glories, and was made by Donatello.

01900626.name: Glittering Armour Map
01900626.description: Land at the British Isles South Coast. Near the ruins to the Southwest.

discovery.name: Jewelled Armour
discovery.description: A suit of armour decorated with silver, gold, and jewels. Its weight and strength make it impractical to use. An aristocrat indulging in extravagance.

01900627.name: Curved Weapon Map
01900627.description: Outside the gates of Beirut, near the upturned rock on the west.

discovery.name: The Cutlass of Mamluk
discovery.description: A cutlass is a sword with a curved spine. It is small and easy to handle; famous for being the pirates' weapon of choice. They say that it was also used by the Mamluk cavalry, who were known for their spear handling and archery.

01900628.name: Ornate Decoration Map
01900628.description: Outside the gates of Calais, near the ruins.

discovery.name: Silver and Ruby Earrings
discovery.description: Earrings that a wealthy merchant gave his wife as a present. Silver and rubies are difficult to come by in Europe. An aristocrat must have had this made.

01900629.name: Highland White Flower Map
01900629.description: Outside the gates of Genoa, near the white flowers.

discovery.name: Edelweiss
discovery.description: An alpine plant that grows in the mountains in Europe. The white petals of this star shaped flower are covered in cilia, such that it appears to have a frosting of snow. It doesn't break apart when it withers and leaves behind a clean white flower. Adored locally as a noble flower because of its rarity.

01900630.name: Giant Insect Map
01900630.description: Land at the South America North Coast Plateau. Near the upturned boulder to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Titan Beetle
discovery.description: The titan beetle. As large as an adult's palm, with sharp mandibles and hooks. The larvae is half as large again. There are no other beetles in its genus. It inhabits the South American rain forest.

01900631.name: Black Bird Map
01900631.description: Head West along the coast from Kakadu.

discovery.name: Black Swan
discovery.description: The black swan. Unlike the migratory white swan, it spends its whole life in one place. It nests by the water's edge in lakes and marshes, primarily in Australia and Aotearoa.

01900632.name: Map of Indigenous Accessory
01900632.description: Land at the North America West Coast. To the South.

discovery.name: Turquoise Accessories
discovery.description: An accessory made up of fragments of turquoise. Turquoise was often collected in southwestern North America, and crafting and trading them were common. Among the indigenous people, it was said that turquoise possessed special powers.

01900633.name: Unfinished Map
01900633.description: A map that shows the location of the bay, north of Tumbes.

discovery.name: The Gulf of Guayaquil
discovery.description: A gulf on the North-west coast of the South American continent. On the southern shore is the city of Tumbes. Off the coast of the bay a warm current from the north and hits a cold current from the south.

discovery.name: The Azuero Peninsula
discovery.description: A peninsula to the west of Panama Bay. The earthenware and gold work unearthed there distinguish this place from other regions. It appears that people lived here in ancient times and developed an independent culture.

01900635.name: Unfinished Map
01900635.description: The mountain range north of Tumbes.

discovery.name: The Darien Mountains
discovery.description: The mountain range that stretches from the north-west coast of South America to Central America. It is hot and humid and the densely forested mountains are constantly covered in mist. A veritable paradise of flora and fauna, with over 1000 varieties of orchid.

01900636.name: Unfinished Map
01900636.description: The bay near the South America Northwest Coast.

discovery.name: Buenaventura Bay
discovery.description: A bay south of Panama, on the north-west coast of South America. Mangrove forests grow to the south of the bay. The cold ocean current from the south turns west at a point south of the bay, resulting in relatively high humidity.

01900637.name: Unfinished Map
01900637.description: The mountain range stretching north of Copiapo.

discovery.name: The Cordillera Occidental
discovery.description: A branch of the Andes. The Occidental range branches off the Andes, north of Copiapo, to the vicinity of Tumbes. The active volcanoes in this mountain range set it apart from the Andes.

discovery.name: The Moon Valley
discovery.description: A belt of rock salt in the Atacama desert. There is absolutely no vegetation, and valleys are formed by hills of rock. They say that someone once said it looks like the moon in the sky, and this has stuck ever since.

01900639.name: Unfinished Map
01900639.description: Outside the gates of Copiapo, towards west.

discovery.name: El Tatio Geyser Field
discovery.description: A group of geysers in the Atacama desert, at an altitude of 450m. Hot water spouts from the earth and steam rises into the sky. It is truly an amazing place.

01900640.name: Ancient Tools Map
01900640.description: Outside the gates of Edo Near the location of blooming flowers

discovery.name: Jomon Ware
discovery.description: Clay pot discovered in Japan distinguished by its cable-stitching. Fragile and easily broken. Believed to have been made in a period when techniques to fire pottery were not fully developed.

01900641.name: Ancient Tools Map
01900641.description: Land at the Japanese Archipelago Southeast Coast. Near the upturned boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: Yayoi Ware
discovery.description: Thin and tough clayware discovered in Japan. Designs and decorations are sparse. Appear to have had a more practical use. Various usages for cooking and storage, and made in several shapes to match usage.

01900642.name: Funeral Earthenware Map
01900642.description: Land at the Japanese Archipelago West Coast. To the South.

discovery.name: Haniwa
discovery.description: Unglazed pottery made in Japan. Made to look like people, horses, houses and also cylindrical shapes. Were often placed around the grave of persons of influence, or within the tomb.

01900643.name: Ancient Settlement Map
01900643.description: Outside the gates of Edo Proceed to the northeast

discovery.name: Jomon Dwelling Site
discovery.description: Remains of a dwelling site of ancient Japanese peoples. Ground is uprooted to form a floor, with pillars placed therein. This area was once a settlement, and other traces can be found in the area.

01900644.name: Ancient Writing Map
01900644.description: Land at the Japanese Archipelago West Coast. To the East.

discovery.name: Ancient Wood Strip
discovery.description: Kifuda (Wood tag) with writing on it, discovered in Japan. There were no means to make paper in this period, so similar objects can be found in China. The writings give insight into the daily lives of the people from that time.

archives.discovery: Anthology of Tales from the Past

discovery.name: Anthology of Tales from the Past
discovery.description: A Japanese book that collects over a thousand fables from Japan, India, and China into one volume. Every story in the anthology starts with the line. Now long ago.

discovery.name: Fushinjo
discovery.description: Letter from Kukai addressed to Saicho. A famous Japanese writing in the Chinese style. Kukai is also known for his penmanship, and this letter is considered his masterpiece.

01900648.name: Fire-like Flower Map
01900648.description: Land at the Japanese Archipelago Southeast Coast. Head South.

discovery.name: Red Spider Lily
discovery.description: Flower that grows throughout East Asia that opens its petals in a radial pattern. Also called 'Manjusaka'. Poisonous and often planted to keep away dangerous bugs.

01900649.name: Framed Flower Map
01900649.description: Outside the gates of Nagasaki Proceed to the northeast

discovery.name: Mophead Hydrangea
discovery.description: Plant native to Japan that bears small flowers that blossom closely to each other. The colour of the flower depends on the dirt and the number of days since it has blossomed. Large decorative flowers surround the small flowers in the center. It appears as a picture frame.

01900650.name: Beachside Flower Map
01900650.description: On the sea north of Nagasaki. Close to the shore.

discovery.name: Hime-Hama-Nadeshiko
discovery.description: Plant endemic to Japan living along the coast, beaches, and rocky places. Its magenta flowers bear strong winds as they grow on the rocks.

01900651.name: Spotted Butterfly Map
01900651.description: Out the gates of Edo Proceed to the northwest

discovery.name: Japanese Luehdorfia
discovery.description: Bright butterfly with yellow and black spots that only inhabits Japan. When the larva matures in the summer, it pupates under a fallen leaf and passes the winter there.

01900652.name: Flightless Bird Map
01900652.description: On the sea southwest of Nagasaki. Near the island.

discovery.name: Okinawa Rail
discovery.description: Bird that only inhabits the forest regions in the north of the main Okinawan island. Has small wings and is flightless. However, its legs are well developed and it can run around thickets.

01900653.name: Elegant Bird Map
01900653.description: On the sea north-northeast of Edo. Close to the shore of the island to the North.

discovery.name: Japanese Crane
discovery.description: Birds that inhabits marshy areas of East Asia. A portion of them spend the winter near human habitations. Red and black appears on its slender white body. That exquisite form appears in many of the works of art in the East.

01900654.name: White Seabird Map
01900654.description: On the sea southwest of Sakai.

discovery.name: Black-tailed Gull
discovery.description: Seabird that inhabits the waters near Japan. Though a type of gull, it does not migrate according to the seasons. Its cry is said to be similar to a cat.

01900655.name: Brightly-coloured Bird Map
01900655.description: Land at the Japanese Archipelago Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to Omi. The white flowers to the East.

discovery.name: Japanese Pheasant
discovery.description: Bird indigenous to Japan that lives in bright forests and grasslands. The male is a lustrous green colour from its breast to its stomach, and bright red around its eyes.

01900656.name: Red-faced Bird Map
01900656.description: Out the gates of Edo Near the table rock

discovery.name: Japanese Crane
discovery.description: Bird dispersed across East Asia. Nearly its whole body is white, but its wings and the backside of its tail feathers are safrano pink. When it grows menacing, the feathers behind its head stand up like a crown.

01900657.name: Waterside Frog Map
01900657.description: Out the gates of Edo Waterfront north of the lone cedar

discovery.name: Forest Green Tree Frog
discovery.description: Frog endemic to Japan. Primarily dispersed in Honshu and Sadogashima. Unlike most frogs that lays eggs in water, they lay their eggs on tree branches that hang out over the water.

01900659.name: Deer-like Animal Map
01900659.description: Land at the Japanese Archipelago Southeast Coast. Near the large boulder to the Southwest.

discovery.name: Japanese Serow
discovery.description: Antelope endemic to Japan that lives in forests. Both males and females have horns but neither regrow. Its fur is insular and durable, and highly valued.

01900660.name: Hammer-head Whale Map
01900660.description: On the sea north-northeast of Edo.

discovery.name: Giant Beaked Whale
discovery.description: Whale that lives in relatively warm waters in the northern Pacific Ocean. About 10m in length. Its head is shaped like a hammer.

01900661.name: Dog-faced Fish Map
01900661.description: On the sea south of Nagasaki.

discovery.name: Spotted Garden Eel
discovery.description: Fish that inhabits the bottom of shallow waters. Often seen peeping its head out of the sand from its pod, facing in the direction of the flow of the tide.

01900662.name: Unfinished Map
01900662.description: On the sea north of Nagasaki.

discovery.name: Iki Island
discovery.description: Island located in the Genkai Sea in the northwestern part of Kyushu. Due to the warm Tsushima current, the climate is comparatively warm. Since ancient times it has been a relaying point to connect Korea and Kyushu.

01900663.name: Unfinished Map
01900663.description: Out the gates of Nagasaki To the southeast

discovery.name: Mount Aso
discovery.description: Volcanic cluster located in a large low-lying depression in the central part of Kyushu. This low-lying depression was likely created by past volcanic activity. The surroundings are blessed with spring water and farming is performed on the flatlands.

01900664.name: Unfinished Map
01900664.description: On the sea northeast of Nagasaki. Close to the Japanese Archipelago West Coast.

discovery.name: Tottori Sand Dunes
discovery.description: Coastal dune located in the central region of Japan. Though it has the appearance of a small desert, rain and snow fall, and many plants and animals unique to the dunes can be seen.

discovery.name: Joseon Gyeonggukjeon
discovery.description: Code of laws used previous to the Gyeongguk Daejeon. Jeong Dojeon formed the foundation of the Joseon Dynasty by penning this code of laws.

discovery.name: Buddha's Nonsense
discovery.description: A critique by the politician, Jeong Dojeon. Jeong Dojeon was entrusted with power by the progenitor of the Joseon dynasty, Yi Seong-gye. It is said that this critique established the foundation of Confucianism-centered policy.

01900668.name: Small Flower Map
01900668.description: Out from the gates of Pohang Near the white flower in the West.

discovery.name: Orange Spider Lily
discovery.description: Plant that grows in the sunny forests of Korea and Japan. It blossoms in early spring, but it begins to wilt in summer. It bears an adorable flower, but it is toxic.

01900669.name: Purple Flower Map
01900669.description: Land at the Korean Peninsula West Coast. Head Northeast from the table boulder, to the South.

discovery.name: Korean Rhododendron
discovery.description: Plant that blossoms with a peach-coloured flower in the spring mainly in Korea. Endeared by the people as a harbinger of spring.

01900670.name: Small Flower Map
01900670.description: Out the gates of Pohang Proceed to the west

discovery.name: Viola Diamantiaca
discovery.description: Plant that inhabits the Korean peninsula and northeast China. Grows well in areas with lots of sunshine. Like other violets, the flower is rather plain.

01900671.name: Yellow Flower Map
01900671.description: Land at the Korean Peninsula West Coast. Close to the lone cedar to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Forsythia
discovery.description: Highly-fertile plant that inhabits Japan, Korean and China. Bears a yellow flower in early spring that bear sharp leaves around the time they wilt.

01900672.name: Rare Insect Map
01900672.description: Out the gates of Pohang. Near the slanted rock in the South.

discovery.name: Callipogon Relictus
discovery.description: Long-horned beetle that primarily lives on the Korean peninsula. Large ones can exceed 10cm in length. Can be seen in the summer in a tree called a hornbeam.

01900673.name: Red and Black Insect Map
01900673.description: Out the gates of Pohang Proceed to the west

discovery.name: Purpuricenus Lituratus Ganglbauer
discovery.description: Long-horned beetle with a garish outer appearance that is found around East Asia, including the Korean peninsula and Japan. Distinguished by it red wings dyed in a black pattern.

01900674.name: Large Fish Map
01900674.description: On the sea south of Hanyang.

discovery.name: Northern Snakehead
discovery.description: Large, carnivorous, freshwater fish found widely from Korea to China. Lives in ponds with plenty of plants. Has a large mouth and sharp teeth.

01900675.name: Striped Fish Map
01900675.description: On the sea just north of Hanyang.

discovery.name: Iksookimia Koreensis
discovery.description: Freshwater fish that lives around Korea. Beautiful loach with a black-on-white pattern.

01900676.name: Mountain Fish Map
01900676.description: On the sea north of Hanyang. Close to the Korean Peninsula North Coast.

discovery.name: Silurus Microdoesalis
discovery.description: Rare catfish living in the mountain streams of Korea. In Korean, its name means Mountain Catfish.

01900677.name: Unfinished Map
01900677.description: On the sea north of Pohang.

discovery.name: Kowloon Falls
discovery.description: Waterfall in Kumgangsan. Kowloon, meaning nine dragons was originally called waterfall basin before its name was officially established as Kowloon.

01900678.name: Unfinished Map
01900678.description: On the sea southwest of Busan. Near the small island.

discovery.name: Cheju Current
discovery.description: Current that flows between the Korean Peninsula and Cheju. Connected to the Tsushima Current. The islands on the current have a warm climate.

01900679.name: Strange Skull Map
01900679.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Near the giant dead tree to the North.

discovery.name: Skull of Tsuochen Man
discovery.description: Remains of a race that lived in Taiwan long, long ago. Many bone instruments have been found in the area, so it has been surmised that they were alive during a time when hunters were prevalent.

01900680.name: Young Daoist Statue Map
01900680.description: Out the gates of Tamsui South from the slanted rock

discovery.name: Bronze Statue of Zhongtan Yuanshuai
discovery.description: Statue of a god worshipped in Taoism. Stored in Taipei. Zhongtan Yuanshi is also called Nezha, and is shown carrying a magic sash and a flaming spear.

01900682.name: Ancient Tools Map
01900682.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Near the shack to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Snorkel Viper Pot
discovery.description: Earthen pot modeled after a Snorkel Viper. In the systems of the Rukai and Paiwan native peoples of Taiwan they were symbols of social status and were not owned by commoners.

01900683.name: Plants Habitat Map
01900683.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Near the large boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: Mahonia
discovery.description: Shrub resistant against drying found across Taiwan and the south of China. Small yellow flowers blossom around its trunk. The leaves are green and ragged, and turn in to stiff needles at the tip.

01900684.name: Black Butterfly Map
01900684.description: Outside the gates of Tamsui Southeast from the gate.

discovery.name: Spangle
discovery.description: Butterfly that inhabits a vast region, including Taiwan and China. Possesses lustrous black wings, but the male's hind wings can change colour over time. Prefers darker areas than other butterflies.

01900685.name: Small Cicada Map
01900685.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Head North from the large boulder in the central area.

discovery.name: Taiwanosemia Hoppoensis
discovery.description: Cicada that only inhabits Taiwan and is characterized by its small body and red eyes. Chirps often during the morning and evening and can be heard from far away.

01900686.name: Split-tailed Bird Map
01900686.description: Outside the gates of Tamsui In the vicinity of the pointed rock to the East

discovery.name: Drongo
discovery.description: Black bird that inhabits the croplands and urban areas in Taiwan and China. Distinguished by the upside-down Y split of its long tail.

01900687.name: Gold Bird Map
01900687.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Near the red flowers to the East.

discovery.name: White-whiskered Laughingthrush
discovery.description: Bird that inhabits the mountain region of Taiwan. Characterized by its golden wings, and its distinct eyebrows. Since it is tame and numerous, it can be seen often.

01900688.name: Triangle-spotted Frog Map
01900688.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Around the water near the shack to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Buergeria Robusta
discovery.description: Frog inhabiting mainly Taiwan. Has a triangular pattern from its mouth to its eyes, and from its eyes to its back. Its colour ranges from light brown to dark brown, depending on its environment.

01900689.name: Yellow Turtle Map
01900689.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Around the water to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Chinese Box Turtle
discovery.description: Turtle with a domal shell that inhabits the waters near Tamsui. Can completely close the space between its upper shell and its lower shell. There are many types, such as those with brown heads and those with dark green heads.

01900690.name: Grey Mouse Map
01900690.description: Outside the gates of Tamsui In the vicinity of the table rock to the North

discovery.name: Asian House Shrew
discovery.description: Mouse widely dispersed across Taiwan and China. Inhabits urban districts and farmlands. The young can be seen binding their tails with their parents', moving and acting together.

01900691.name: Long-tailed Monkey Map
01900691.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Head East.

discovery.name: Formosan Rock Macaque
discovery.description: Monkey found in Taiwan. Its whole body is grey-brown except for the end of its 4 limbs which are black. Its tail is comparatively long and fat.

01900692.name: Large Deer Map
01900692.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Near the giant dead tree to the North.

discovery.name: Sambar
discovery.description: Deer dispersed among the expansive regions of Taiwan and India. Grows to over 150cm in height. The males have horns. A nocturnal animal that can be seen resting under the shade of trees during the day.

01900693.name: Spooky Fish Map
01900693.description: Outside the gates of Tamsui Waterfront near the red flowers

discovery.name: Chinese Snakehead
discovery.description: Fish about 30cm long found across Taiwan and China. Used in food and medicine. There are red, brown, and green ones.

01900694.name: Unfinished Map
01900694.description: On the sea northeast of Anping. Close to the shore.

discovery.name: Shihyusan
discovery.description: Rock on the coast of Taiwan formed by sea erosion.A single, thin and long rock supports a larger rock, giving the impression of an umbrella.

01900695.name: Unfinished Map
01900695.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Near the shack to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Tailuge Gorge
discovery.description: Gorge formed by eroded marble spreading across the southeast of Tamsui. The surrounding mountains proclaim heights of over 3000 metres. Noted for its naturally-formed cliffs.

01900697.name: Ancient Sake Vessel Map
01900697.description: Land at the China Southeast Coast. Near the upturned boulder to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Jue
discovery.description: Wine vessel used during the Zhou Dynasty for ceremonial purposes. Its three legs stand for heaven, earth, and god. This Jue has a depiction of a strange beast called a Taotie.

discovery.name: Armillary Sphere
discovery.description: Astronomical device invented in the Later Han dynasty. Three disks are arranged with a detailed angle index carved into each. Through this, an astronomical object's position in space can be read.

01900699.name: Map of Large Marine Mammal
01900699.description: Near the island northeast of Petropavlovsk.

discovery.name: Steller's Sea Cow
discovery.description: A large sea creature which inhabits the island east of the Kamchatka Peninsula. Their tendencies of not being cautious of humans and protecting their companions who have been hurt is putting them at risk of becoming extinct.

01900700.name: Religious Book Map
01900700.description: Land at the Yellow River Downstream. Near the upturned boulder to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Taiping Qingling Shu
discovery.description: A Taoist sutra. Became a sutra of Taiping Tao, a movement started by Zhang Jiao. Also called the Taiping Sutra.

01900701.name: Round Instrument Map
01900701.description: Outside the gates of Chongqing Near the Upturned Boulder to the East

discovery.name: Ruan
discovery.description: Instrument believed to have been made during the Han Dynasty. Named after one of the seven scholars, Ruan Xian who was said to love playing the instrument. It is simply called Ruan in modern times.

discovery.name: The Inner Canon of Huangdi
discovery.description: Book that has formed the basis of Chinese medicine since ancient times. Though to have been compiled in the former Han dynasty. As a variety of medical theories have been brought together, the authors and compilers are unclear.

01900703.name: Ancient Book Map
01900703.description: Land at the China Southeast Coast. Near the giant dead tree to the South.

discovery.name: Shen Nung's Pen Ts'ao
discovery.description: Pharmacology book recording the effect of each individual drug, thought to have been compiled in the later Han dynasty. Over 300 types of medicines are characterized by their effect. Shen Nung was an ancient individual of legend, and the godfather of agriculture and medical science.

01900705.name: Small Lizard Map
01900705.description: Land at the Yellow River Downstream. To the Southwest.

discovery.name: Small Winged Dragon Bones
discovery.description: Bones of a creature as small as a sparrow found near the Yuntain Mountains. Characterized by its thin wings and curved legs as small as a fingertip.

01900706.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900706.description: Outside the gates of Yuntaisha Proceed north from the slanted rock

discovery.name: Petrified Turtle like Animal
discovery.description: Petrified creature thought to be like a turtle discovered south of the Yellow River. Its head cannot be found. Did it break off?

01900707.name: Fish Bones Map
01900707.description: Land at the Yellow River Downstream. Near the stacked boulders to the South.

archives.discovery: Bones of Fish with Sunken Eyes

discovery.name: Bones of Fish with Sunken Eyes
discovery.description: Bones of a creature thought to be a fish discovered near the Yellow River. Characterized by its large eye cavities.

01900708.name: Yellow and Red Flower Map
01900708.description: Outside the gates of Chongqing Near slanted rock in southeast

discovery.name: Yellowhorn
discovery.description: Plant mostly seen in China. It grows a white flower, but as the days pass it gradually changes into a light red colour from the center.

01900709.name: Small Flower Map
01900709.description: Outside the gates of Chongqing South from the gate

discovery.name: Buddleja Davidii
discovery.description: A plant that primarily grows in China with small flowers blossoming in tufts on its branches. Its fragrance often attracts butterflies.

01900710.name: Shade Blossom Map
01900710.description: Outside the gates of Yuntaisha Near the stacked boulders to the northwest

discovery.name: Hardy Begonia
discovery.description: Plant that mainly inhabits China. A red flower that blossoms from the end of Summer to Fall. Prefers shade and dampness, and can be seen blooming in various locations.

01900711.name: White Flower Map
01900711.description: Land at the China Southeast Coast. Head Southwest from the giant dead tree, to the Southwest.

discovery.name: Japanese Pagoda Tree
discovery.description: Plant with lots of white flowers, mostly found in China. Famous as a medicinal plant, and dried buds are used as a hemostatic.

01900712.name: Green Insect Map
01900712.description: Inland of Chongqing Near slanted rock in the north

discovery.name: Calyptotrypes Hibinonis
discovery.description: Bug inhabiting the south of China. Said not to land on the ground even once during its lifetime. Often seen flying around the top of tree leaves.

01900713.name: Vivid Colour Birds Map
01900713.description: Inland of Chongqing West from the gate

discovery.name: Golden Pheasant
discovery.description: Bird that inhabits the mountains of southwest China. Has a red and luxurious coat. Very alert and talented at hiding. Very rarely seen.

01900714.name: Unusual Bird Map
01900714.description: Outside the gates of Chongqing Near the Giant Dead Tree to the southwest

discovery.name: Chinese Bamboo Partridge
discovery.description: Bird with a strange chirp that inhabits China and Taiwan. It's a very alert animal and is rarely seen. Searches for food in the early hours as a flock.

01900715.name: Large Sheep Map
01900715.description: Inland of Chongqing Near the lone cedar to the west

discovery.name: Argali
discovery.description: Large sheep of 120cm, back-to-front, that mainly inhabits the plateau regions of central China. Both males and females have horns. Male horns grow to over 1m in length.

01900716.name: Large Horn Animal Map
01900716.description: Inland of Chongqing In the vicinity of the pointed rock to the East

discovery.name: Takin
discovery.description: Animal distinguished by its large curved horns that inhabits southwest China. It forms large flocks in the summer, but tend to split into smaller groups in winter.

01900718.name: Small Turtle Map
01900718.description: Outside the gate of Chongqing Southwest from the gate

discovery.name: Yellow Pond Turtle
discovery.description: Nocturnal turtle spread across the regions of China. Spends the days in the mud in the bottom of water or in holes. Has an aggressive side, as can be seen in its biting of other individuals.

01900719.name: Unfinished Map
01900719.description: On the sea north of Yuntaishan. Near the mouth of the Yellow River.

discovery.name: Mount Pan
discovery.description: Towering mountain north of the Yellow River famous for its natural spring water and Buddhist temples. Has landscapes of pine trees and beautiful water, and looks dazzling from any direction.

01900720.name: Unfinished Map
01900720.description: On the sea northeast of Quanzhou. Near the China Southeast Coast.

discovery.name: Wuyi Mountains
discovery.description: Mountains that maintain a warm climate and where many tea leaves can be extracted. Relics of the Song Dynasty and books used by the progenitors of Neo-Confucianism remain here.

01900721.name: Unfinished Map
01900721.description: On the sea west of Macau. Close to the shore.

discovery.name: South China Karst
discovery.description: Land spreading out far south of Chongqing, where a forest of strange rocks stand. Blessed with an abundant landscape and calm weather.

01900722.name: Tainan Map
01900722.description: Record of Europeans who used the castle ruins in Anping as a base of operations.

discovery.name: Tawara Sotatsu Folding Screen Painting
discovery.description: A painting on a folding screen by the Japanese artist, Tawaraya Sotatsu. On the one side the thunder god is depicted on the left sounding out a dram while the wind god is depicted on the right manipulating the wind..

discovery.name: Temple Miracles Scroll
discovery.description: A Japanese picture scroll depicting the miraculous events surrounding a temple and the priests there. It beautifully records the attitudes of those who sought faith, both rich and poor.

discovery.name: Chinese Folding Screen
discovery.description: Folding screen picture depicting nature. A furnishing used in the mansions and royal courts of the Heian nobles.

01900727.name: Large Pottery Map
01900727.description: Out the gates of Pohang Near the slanted rock in the south

discovery.name: Hearth-shaped Pottery
discovery.description: Clayware shaped like a Hibachi. Often used in the Gaya period. As the pottery-making technology developed they grew larger, and were decorated with various patterns, such as triangular and half-circle patterns.

01900728.name: Ancient Stele Map
01900728.description: Land at the Korean Peninsula North Coast. Head East from the stacked boulders to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Jungwon Goguryeo Stele
discovery.description: Stele believed to have been built in the Goguryeo period. It is covered in lettering on all four sides. It appears to detail the relationship between Goguryeo and Silla, but it is heavily damaged and difficult to read.

discovery.name: Gilt-bronze Standing Bodhisattva
discovery.description: Bodhisattva statue often seen in Korea. There are many methods of making the statues, such as painting a wooden figure with bronze, or through casting.

01900730.name: Korean Relic Map
01900730.description: Land at the Korean Peninsula West Coast. Near the table boulder to the South.

discovery.name: Paekche Reliquary Container
discovery.description: Sarira recepticle from a time when Buddhism flourished in Silla. Stored at a certain temple, the item itself is a type of nested container. The outer bronze recepticle contains a silver recepticle, and within that is a golden recepticle.

discovery.name: Sin Saimdang Folding Screen
discovery.description: Folding screen said to have been drawn by the Korean artist, Sin Saimdang. Influenced by Ahn Gyeon, it features a very sophisticated painting style. Devoid of humans and animals, the grass and insects are beautifully depicted.

discovery.name: Gang Huian Ink Painting
discovery.description: Ink painting by the Korean painter, Gang Hui-an. Gang Hui-an studied art in China and was particularly praised for his depictions of bamboo. He also masterly depicted landscapes, plants and figures.

01900734.name: Large Island Map
01900734.description: Outside the gates of Tamsui East from the gate.

discovery.name: Taiwan Island Map
discovery.description: A full-island map of Taiwan. Many maps of Taiwan depicted three islands, but this island depicts Taiwan as one island.

01900735.name: Castle Overhead View Map
01900735.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Near the shack to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Fort Zeelandia Map
discovery.description: Map of Fort Zeelandia drawn from above. The artist is unknown, but it has been preserved beautifully.

01900736.name: Ancient Ornament Map
01900736.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Near the red flowers to the East.

discovery.name: Man-Beast Ear Ornament
discovery.description: Ear Accessory exhumed from a Taiwanese settlement. A beast rides on the head of two humans, symbolizing the relationship between humans and divine beasts.

01900737.name: Old Writings Map
01900737.description: Outside the gates of Yuntaisha Proceed south from the gate

discovery.name: Amida Fragment
discovery.description: Work that shows the state of the Pure Land with sutras and drawings. Based on the sutra Amitabha Sutra, and translated by the monk of the Six Dynasties, Kumarajiva.

discovery.name: Mao Song Painting
discovery.description: Picture depicting monkey that is believed to be a Japanese Macaque. Believed to be a work of Southern Song painter, Mao Song. A famous work exhibiting outstanding expressiveness.

discovery.name: Huang Gongwang Ink Painting
discovery.description: Ink painting by the Yuan Dynasty artist, Huang Gongwang. Various scenes are depicted by the contrasting shades of ink. The painting is over 6m tall.

discovery.name: Mao Yi Painting
discovery.description: Painting of plants and animals by Mao Yi, artist of the Southern Song period. Petals are drawn one by one in fine detail. Though old, the painting has not lost much of its colour.

01900741.name: Valuable Book Map
01900741.description: Land at the Yellow River Downstream. Near the pointed boulder to the North.

discovery.name: Yongle Encyclopedia
discovery.description: Book compiling original copies of various works on astronomy, topography, and yin and yang. Covers valuable literature up to the Ming Dynasty. However the book grew into a massive compilation exceeding 20,000 volumes, and only a portion has been reproduced.

01900742.name: A Daimyo's Helmet Map
01900742.description: Outside the gates of Edo Near the red flowers

01900743.name: Tatara Furnace Map
01900743.description: Land at the Japanese Archipelago West Coast. Near the shack to the Southeast.

01900744.name: Indigenous Pottery Map
01900744.description: Land at the North America Southeast Coast. Head South from the shack to the West.

discovery.name: Underwater Panther Jug
discovery.description: A domestic tool of a tribe that lived on the Gulf of Mexico coast near the Mississippi River. This jug is decorated with the underwater panther, a mythological creature that appears in the tribe's legends.

01900745.name: Shell Accessories Map
01900745.description: Land at the North America Southeast Coast. Head North.

discovery.name: Shell Gorget
discovery.description: A collar carved from a shell. It was discovered in a tomb near the Etowah River in North America. The gorget is uniquely carved and contains geometrical patterns.

01900746.name: Old Pipe Map
01900746.description: Land at the North America East Coast. Near the table boulder to the West-Northwest.

discovery.name: Adena Pipe
discovery.description: An ancient pipe found near the Ohio River in North America, it is a relic of an agricultural society from thousands of years ago. It shows that people have smoked tobacco since very long ago.

01900747.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900747.description: Land at the North America East Coast. Head South from the table boulder to the West-Northwest.

discovery.name: Stone with a Plant Pattern
discovery.description: A stone with strange patterns and impressions that look like a fern leaf... Could it be a petrified ancient plant?

01900748.name: Bizarre Stone Map
