01900748.description: Land at the North America East Coast. Head Southwest.

discovery.name: Stone with a Pattern
discovery.description: A giant stone covered with a pattern of six-sided shapes. It was discovered near a coal deposit. Could there be a connection?

01900749.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900749.description: Land at the North America East Coast. Near the giant dead tree to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Rock like a Fanged Lizard
discovery.description: A stone resembling a lizard dug up in Joggins. It has a long and narrow snout for a lizard. Could such a creature have once lived long ago?

01900750.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900750.description: Land at the North America East Coast. North of the table boulder to the West-Northwest.

discovery.name: Rock like a Long-snouted Lizard
discovery.description: A rock that looks like a lizard measuring over 60 cm long. It was overlapped by other stones when found.

01900751.name: Large Flower Map
01900751.description: Land at the North America East Coast. Near the pointed boulder to the South.

discovery.name: Cotton Rosemallow
discovery.description: A plant that grows on the plains of North America that tends to favor sunny areas. It can grow up to 1 meter tall and blooms with large flowers spanning roughly 20 cm.

01900752.name: Yellow Flower Map
01900752.description: Land at the North America East Coast. Near the giant dead tree to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Goldenglow
discovery.description: A native plant of North America, it can grow up to 2 meters in height and blossoms with large yellow flowers. It can breed with both its seeds and underground stems.

01900753.name: Flower Truss Map
01900753.description: Land at the North America Southeast Coast. Near the shack to the West.

discovery.name: American Wisteria
discovery.description: A type of wisteria distributed in southern North America with relatively small flowers growing in trusses that are 15 cm in length.

01900754.name: Aquatic Flower Map
01900754.description: Land at the North America Southeast Coast. Near the diagonal boulder to the North-Northeast.

discovery.name: Pigmy Waterlily
discovery.description: An aquatic plant distributed in East Asia, North America and elsewhere, it grows wild in ponds and other bodies of water with a calm surface. It blooms during the day and has white flowers from early summer to autumn.

01900755.name: Blue Small Flower Map
01900755.description: Land at the North America Southeast Coast. Head East from the red flowers, to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Bluebonnet
discovery.description: A flower that inhabits North America. Its dense formation of small blue flowers looks like a long rug.

01900757.name: Fish with Legs Map
01900757.description: Land at the North America Southeast Coast. Around the water near the shack, to the West.

discovery.name: Lesser Siren
discovery.description: An amphibian with an eel-like body and two legs. The legs have four toes with a well-developed structure.

01900758.name: Round Creature Map
01900758.description: Land at the North America Southeast Coast. Near the diagonal boulder to the North.

discovery.name: Common Box Turtle
discovery.description: A type of box turtle inhabiting eastern North America. It has a dome-shaped shell that appears circular when viewed from above. The male has a larger head than the female's as well as thicker, shorter claws on the hind legs.

01900759.name: Ferocious Creature Map
01900759.description: Land at the North America Southeast Coast. Around the water near the entrance.

discovery.name: Common Snapping Turtle
discovery.description: A large turtle that can exceed 40 cm in length. Its stout frame makes it seem even bigger. Hungry snapping turtles are aggressive and best to be avoided.

01900760.name: River Shark Map
01900760.description: A map of a creature that inhabits the Mississippi River.

discovery.name: American Paddlefish
discovery.description: A relative of the sturgeon that inhabits North America. Its distinctive feature is the long snout, but this body part's function is poorly understood. Many people enjoy salting and dining on its eggs, called American Sevruga Caviar.

01900761.name: Common Shellfish Map
01900761.description: Land at the North America East Coast. On the beach near the landing point.

discovery.name: Hard Clam
discovery.description: A common clam that is often consumed as food, its shell has a rough, ridged surface. It can be found in relatively many places.

01900762.name: Unfinished Map
01900762.description: On the sea south-southwest of the Newfoundland North Coast.

discovery.name: Prince Edward Island
discovery.description: An island in North America with a warm climate and productive land. It is said that the island's southern end was once connected to the mainland.

01900763.name: Unfinished Map
01900763.description: On the sea north-northeast of Nassau.

discovery.name: Nantucket Island
discovery.description: A small island off the coast of North America, temperatures here are low year-round and snowfall is heavy in winter. There have been numerous sightings of whales in the waters nearby.

discovery.name: Cape Cod
discovery.description: An arm-shaped peninsula in northern North America with cool summers and warm winters. Its name stems from the fish of the same name often caught in the waters around the cape.

01900765.name: Unfinished Map
01900765.description: A map that shows the location of the coast, north of the North America Southeast Coast.

discovery.name: Outer Banks
discovery.description: A line of peninsulas and sandbars on the eastern coast of North America that stretches for over 500 km from north to south. The two ocean currents converging in the area make maritime navigation difficult.

01900766.name: Unfinished Map
01900766.description: On the sea north of the North America Southeast Coast.

discovery.name: Pamlico Sound
discovery.description: A triangular lagoon surrounded by peninsulas. The dreaded pirate Blackbeard supposedly had...or perhaps still has...his base of operations here.

01900768.name: Treasure Map
01900768.description: Map indicating the location of treasure hidden at Naples Outskirts.

archives.prerequisite: The Staff of Peter the Hermit

requirements.name: The Staff of Peter the Hermit

01900769.name: Treasure Map
01900769.description: Map indicating the location of treasure hidden at Southeast Lubeck.

01900770.name: Treasure Map
01900770.description: Map indicating the location of treasure hidden at the Bay of Biscay South Coast.

01900771.name: Treasure Map
01900771.description: Map indicating the location of treasure hidden in South Calais.

01900772.name: Treasure Map
01900772.description: Map indicating the location of treasure hidden north of Dublin.

01900773.name: Indigenous People Records
01900773.description: Records regarding the natives living on the southeast coast of North America.

01900774.name: Indigenous People Records
01900774.description: Records regarding the natives living on the southeast coast of North America.

01900775.name: Indigenous People Records
01900775.description: Records regarding the natives living on the east coast of North America.

01900776.name: Indigenous People Records
01900776.description: Records regarding the natives living on the east coast of North America.

01900777.name: Indigenous People Records
01900777.description: Records regarding the natives living on the southeast coast of North America.

01900780.name: Indigenous People Records
01900780.description: Records regarding the natives living on the southeast coast of North America.

01900781.name: Indigenous People Records
01900781.description: Records regarding the natives living on the east coast of North America.

01900782.name: Explorers Notes
01900782.description: Map fragment showing Northwest Genoa. Recorded by an explorer.

01900783.name: Shipwreck Route Map
01900783.description: Navigation chart of the sunken ship in the Baltic Sea.

01900784.name: Explorers Notes
01900784.description: Map fragment showing Bay of Biscay South Coast. Recorded by an explorer.

01900786.name: Caravan Record
01900786.description: Record of missing caravan at South Calais.

01900787.name: Caravan Record
01900787.description: Record of missing caravan at Southeast Lubeck.

01900788.name: Holy Man's Note
01900788.description: Clergyman's writings indicating a place in the Candia Church.

01900789.name: Caravan Record
01900789.description: Record of missing caravan at British Isles North.

01900790.name: Caravan Record
01900790.description: Record of missing caravan at North Oslo.

01900791.name: Hardened Tree Map
01900791.description: Land at the Newfoundland North Coast. Near the lone cedar to the West.

discovery.name: Black Spruce
discovery.description: A type of tree that grows from the eastern part of North America to the north. Grows to be almost 25 meters tall, with branches growing like a cone around the trunk. Very hard wood, making it a popular material for building.

01900792.name: Tree with Twisted Branches Map
01900792.description: Land at the Newfoundland North Coast. Near the lone cedar to the West.

discovery.name: Jack Pine
discovery.description: A tree that grows from the north to northeast of North America. The tree forms a wide cone shape with the branches bending irregularly.

01900793.name: Unfinished Map
01900793.description: On the sea southwest of the Newfoundland North Coast.

discovery.name: Long Range Mountains
discovery.description: A mountain range located in the western part of Terra Nova, along the northeastern part of North America. It is the northern edge of the Appalachian mountain range.

01900794.name: Unfinished Map
01900794.description: On the sea south-southwest of the Newfoundland North Coast.

discovery.name: Cabot Strait
discovery.description: A strait found along the northeastern coast of North America. About 11km wide, it is the widest strait allowing entrance into the Gulf of Saint Lawrence from the Atlantic Ocean.

01900795.name: Unfinished Map
01900795.description: On the sea southwest of the Newfoundland North Coast.

discovery.name: Lewis Hills
discovery.description: A mountain found in the western part of Terra Nova, along the northeastern coast of North America. Rising to a height of 814 meters, it is the highest mountain on Terra Nova, being slightly taller than Gros Morne, the other tall mountain of the Long Range mountains.

01900796.name: Unfinished Map
01900796.description: On the sea south-southeast of the Newfoundland North Coast.

discovery.name: Cape Spear
discovery.description: A cape located on the northeastern part of Terra Nova, along the northeastern coast of North America. It is considered the eastern most point of North America. The cape looks out over the Atlantic Ocean, and whales can sometimes be seen swimming in the waters from there.

01900798.name: Unfinished Map
01900798.description: On the sea north of the Azores. The cape at the southern edge of Greenland.

discovery.name: Cape Farewell
discovery.description: The cape located at the southern most tip of Greenland. The land of Greenland is covered in ice and snow for the most part, but during the summer, you can see land from the coast along capes like these.

01900799.name: Unfinished Map
01900799.description: On the sea southeast of the Newfoundland North Coast.

discovery.name: Avalon Peninsula
discovery.description: A peninsula on the southeastern part of Terra Nova. With a convoluted coastline, there are numerous bays and inlets in that area. An excellent fishing spot.

discovery.name: Text on Hermes
discovery.description: A book obtained by Cosimo and translated into Latin by Marsilio Ficino. It was put together in the Eastern Roman Empire, but appears to be based on a book on philosophy written in Egypt.

01900801.name: Unfinished Map
01900801.description: On the sea south-southwest of the Newfoundland North Coast.

discovery.name: Gaspe Peninsula
discovery.description: A peninsula located on the southern side of the mouth of the St. Lawrence River. Numerous ancient fossils have been on its southern shores.

01900802.name: Strong Bird Map
01900802.description: Land at the North America East Coast. Near the giant dead tree to the North.

discovery.name: Osprey
discovery.description: A large bird found on most of the coasts of North America. Fish eaters, they tend to fly low over the water and drop down to get there prey. Overall a blackish brown color, their heads sport a white crown of feathers.

01900803.name: Map of a Small Bird
01900803.description: Land at the North America East Coast. Near the large tree to the Southwest.

discovery.name: Black-capped Chickadee
discovery.description: A small bird found in the northern area of North America. Alert for danger, this small bird changes its cry depending on the level of danger it senses.

01900804.name: Map of Roman Earthworks
01900804.description: Land at the British Isles North. Head South from the stacked boulders in the Southwest.

discovery.name: Antonine Wall
discovery.description: Earthworks built at the command of Emperor Antoninus Hadrian during the time of the Roman Empire. The 60 km wall was built over the extremely short period of only 2 years.

01900805.name: Unfinished Map
01900805.description: The Great Plains. Across the river.

discovery.name: Prairie
discovery.description: A huge area of flat grasslands in the center of North America. The grass grows long. The land is exceptionally fertile and good for farming,

01900806.name: Map to Beautiful Flowering Trees
01900806.description: Land at the North America Southeast Coast. Head Northwest from the landing point.

discovery.name: Flowering Dogwood
discovery.description: A flowering tree of North America. In late spring it blooms with a white or faint pink flower and carries a red fruit in the fall.

01900807.name: Unfinished Map
01900807.description: On the sea north of the Northern Britain Island. The island to the West.

discovery.name: Islay
discovery.description: An island on the west in the northern parts of the British Isles. Due to the surrounding currents, this island has milder weather than the main island.

01900808.name: Unfinished Map
01900808.description: On the sea north of the Northern Britain Island. The island to the West.

discovery.name: Isle of Skye
discovery.description: An island on the west in the northern parts of the British Isles. They say the name of the island originates either from the old Nordic language, or from the legends of Scathach. It is also sometimes called the Isle of the Mist.

01900809.name: Unfinished Map
01900809.description: On the sea north of the Northern Britain Island. The island to the West.

discovery.name: Lewis
discovery.description: Northern part of the British Isles. Island to the west. The island with the largest land mass of the nearby islands. The southern part is called also by a different name. The island has ruins showing the use of huge rocks and stones.

01900810.name: Map to Decorated Copies
01900810.description: Inside the church in Dublin. Behind the bookstand.

discovery.name: Book of Durrow
discovery.description: The oldest handwritten copy of the bible created in Ireland or the British Isles. Similar to the Book of Kells, it is decorated in beautiful calligraphy. The letters are written in a peculiar style called Island letters.

01900811.name: Map to Decorated Copies
01900811.description: Inside the church in Dublin. Behind the bookstand.

discovery.name: Lindisfarne Gospels
discovery.description: A handwritten copy of the four books of the Gospels. Though done in beautiful calligraphy similar to the Book of Kells, it is written in Latin. Originally, it was decorated with gems and precious metals, but these were lost to the Vikings.

01900812.name: Map to the Red Wolf
01900812.description: Land at the Colorado Plateau. Near the pointed boulder to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Red Wolf
discovery.description: A type of wolf found in the central and southern parts of North America. Resembles the coyote, with whom it shares territories, but is slightly larger in size. Large differences can be found in fur color, but it is generally reddish in color.

01900813.name: Unfinished Map
01900813.description: On the sea west-northwest of Plymouth. The coast area west of Ireland.

discovery.name: Cliffs of Moher
discovery.description: The cliffs touching the sea west of Southern Ireland. Its name means the Cliff of Ruin. The colors there on a clear day are said to be spectacular.

01900814.name: Notes Concerning Hunting Spots
01900814.description: A record of hunting performed by the natives in the Colorado plateau.

01900815.name: Unfinished Map
01900815.description: A map that shows the location of the cape, north of the Scandinavia West Coast.

discovery.name: North Cape
discovery.description: Also known as Nordkapp. It is a cape on the northern coast of a small island of the Scandinavian peninsula. The cliff is steep, but the view from the top is superb.

01900816.name: Unfinished Map
01900816.description: On the sea northeast of Petropavlovsk. The easternmost point of the continent

discovery.name: Chukchi Peninsula
discovery.description: A peninsula facing the Bering Strait. Though a frigid land, there is evidence that people used to live here. Perhaps there are rich resources sleeping under the ice…

01900817.name: The Map of the Beast of the Far North.
01900817.description: West-Northwest of Petropavlovsk. On the shores near the continent.

discovery.name: Amur Leopard
discovery.description: A large leopard that inhabits the coast of eastern Russia. Its habits are slightly different from other leopards, and Amur leopards do not carry their prey into the trees.

01900818.name: Luxurious Wall Map
01900818.description: Inside the Cathedral in St. Petersburg. In the back.

discovery.name: Iconostasis
discovery.description: A wall covered by iconography. They are placed in several locations inside the Cathedral. Depending on the location, different pictures are drawn.

01900819.name: Map of Slavic Wooden Statue
01900819.description: Land at the Baltic Sea South-East. Near the northeastern edge.

discovery.name: Wooden Sculpture of Velez
discovery.description: A wooden sculpture of a god of Slavic myth. Velez was the god of livestock and wealth, and was loved by the commons. Velez is also associated with the souls of the dead. In the Tale of Igor's Campaign, a legendary bard is said to be a grandson of Velez.

01900820.name: Map of Slavic Tablet
01900820.description: Land at the Baltic Sea South-East. Near the eastern edge.

discovery.name: Relief of Svarog
discovery.description: A sculpture of a god of Slavic myth. Svarog is the father of the sun god, Dazbog, and represents fire and the hearth.

01900821.name: Unfinished Map
01900821.description: Set sail from Jamaica to the eastern sea.

discovery.name: The Jamaica Channel
discovery.description: A channel located to the northeast of Jamaica. This region is full of small islands which house pirates. Exercise caution when sailing these waters.

01900822.name: Map of Caribbean Ores
01900822.description: Inside the Mansion in Port Royal.

discovery.name: A View of the Caribbean
discovery.description: A pale blue stone called Larimar, found in the vicinity of the Bahamas. Its beautiful color is reminiscent of the Caribbean Sea, and is relaxing to the mind of the bearer.

discovery.name: Ab Urbe Condita Libri
discovery.description: A monumental history of the founding of Rome, reconstructed from scattered chapters. The original work by Titus Livius had over 100 chapters, and many have not been found.

01900824.name: Unfinished Map
01900824.description: Land at the Yellow River Downstream. Head South from the upturned boulder to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Mongolian Plateau
discovery.description: A seemingly endless plateau. Perhaps due to low precipitation, the center region is desert.

01900826.name: Unfinished Map
01900826.description: The coast area in the southern Chukchi Sea. On the east side of the strait that runs north and west.

discovery.name: Chukchi Mountains
discovery.description: A large mountain range located at the base of the Chukchi Peninsula. There are also other mountain ranges in the area, which makes the whole region peppered with mountains

01900827.name: Round Seal Map
01900827.description: The coast area in the White Sea. Around the entrance to the inlet.

discovery.name: Ringed Seal
discovery.description: Small seals that reside vastly across the sea ice fields. Their bodies are rounded with black and grey spots on the dorsal side.

01900828.name: Rare Deer Map
01900828.description: The Kamchatka Peninsula Shores. In the coast area west of the peninsula.

discovery.name: Micromeryx
discovery.description: Animal thought to be a sub species to the Siberian musk deer. Its ecology is essentially the same as a Siberian musk deer. Rarely seen.

01900829.name: Cross Map
01900829.description: Land at the Baltic Sea North. The northeastern corner.

discovery.name: A Silver Cross
discovery.description: A silver cross thought to have been carried by the Slavs. They were distributed on the coastal region of the Baltic coast, Balkans and the Black sea coast from the 6th century.

01900830.name: Unfinished Map
01900830.description: Land at the Sea of Okhotsk West Coast. Proceed inland to Lake Baikal. Near the stacked boulders.

discovery.name: Lake Baikal
discovery.description: A large lake located between Southeast Russia and northern Mongolia. Its water is fed by many lakes and streams, boasting a richness of animal life.

01900831.name: Brilliantly Colored Shrimp Map
01900831.description: Set sail from Havana sail west at sea.

discovery.name: Lysmata Amboinensis
discovery.description: A type of shrimp found in the corals of the Caribbean. Has a single white line running down its back, sandwiched by vivid red lines on either side.

01900832.name: Unfinished Map
01900832.description: Land at the Yellow River Downstream. Head West.

discovery.name: Altai Mountains
discovery.description: Mountain range spanning from western Siberia to Mongolia. Has been occupied by men since ancient times, apparent from many pictures carved in stone

01900833.name: Unfinished Map
01900833.description: The water facing east of the Jamaican island.

discovery.name: Blue Mountains
discovery.description: Mountain range located in eastern Jamaica. With elevations above 2000m, the mountain range appears blue from afar

01900834.name: Poisonous Spider Map
01900834.description: Land at the Colorado Plateau. Near the stacked boulders in the central area.

discovery.name: Brown Recluse Spider
discovery.description: Highly venomous spider distributed in central and south America. With no known antidote, the pain from its bite will persist until it naturally heals

01900836.name: Map of Caribou Living on Island
01900836.description: Northeast of Greenland. On the sea close to the shore of the island.

discovery.name: Eastern Greenland Caribou
discovery.description: A type of caribou living on the eastern part of Greenland. Moving in small flocks and eat lichens.

01900837.name: Map of Tribal Statue
01900837.description: Outside the gate of Havana East of the gate

discovery.name: The Sculpture of Zemi
discovery.description: A stone sculpture which was made by the Taino tribe who have lived in the Caribbean area since long ago. It is shaped as gods or spirits of ancestors as well as many other types of figures.

01900838.name: Map of Spotted Ray
01900838.description: On the sea north of Willemstad

discovery.name: Yellow Stingray
discovery.description: A type of ray which resides in the Caribbean Sea. The body is close to a circular shape with a short tail. Their main characteristic is the spotted design on their body surface.

01900839.name: Map of Glorious Fish
01900839.description: On the sea south of Grand Cayman

discovery.name: Squirrelfish
discovery.description: A fish which resides in the reef area of the Atlantic Coast. The body colour is silver or red, has long fins, and big eyes.

01900841.name: Unfinished Map
01900841.description: On the sea east-northeast of Willemstad

discovery.name: Martinique
discovery.description: A volcanic island which belongs to the Caribbean West Indies. A beautiful island where the bumpy landforms are covered by green trees and surrounded by a blue ocean.

01900843.name: Observation Record of Bright Stars
01900843.description: Observe on the sea off the coast of Hawaii.

discovery.name: Altair
discovery.description: A first-magnitude star. The brightest one in the constellation Aquila, it creates the corner of the summer triangle. It is an abbreviation of an Arabic phrase which means 'the flying eagle'.

01900844.name: Observation Record of Bright Stars
01900844.description: Observe on the sea in the Bay of Bengal.

discovery.name: Vega
discovery.description: Vega creates one corner of the summer triangle. It is the brightest star in the constellation Lyra, the fifth brightest star in the night sky, and the second brightest star in the northern celestial hemisphere, after Arcturus. It is said that the constellation Lyra was formed from the harp of Orpheus, with Vega as its handle.

01900845.name: Observation Record of Bright Stars
01900845.description: Observe on the sea in the North Sea.

discovery.name: Deneb
discovery.description: It is the brightest star in the constellation Cygnus, and one of the vertices of the Summer Triangle. The name Deneb is derived from 'dhaneb', the Arabic word for 'tail'.

01900846.name: Student's Observation Record
01900846.description: Observe on the sea in the Central Atlantic Ocean.

discovery.name: The Summer Triangle
discovery.description: An astronomical asterism involving an imaginary triangle drawn on the northern hemisphere's celestial sphere. It covers the milky way, and is used as a mark to search for other stars and constellations.

01900847.name: Observation Record of Saturn
01900847.description: Observe on the sea in the Gulf of Guinea.

discovery.name: Saturn's Ring
discovery.description: A ring which surrounds Saturn. The existence of the ring was found by the early telescope, but observing it was difficult. Once the function quality of the telescope was enhanced, observations of the ring became successful. However it is still unknown as to what it is made up of.

01900848.name: Observation Record of Venus
01900848.description: Observe on the sea in the Gulf of Mexico.

archives.discovery: Waxing and Waning of the Venus

discovery.name: Waxing and Waning of the Venus
discovery.description: Venus not only waxes and wanes like the Moon does, but also it appears to be a different size depending on the time. This creates the solid evidence of Venus revolving around the sun, and not the earth.

01900849.name: Observation Record of Jupiter
01900849.description: Observe on the sea in the Southwest Atlantic Ocean.

discovery.name: Galilean Satellites
discovery.description: Pointing to the four satellites revolving around Jupiter, the Galilean satellite has a brightness of five to six magnitudes and would be able to be seen with the naked eye if the planet Jupiter was not so bright.

01900850.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900850.description: Observe on the sea in the Arabian Sea.

discovery.name: Spiral Nebula of Andromeda
discovery.description: A nebula shaped like a spiral in the constellation of Andromeda. It is at the position equal to the right side of the waist of the Andromeda, and can be seen with the naked eye.

01900851.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900851.description: Observe on the sea off the coast of the Cape of Good Hope.

archives.location: Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea

discovery.name: The Large Magellanic Cloud
discovery.description: Named after Magellan as he kept records during his travel across the world. Prior to Magellan, European voyagers referred to it as the Cape Clouds. It cannot be seen in the Northern Hemisphere unless one heads south towards the equator.

01900853.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900853.description: Observe on the sea off the coast of the Gold Coast.

discovery.name: Orion's Umbrella-like Nebula
discovery.description: A nebula in the center of three small stars attending to the south of the three stars of Orion. It is one of the brighter nebulas, and can be seen with the naked eye.

01900854.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900854.description: Observe on the sea off the coast of Madeira.

discovery.name: Rose-shaped Nebula of Monoceros
discovery.description: A rose-shaped nebula located in the north of the Monoceros. It is within the Milky Way, and cannot be seen with the naked eye.

01900855.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900855.description: Observe on the sea off the coast of Antilles.

discovery.name: The Horsehead Nebula of Orion
discovery.description: It is a nebula located just to the south of the star which is farthest east on Orion's Belt. In front of the brighter cloud, a dark cloud in the shape of a horse's head can be seen.

01900856.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900856.description: Observe on the sea in the Bay of Biscay.

discovery.name: A Ring-like Nebula in Lyra
discovery.description: A nebula in the constellation of Lyra. The center is slightly dark, and can be seen with a ring containing various colours.

01900857.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900857.description: Observe on the sea off the coast of Namibia.

discovery.name: A Trifurcated Nebula in Sagittarius
discovery.description: A nebula in the constellation of Sagittarius. It is seen as though the brighter cloud is split into three by the darker cloud.

01900858.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900858.description: Observe on the sea in the Northeast Atlantic Ocean.

discovery.name: Quadrantids
discovery.description: A meteor shower which appears as if it is shooting out from the constellation, Quadrans Muralis. It can only be seen once a year, and only for a few hours.

01900859.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900859.description: Observe on the sea in the South Atlantic Ocean.

discovery.name: Spiral Nebula in Triangulum
discovery.description: Located slightly west of the Triangulum, it is a nebula shaped like a whirlpool. Because it is spread out faintly, it is difficult to see with the naked eye.

01900860.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900860.description: Observe on the sea in the North Atlantic Ocean.

archives.discovery: Parent and Child Nebula in Canes Venatici

discovery.name: Parent and Child Nebula in Canes Venatici
discovery.description: A nebula in the Canes Venatici. Spiral shaped, it appears as though the small and large nebulas are connected.

01900861.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900861.description: Observe on the sea in the North Atlantic Ocean.

discovery.name: Spiral Nebula of Canes Venatici
discovery.description: A spiral shaped nebula in the Canes Venatici. Though it cannot be seen with the naked eye, through a telescope the differences can be noticed between the nebula and the fixed star.

01900862.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900862.description: Observe on the sea in the East Mediterranean.

discovery.name: Spiral Nebula of Coma Berenices
discovery.description: The spiral-shaped nebula in the Coma Berenices. The main feature is its clear black cloud.

01900863.name: Records of North American Development
01900863.description: Records of the development taking place on the west coast of North America.

01900864.name: Records of North American Development
01900864.description: Records of the development taking place in the suburbs of Tacoma.

01900865.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900865.description: Outside the gate of Tacoma, northwest of the gate.

discovery.name: Bones of Long-crested Dragon
discovery.description: Bones of a dragon with a long crest which was discovered in North America. Judging from the size of its head, its body is estimated to be fairly large.

01900866.name: Map of Coastal Seal
01900866.description: On the sea north of Tacoma. Close to the shore.

discovery.name: Harbour Seal
discovery.description: A seal that inhabits the northern parts of the Pacific and Atlantic Oceans. It has ring-like patterns on its body and lives around rocky places or reefs.

01900867.name: Map of Small Whale
01900867.description: On the sea southwest of Tacoma.

discovery.name: Minke Whale
discovery.description: The small whale which inhabits the northern sea areas above the equator. They inhabit the outer ocean and migrate exclusively.

01900868.name: Map of Spotted Whale
01900868.description: In the coast area in the Gulf of Alaska.

discovery.name: Gray Whale
discovery.description: A slightly small whale that migrates around the northern coast of North America and Eurasia. Their main features are the sea shells placed on their black skin which appear as a pattern.

01900869.name: Unfinished Map
01900869.description: Outside the gate of Tacoma, northeast of the gate

discovery.name: Moraine Lake
discovery.description: The lake in a place of high elevation in western North America. It is said to have been formed by the melting of glacial ice. During the summer season, it becomes filled with water. When the sand that flows into it becomes refracted by the sunlight, the water's surface becomes dyed a beautiful turquoise blue.

01900870.name: Map of Giant Tree
01900870.description: Land at the North America West Coast. Near the upturned boulder to the Northeast.

discovery.name: Sequoia
discovery.description: A type of cedar which grows in western North America. Being able to grow extremely tall in height, some of them could easily reach up to 100m. It is surrounded by thick bark and is apparently strong against forest fires.

01900871.name: Unusual Bird Map
01900871.description: Outside the gate of Wanganui. Near the Large Boulder.

discovery.name: Laughing Owl
discovery.description: A bird characterized by its strange call usually described as a stifled laugh or a whistle. Previously it was not that rare of an animal, but due to the environmental changes in its habitat, they could potentially become extinct due to their rapid decrease in population.

discovery.name: Mauna Kea
discovery.description: A mountain located in the north part of the Island of Hawaii. Being the tallest mountain in the Hawaii islands, it becomes snowcapped during the winter. The main feature is its incredibly large mountain shape.

01900874.name: Map of Oceanian God Statue
01900874.description: In the town of Hiva Oa. Near the gate to the East.

discovery.name: Statue of Kanaloa
discovery.description: One of the four major gods widely known in both Hawaii and Polynesia. Aside from being considered the god of the sea, it is also seen as the god of magic and the underworld. Often depicted in the form of either a squid or an octopus, it is also referred to as Tangaroa.

discovery.name: The Aleutian Islands
discovery.description: A chain of islands which extend from the Kamchatka Peninsula to the North American Alaskan Peninsula. It acts as the border between the Bering Sea and the Pacific Ocean.

01900877.name: Unfinished Map
01900877.description: On the coast of the island northwest of Hawaii.

discovery.name: Diamond Head
discovery.description: A mountain located on the island northwest from the Island of Hawaii. There seems to a crater that apparently used to emit a large quantity of volcanic smoke. It was named after a transparent stone, resembling a diamond, was found near the mountaintop.

01900878.name: Map of Large Leopard
01900878.description: Land at Upper Euphrates. Head Northwest.

discovery.name: Persian Leopard
discovery.description: The largest leopard subspecies inhabiting the Middle East. Unlike the average leopard, it has spots on both its chest and stomach.

01900879.name: Unfinished Map
01900879.description: Land at Upper Euphrates. Head West-Northwest.

discovery.name: The Mesopotamian Marshes
discovery.description: A wetland area located in the lower Tigris Euphrates. It is a part of the Fertile Crescent, and since ancient times, it has been prosperous in agriculture.

01900880.name: Observation Record of Bright Stars
01900880.description: Observe on the water in the Black Sea.

discovery.name: Algol
discovery.description: A star included within the constellation Perseus. The star's brightness changes approximately every three days. Algol is said to mean the Demon Star, and according to the star map, it is located at the head of Medusa that Perseus is carrying.

01900881.name: Observation Record of Bright Stars
01900881.description: Observe in the Mesopotamian River Basin.

discovery.name: Alphard
discovery.description: The brightest star within the constellation Hydra. It means 'the solitary one' in Arabic. As it is located at what could be the heart of Hydra, it is also referred to as 'Cor Hydrae', meaning 'snake's heart'.

01900882.name: Observation Record of Bright Stars
01900882.description: Observe on the sea in the Persian Bay.

discovery.name: Albireo
discovery.description: According to the star map, it is the star located at the head of the constellation Cygnus. When looking through a telescope, you can see it is a double star consisting of the brighter yellow one and the fainter blue one.

01900883.name: Observation Record of Bright Stars
01900883.description: Observe on the sea in the Northern Britain Island.

discovery.name: Erakis
discovery.description: A red star that is included in the constellation Cepheus. Because of its very fine, deep garnet colour, it later started being referred to as the 'Garnet Star'.

01900884.name: Observation Record of Bright Stars
01900884.description: Observe on the sea in the Argentine Sea Basin.

discovery.name: Achernar
discovery.description: It is the brightest star in the constellation Eridanus which is located at the southern end of the constellation. It stands out well in the Southern Hemisphere, but the areas you can observe it from in the Northern Hemisphere are limited.

01900885.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900885.description: Observe on the sea in the Baltic Sea.

discovery.name: The Cat's Eye Nebula
discovery.description: A nebula in the constellation Draco, that is shaped like a cat eye. It seems to have an incredibly complex composition.

01900887.name: Map of Cretan Goddess Figurine
01900887.description: Inland Crete, the outskirts of Candia. Near the ruins.

discovery.name: Snake Goddess Figurine
discovery.description: A goddess figurine found on Crete. Its hands hold a snake, and there is a lion on top of its hat. From the fact that women and snakes were considered sacred, and snakes and lions were symbols of mother goddess, it is certain that this figurine was an object to worship for the local people.

01900888.name: Map of Squirrel Living in Burrow
01900888.description: Outside the gate of Salonika. Near the lone cedar in the Southeast.

discovery.name: European Ground Squirrel
discovery.description: A squirrel found throughout eastern Europe, which grows to a length of approximately 20 centimeters. They live in colonies of individual burrows in pastures or grassy embankments. They feed upon seeds, plant shoots, and roots, and have a habit of taking food back to their nest by carrying it in their mouths.

01900889.name: Unfinished Map
01900889.description: The map of the islands on the sea north of Candia.

discovery.name: Cyclades
discovery.description: One of the island groups in the Aegean Sea, comprised of about 220 islands. The island which was the most important religious site in ancient Greek is surrounded by the other islands. The name, Cyclades, refers to those surrounding islands.

01900890.name: Unfinished Map
01900890.description: The map of the peninsula on the sea northwest of Candia.

discovery.name: Peloponnese
discovery.description: A peninsula located in the southernmost part of Greece. It is connected with the mainland Greece by the narrow land bridge called the Isthmus of Corinth. It has a mountainous interior and deeply indented coasts. It has many ruins, indicating that it's been a prosperous area since ancient times.

01900891.name: Unfinished Map
01900891.description: The map of the large island on the sea southeast of Athens.

discovery.name: Crete
discovery.description: Located in the southern Aegean Sea, and the largest of the Greek islands. Being the center of the Cretan civilization, it has a large number of ruins which include the Knossos Palace.

01900899.name: Map of King's Stele
01900899.description: Northern Ethiopia, the outskirts of Massawa. Near the table boulder.

01900900.name: Map of Temple's Relief
01900900.description: The inland of South Pondicherry. Near the large boulder in the South.

01900907.name: Map of King's Relief
01900907.description: Mayan Lowlands, the inland of South Veracruz. Near the palace in the South.

01900912.name: Map of Paekche King's Stele
01900912.description: Land at the Korean Peninsula West Coast. Proceed inland to Northern Kongju. Near the red flowers to the Northeast.

01900913.name: Map of Lovely Little Flower
01900913.description: Land at the Korean Peninsula North Coast. Near the stacked boulders to the North-Northeast.

01900915.name: Map of Hero's Story
01900915.description: Outside the gate of Nagasaki. Near the diagonal boulder.

01900917.name: Map of Aligned Stone Pillars
01900917.description: Land at the Taiwan Southeast Coast. Near the red flowers to the East.

01900918.name: Map of Goddess Statue of Mount Tai
01900918.description: Outside the gate of Yuntaishan. Near the table boulder.

01900919.name: Map of Stone Buddhist Pagoda
01900919.description: Land at the Yellow River Downstream. Proceed inland to the Loess Plateau. Near the giant dead tree.

01900920.name: Map of Viking Shield
01900920.description: Land at the Newfoundland North Coast. Proceed inland to the Cape of Vinland. To the Northwest.

01900921.name: Unfinished Map
01900921.description: Land at the Black Sea East Coast. Proceed inland to Caucasus. To the Southeast.

01900922.name: Unfinished Map
01900922.description: Land at the Black Sea East Coast. Proceed inland to Caucasus. To the Northwest.

01900923.name: Map of Large-Nosed Animal
01900923.description: Land at the Black Sea East Coast. Proceed inland to Caucasus. Near the stacked boulders.

discovery.name: Saiga
discovery.description: An antelope recognized by an unusual, over-sized nose. Hunted extensively as food and for their fur. The horn is considered an effective medicine, but it's not certain.

01900924.name: Map of Healing Necklace
01900924.description: Land at the Baltic Sea North. Proceed inland to the West Siberian Plain. To the East.

01900925.name: Map of Vein of Color-Shifting Gemstones
01900925.description: Land at the Baltic Sea North. Proceed inland to the West Siberian Plain. To the Southwest.

01900926.name: Map of Aquatic Mole
01900926.description: Land at the Baltic Sea North. Proceed inland to the West Siberian Plain. To the East.

01900927.name: Map of Agile Dog
01900927.description: Land at the Baltic Sea North. Proceed inland to the West Siberian Plain. To the Northeast.

01900928.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900928.description: Observe from the Gulf of Mexico.

archives.discovery: Spiral Galaxy in the Virgo Cluster

discovery.name: Spiral Galaxy in the Virgo Cluster
discovery.description: A spiral galaxy in the constellation Virgo. The dark dust lane and the bulge give this galaxy the appearance of the Mexican hat, a sombrero.

01900929.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900929.description: Observe from Cape Cod, open sea.

discovery.name: Bird-shaped Galaxy in Ophiuchus
discovery.description: A bird-shaped galaxy located between the constellation Ophiuchus and the constellation Sagittarius. It has a large number of small stars.

discovery.name: Dumbbell Nebula in Vulpecula
discovery.description: A planetary nebula in the constellation Vulpecula. Characterized by its oval shape and its narrow central part.

discovery.name: Flower-like Nebula in Cepheus
discovery.description: A spiral galaxy located near the star around the waist of the constellations Cepheus. Its shape and color are associated with a blue flower.

01900932.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900932.description: Observe on the sea in the North Atlantic Ocean.

discovery.name: Trifid Nebula in Sagittarius
discovery.description: A nebula located in the west of the constellation Sagittarius. It is an unusual combination of different types of nebulas including a dark nebula. It can be observed with the naked eye under good conditions of darkness.

discovery.name: Alnair
discovery.description: The brightest star in the constellation Grus. The name is from Arabic, meaning 'the bright one of the tail.' It was part of the constellation Piscis Austrinu in the past.

01900934.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900934.description: Observe from Cape of Good Hope, open sea.

archives.location: Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea

discovery.name: Eta Aquariids
discovery.description: A meteor shower associated with Halley's Comet. It appears to be coming out from the direction of the water jar of the constellation, Aquarius.

01900935.name: Observation Record of Bright Stars
01900935.description: Observe from the Southwest Indian Ocean.

discovery.name: Hadar
discovery.description: A first-magnitude star located around what could be the foot of the constellation Centaurus. The name comes from Arabic, meaning 'on the ground.'

discovery.name: Rigil Centaurus
discovery.description: A first-magnitude star located around what could be the foot of the constellation Centaurus. The name means 'the foot of the Centaur.'

discovery.name: Globular Cluster in Centaurus
discovery.description: A globular cluster located at what could be the horse's back of the constellation Centaurus. Can be observed with the naked eye. It had been called 'Omega Centauri' until it was recognised as a globular cluster in the 19th century.

01900938.name: Unfinished Map
01900938.description: On the sea north of Syracuse.

discovery.name: Isola Bella
discovery.description: A small island located in the north of Syracuse on Sicily. The water clarity of the surrounding sea coupled with the shape of the island creates breathtaking beauty.

01900939.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01900939.description: Outside of the gate of Tunis. West of the gate.

discovery.name: Skull of Horse-like Elephant
discovery.description: A skull of an animal which has a long face like a horse and tusks like an elephant.

01900940.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900940.description: Observe from Buenos Aires, Open Sea.

discovery.name: The Sculptor Galaxy
discovery.description: A spiral galaxy which lies between Sculptor and Cetus. It's a bright galaxy, but Europe is too far North to be able to observe it.

discovery.name: Orionids
discovery.description: A meteor shower which can be seen in October every year. It appears to originate from the point located between the constellations Orion and Gemini. They are believed to be produced by Halley's Comet.

01900942.name: Map of Ancient Stone Ware
01900942.description: Land at Africa, South-Southeast Coast and proceed inland to Zambezi River, Midstream. Near the large boulder in the West.

01900943.name: Map of an Ancient Wall Painting
01900943.description: Land at Africa, North Coast and proceed inland to the Sahara. Near the large boulder in the Northwest.

01900944.name: Map of a Southern African God Statue
01900944.description: Land at Africa, South-Southeast Coast and proceed inland to Zambezi River, Midstream. At the northern end.

01900945.name: Map of a Spider-like Insect
01900945.description: Land at Africa, North Coast and proceed inland to the Sahara. Near the table boulder to the South.

01900946.name: Map of a Bizarre Lizard
01900946.description: Land at Africa, South-Southeast Coast and proceed inland to Zambezi River, Midstream. The red flowers.

01900947.name: Unfinished Map
01900947.description: Land at Africa, North Coast and proceed inland to the Sahara. Near the bones of a mammal.

01900948.name: Insect Habitat Map
01900948.description: Land at Africa, North Coast and proceed inland to the Sahara. Near the large boulder to the West.

discovery.name: Sahara Desert Ant
discovery.description: An ant that lives in the Sahara, that has an excellent sense of direction. Even if they wander here and there looking for food, they can find their way back to their nest in a straight line. Furthermore, even if the wind changes the shape of the sand dunes, they never get lost.

01900949.name: Unusual Bird Map
01900949.description: Land at Africa, South-Southeast Coast and proceed inland to Zambezi River, Midstream. The red flowers.

discovery.name: Saddle-Billed Stork
discovery.description: A large bird that lives in the wetlands stretching from Central to Southern Africa. It's name comes from the yellow spot on the base of its bill, which looks like a saddle. It has a spot on its breast with no feathers, which it uses to keep its eggs warm when nesting.

01900950.name: Unusual Bird Map
01900950.description: Land at Africa, South-Southeast Coast and proceed inland to Zambezi River, Midstream. The diagonal boulder.

discovery.name: Wattled Crane
discovery.description: A crane that lives in the wetlands of Southern Africa. Its neck and head are white, and the feathers on its body are dark. It's characteristic feature is the wattle which hangs below its cheeks. Also, from the base of its beak and around its face, it has no feathers, with exposed red skin.

01900951.name: Map of Squirrel Living in Burrow
01900951.description: Land at the Africa South Coast. Near the large cactus to the West.

discovery.name: Cape Ground Squirrel
discovery.description: A member of the squirrel family that inhabits the arid region of Southern Africa. It lives in a burrow underground. Unlike squirrels that live in trees, it doesn't store food, but spends most of the day eating. If it senses danger, it alerts its fellow squirrels with a bird-like call.

01900952.name: Map of a Bizarre Lizard
01900952.description: Land at Africa, North Coast and proceed inland to the Sahara. Near the table boulder to the South.

discovery.name: Bell's Dabb Lizard
discovery.description: A herbivorous lizard that lives in the Sahara. They can grow to over 40cm long. It's thick tail is covered in spiny scales, and it attacks with it when protecting itself. It is mostly active in the daytime, but when the heat is too intense it will hide in a hole.

01900953.name: Map of a Bizarre Lizard
01900953.description: Land at Africa, South-Southeast Coast. Head Northwest.

discovery.name: Giant Girdled Lizard
discovery.description: A lizard that lives on the grasslands in Southeastern Africa. Large ones will reach 40cm long. It has hardened scales on its back, which is the source of its name. It seems to love basking in the sun.

01900954.name: Map of a Pig-like Animal
01900954.description: Land at Africa, West Coast. Near the upturned boulder in the Southeast.

discovery.name: Common Warthog
discovery.description: An animal that can be seen in sub-Saharan Africa. Its appearance resembles a boar, and it has the wart-like bump under each eye. Watching them sprint with all their might with their tails sticking up is somehow entertaining.

01900955.name: Map of a Horned Animal
01900955.description: Land at Africa, North Coast and proceed inland to the Sahara. The table boulder in the South.

discovery.name: Scimitar Oryx
discovery.description: A herbivorous animal that lives around the edge of the Sahara, with characteristic long, bent backward horns. They migrate North and South with the seasons, in large herds. They can withstand dry conditions, able to go a long time without drinking, but when there is water available, they will drink a lot.

01900956.name: Colourful Fish Map
01900956.description: Land at the Africa South-Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Zambezi River Midstream. To the North.

discovery.name: Mbuna
discovery.description: A freshwater fish with a vivid striped pattern, that lives in Lake Malawi. They are very territorial, and each individual's pattern is slightly different. It seems that the stronger the fish is, the clearer the pattern is.

01900957.name: Map of a Fruit Tree
01900957.description: Land at Africa, West Coast. Head Northeast.

discovery.name: Shea Tree
discovery.description: A tree that grows in the Savannah, South of the Sahara, and can be 7m to 20m tall. It is able to grow even in areas with little rain. A high-quality oil, Shea Butter, can be harvested from its seeds, and it is used as a food and a medicine.

01900958.name: Map of an Ancient Wall Painting
01900958.description: Land at the Africa South-Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Zambezi River Midstream. To the Northwest.

archives.prerequisite: The Rock Paintings of Tsodilo Hills

requirements.name: The Rock Paintings of Tsodilo Hills

discovery.name: Chongoni Rock Art
discovery.description: Paintings that appear on rocks and in caves across a wide area of Southeastern Africa. The drawings of hunters are especially ancient, and the sites have been used in ceremonies for a long time.

01900959.name: Unfinished Map
01900959.description: Land at the Africa South-Southwest Coast. Head North-Northeast from the large boulder, to the North.

discovery.name: Okavango River
discovery.description: A river that flows in the arid region of Southwest of Africa. It is an inland river that does not flow to the ocean, so huge wetlands form at its lower reaches. It is a valuable resource for the life around the river basin.

01900960.name: Unfinished Map
01900960.description: Land at Africa, South-Southwest Coast. Head to the Northeast end.

discovery.name: Makgadikgadi Salt Flats
discovery.description: One of the World's largest salt flats, in the South of Africa. Several rivers flow in, but only during the rainy season they fill with water and become saltwater lakes. Many different animals come looking for salt, water, and grass.

01900961.name: Map of a Long, Thin Fish
01900961.description: On the sea northeast of San Juan.

discovery.name: Slender Snipe Eel
discovery.description: A deep sea fish, whose characteristic features are its long, thin body, and protruding jaw. It's thought to use it for hunting crustaceans.

01900962.name: Map of an Eccentric Octopus
01900962.description: Bermuda, Open Sea, to the East.

discovery.name: Flapjack Octopus
discovery.description: A species of deep sea octopus. Different to other octopi, it only has one row of suction cups on each tentacle. Its body is so soft that it will collapse if it leaves water. As it has a briny taste and strong smell, it's not very suitable for eating.

discovery.name: Scutum
discovery.description: A constellation designated in 1684 by a Polish astronomer, Hevelius, in commemoration of King John III Sobieski. John III was hailed for his courage in the Battle of Vienna.

01900964.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900964.description: Observe on the Argentine Sea Basin.

discovery.name: Dorado
discovery.description: A constellation near the Large Magellanic Cloud. Plotted at the end of the 16th century by Frederick de Houtman and Pieter Dirkszoon Keyser.

01900965.name: Unfinished Map
01900965.description: South Greenland Sea, the South of Iceland.

discovery.name: Hekla
discovery.description: A volcano in the South of Iceland. Hekla means 'hood' in Icelandic. It is the most active volcano in Iceland, and many eruptions have been recorded.

01900966.name: Unfinished Map
01900966.description: South Caribbean Sea, the island in the Southeast.

discovery.name: Trinidad
discovery.description: An island to the North of continental South America. On the South side of the island there is a channel called the Serpent's Mouth, and on the North side there is one called the Dragon's Mouth. It is an island where the beauty of tropical nature can be appreciated.

01900967.name: Unfinished Map
01900967.description: At sea far to the West of Cape Town, the South Atlantic Ocean.

discovery.name: Tristan da Cunha
discovery.description: A volcanic island in the South Atlantic Ocean. It is named after the Portuguese explorer who discovered it at the beginning of the 16th century. It's hoped it can be used as a resupply and refuge port.

01900968.name: Unfinished Map
01900968.description: Cape San Roque, Open Sea, Northeast from the cape.

discovery.name: Fernando de Noronha
discovery.description: An archipelago of 21 islands, located off the coast of Cape Sao Roque.

01900969.name: Map of a Strange Tool
01900969.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. To the Northeast.

01900970.name: Map of a Tea Plant
01900970.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. To the North.

01900971.name: Map of a Running Bird
01900971.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. The northern corner.

01900972.name: Map of a Fruit Tree
01900972.description: Land at the Amazon River Upstream. Proceed to the Amazon Inland. Head West from the entrance.

01900973.name: Map of a Big-eyed Bird
01900973.description: Land at the Amazon River Upstream. Proceed to the Amazon Inland. Near the large boulder to the South.

01900974.name: Map of a Bizarre Frog
01900974.description: Land at the Amazon River Upstream. Proceed to the Amazon Inland. To the Southwest.

01900975.name: Egyptian Goddess Map
01900975.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. Near the oasis to the Northwest.

discovery.name: Statue of Neith
discovery.description: Neith is the goddess of war and weaving. She is usually portrayed bearing a shuttle on her head, and an arrow in her hand.

01900976.name: Map of a Marble Statue
01900976.description: Outside the gate of Salonika. Near the giant dead tree to the Southeast.

discovery.name: Head of a Cyclops Statue
discovery.description: A Cyclops is a one-eyed giant in Greek mythology. In ruins of the Mycenaean civilization there are a number of structures with huge stones stacked up, which is believed to have been done by a Cyclops.

discovery.name: Stratagems in War
discovery.description: A book written by Polyaenus. One of the episodes is about Cambyses II, emperor of the Achaemenid Empire, who tactfully used cats which are regarded as sacred animals in Egypt, when he attacked the town of Pelusium.

discovery.name: Bibliotheca
discovery.description: A compendium of Greek myths and heroic legends, which had not yet been influenced by Roman mythology. Chronologically compiled from the 'origin of the world' to the Trojan War.

01900980.name: Old Egyptian Relic Map
01900980.description: Land at Central Nile. Proceed inland to Luxor. To the South.

discovery.name: Senet
discovery.description: A board game from predynastic and ancient Egypt. Often placed in the grave alongside other objects.

01900981.name: Old Egyptian Relic Map
01900981.description: Land at the Shore Opposite Cairo. Proceed inland to Giza. To the Southwest.

discovery.name: Uraeus
discovery.description: A representation of an Egyptian cobra, used as a symbol of sovereignty, royalty, deity and divine authority in ancient Egypt. Made of gold and gemstones.

discovery.name: Argonautica
discovery.description: A Greek epic poem that tells the myth of the voyage of Jason and his fifty heroic companions in their giant ship, the Argo, to retrieve the Golden Fleece from the remote Colchis.

01900983.name: Unfinished Map
01900983.description: On the sea east of Syracuse.

discovery.name: Mount Etna
discovery.description: The tallest active volcano in Europe, located on the east coast of Sicily. A number of eruptions have been recorded in the literature of every age. In Greek Mythology, the deadly monster Typhon was trapped under this mountain by Zeus.

01900984.name: Unfinished Map
01900984.description: On the sea east of Athens.

discovery.name: Samos
discovery.description: A Greek island in the eastern Aegean Sea. Believed to be the birthplace of the goddess Hera; it has a temple enshrining her. The Greek mathematician Pythagoras was born on this island.

01900985.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900985.description: Observe from the Southeast Indian Ocean.

discovery.name: Triangulum Australe
discovery.description: A small constellation near Centaurus. Consisting of three of the brightest stars that shape a triangle. Was depicted on a celestial globe by a Dutch astronomer, Petrus Plancius.

01900986.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900986.description: Observe from the South Pacific Ocean Basin.

discovery.name: Carina
discovery.description: A constellation in the southern sky, which contains the second brightest star in the night sky, Canopus. Represents the keel of the ship Argo.

01900987.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900987.description: Observe from the South Australian Sea Basin.

discovery.name: Volans
discovery.description: A constellation in the southern sky. It represents a flying fish. In celestial maps, the flying fish was often depicted as being chased by the predatory fish represented by the adjoining constellation Dorado.

01900988.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01900988.description: Observe from the Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea.

archives.location: Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea

discovery.name: Flower-like Nebula in Carina
discovery.description: Diffuse nebula located in the constellation Carina. Although it is four times as large and even brighter than the famous Orion Nebula, the Carina Nebula is not as well known, due to its location in the southern sky.

01900989.name: Unfinished Map
01900989.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. Near the gate.

discovery.name: Pantanal
discovery.description: The world's largest tropical wetland area located around the upstream of the Paraguay River. Roughly 80% of the Pantanal floodplains are submerged during the rainy seasons. Essential sanctuaries for a wide variety of plants and animals.

01900990.name: Map of a Tropical Fruit Tree
01900990.description: Outside the gate of Guatemala. Near the red flowers to the North.

discovery.name: Guava
discovery.description: A small tree native to the Caribbean, Central America and South America. The fruit were eaten by the local people since ancient times. However, the leaves started to be used for making tea after Guava was introduced to Southeast Asia in the 16th to 17th century.

01900991.name: Map of a Beautiful Butterfly
01900991.description: Outside the gate of Panama. Near the red flowers to the East.

discovery.name: Haeterini
discovery.description: A butterfly found in the tropical rainforests in Central and South America. The winds are clear as a glass. The hindwings have faded red and purple patterns.

01900992.name: Map of a Luminous Insect
01900992.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. To the Northwest.

discovery.name: Fire Beetles
discovery.description: A bioluminescent click beetle that inhabits in Central America and South America. The light they emit is said to be the brightest among other bioluminescent insects.

01900993.name: Map of a Bird with a Black Head
01900993.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. To the Northeast.

discovery.name: Jabiru
discovery.description: A large stork most common in the Pantanal. An adult jabiru is 120-140 cm long, 2.3-2.8 m across the wings. Their head is featherless.

01900994.name: White Bird Map
01900994.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. In the central area.

discovery.name: White Woodpecker
discovery.description: A species of woodpecker commonly found in the Pantanal. Can perch on vertical surfaces of trees, but don't drill or drum on trees like some other members of the same family.

01900995.name: Map of a Bird with a Stripe
01900995.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. In the central area.

discovery.name: Picui Ground Dove
discovery.description: A species of dove commonly found in the Pantanal. They have a single blue line on each shoulder. Although they are doves, they are comparable to sparrows in size.

01900996.name: Map of a Bird with a Black Belly
01900996.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. To the East.

discovery.name: Buff-necked Ibis
discovery.description: A fairly large ibis commonly found in the Pantanal. Their neck is buffish, their upperparts are grey, and their belly and flight feathers are black.

01900997.name: Map of a Squirrel-like Animal
01900997.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. To the Northwest.

discovery.name: Agouti
discovery.description: A 50-70 cm long rodent commonly found in forested and wooded areas in Central and South America. Their appearance is like a squirrel but bigger in size, and has longer legs and a shorter tail. They are active and graceful in their movements.

01900998.name: Map of an Animal with a Long Face
01900998.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. In the central area.

discovery.name: Paca
discovery.description: A 60-80 cm long rodent with dots and stripes on their sides, that inhabits South and Central America. They are great swimmers and prefer to be near water.

01900999.name: Map of an Animal with an Armour Shell
01900999.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. The red flowers.

discovery.name: Giant Armadillo
discovery.description: The largest living species of armadillo found widely throughout the tropical rainforests of South America. They have a typical length of 75-100 cm. Their head and back is covered with armour bands.

01901000.name: Large Deer Map
01901000.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. The red flowers.

discovery.name: Marsh Deer
discovery.description: The largest deer species from South America reaching a length of 2 m, commonly found in the Pantanal. Only the males possess antlers which are ramified and reach a length of 60 cm.

01901001.name: Map of a Black Crocodile
01901001.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Proceed inland to the Paraguay River Upstream. To the Southeast.

discovery.name: Black Caiman
discovery.description: A large crocodilian found in the central region of South America, growing to sizes of at least 5 m. Has dark-coloured, scaly skin. Fierce enough to attack humans.

01901002.name: Unfinished Map
01901002.description: On the sea east of Amazon River Upstream.

discovery.name: Oxbow Lake
discovery.description: A U-shaped body of water that forms when a wide meander from the main stem of a river is cut off, creating a free-standing body of water. Commonly seen in the Amazon River.

01901003.name: Map of a Fish with Peacock Patterns
01901003.description: On the sea northwest of the Amazon River Upstream.

discovery.name: Tucunare
discovery.description: A tropical, freshwater fish found in the Amazon basin. They have a spot on their tail fins which resembles the eyes on a peacock's tail feathers. Widely consumed as food by the local people.

01901004.name: Map of a Scarlet Fish
01901004.description: On the sea south of Hawaii.

discovery.name: Flame Angelfish
discovery.description: A fish inhabiting central and western parts of the Pacific Ocean. It lives in reefs and coral reefs. It has a bright and dark orange body with black vertical stripes.

01901005.name: Map of a Bizarre Fish
01901005.description: On the sea west of Lambayeque.

discovery.name: Red-lipped Batfish
discovery.description: Fish inhabiting near the Galapagos Islands. The way it swims makes it appear as if it is walking on the ocean floor. Its name comes from the color of its lips.

01901006.name: Unfinished Map
01901006.description: On the sea west of Manchester.

discovery.name: River Mersey
discovery.description: A river flowing in the northwestern part of England. It's used for water supply by places such as Manchester, and when the canal was built, it was also used to support the development of the water industry.

01901007.name: Unfinished Map
01901007.description: On the sea south of Hawaii.

discovery.name: Kiritimati
discovery.description: One of the largest coral reef island in the world, located south of Hawaii. The name means Christmas in the Kiribati language. As British explorer James Cook had reached the island on Christmas eve, the island was given this name.

01901008.name: Unfinished Map
01901008.description: Outside the gate of Merida. To the Southwest.

discovery.name: Cenote
discovery.description: A fountain created by groundwater pooling on the collapsed ground. Can be found in the limestone area of Yucatan Peninsula. In some cases, the limestone cave sinks in the bottom of the water.

01901009.name: Unfinished Map
01901009.description: On the sea east of Zanzibar.

discovery.name: Aldabra
discovery.description: Coral atoll located north of Madagascar Island. In addition to having many turtles inhabit there, various birds and sea turtles also inhabit there.

01901010.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01901010.description: Observe from the Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea.

archives.location: Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea

discovery.name: Vela
discovery.description: A constellation in the Southern Hemisphere. As part of this constellation connects with the constellation Carina to form the shape of a cross, it is easy to mistaken this constellation for another.

01901011.name: Map for Andes Instrument
01901011.description: Outside the north gate of Lima. To the East.

discovery.name: Chajchas
discovery.description: Traditional instrument from Andes typically made with hooves from animals such as llamas. It is worn on the wrist or ankle and creates a sound when shaken.

01901012.name: Map for Southeast Asian Instrument
01901012.description: Land at the Island of Java, North Coast. To the Southwest.

discovery.name: Gambang
discovery.description: Percussion instrument from Indonesia. It is played by striking the arranged bamboo pieces that are on the diaphragm board.

01901013.name: Map for a Hawaiian Bird
01901013.description: In the town of Hawaii. On the beach.

discovery.name: Nene
discovery.description: A goose which inhabits Hawaii. This species can grow up to be as big as 60cm. The name originates from the sound of its soft call.

01901014.name: Unfinished Map
01901014.description: On the sea west of Athens.

discovery.name: Navagio Beach
discovery.description: A cove located on Zakynthos, Greece. It's surrounded by limestone cliffs, white sand beaches and clear blue water.

01901015.name: Unfinished Map
01901015.description: On the sea east of Hawaii.

discovery.name: Punalu'u Beach
discovery.description: A black beach located in Hawaii. The lava expelled from a volcano was crushed finely into black sand and accumulated there to create the beach. The location is famous for being a habitat for sea turtles.

01901016.name: Unfinished Map
01901016.description: On the sea south of K'gari.

discovery.name: Hyams Beach
discovery.description: A beach located in the southeast area of Australia. It's known for its soft and fine white sand which shines brightly.

01901017.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01901017.description: Observe from the Southwest Atlantic Ocean.

discovery.name: Octans
discovery.description: A constellation in the Southern Hemisphere created by Lacaille. Its shape resembles an octant used for star gazing.

01901018.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01901018.description: Observe from the Strait of Mozambique.

discovery.name: Flower-like Nebula of Vela
discovery.description: A nebula which is located near Vela. It's a faint dark nebula which spreads out.

01901019.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01901019.description: Observe on the sea in the Northeast Atlantic Ocean.

discovery.name: Quadrantids
discovery.description: A meteor shower which appears as if it is shooting out from the constellation, Quadrans Muralis. It can only be seen once a year, and only for a few hours.

01901021.name: Holy Man's Note
01901021.description: Clergyman's writings indicating a place in the Baltic Sea South-East.

01901022.name: Holy Man's Note
01901022.description: Clergyman's writings indicating a place in East Havana.

01901023.name: Treasure Map
01901023.description: A map that shows the location of the treasure, said to be hidden in the South America North Coast Plateau.

01901024.name: Holy Man's Note
01901024.description: Clergyman's writings indicating a place in the inland of West Candia.

01901025.name: Hidden Treasure Map
01901025.description: A map that shows the location of a treasure, said to be hidden in the inland of the Amazon River Upstream.

01901026.name: Treasure Map
01901026.description: A map that shows the location of a treasure, said to be hidden in North Lima.

01901027.name: Treasure Map
01901027.description: A map that shows the location of a treasure, said to be hidden in the Island of Java North Coast.

01901028.name: Map of a Tool Used in Competitions
01901028.description: Outside the gate of Tacoma. Proceed inland to the Rocky Mountains. Head East from the gate.

discovery.name: Coup Stick
discovery.description: A winged stick attained by a North American native warrior. It is used for counting coup, a hero's winning of prestige in battles by touching an enemy warrior's stick instead of killing.

01901029.name: Map of Bones of a Large Turtle
01901029.description: Outside the gate of Tacoma. Proceed inland to the Rocky Mountains. Head Northeast from the gate.

discovery.name: Bone of a Giant Turtle
discovery.description: A bone of a sea turtle with the overall length of 4m and the width of 5m. The back is not covered by bones but seems to be covered by some kind of skin.

01901031.name: Map of Bones of a Strange Lizard
01901031.description: Outside the gate of Tacoma. Proceed inland to the Rocky Mountains. Head South from the gate.

01901032.name: Map of Bones of a Large Penguin
01901032.description: Land at the Colorado Plateau. Head North from the gate.

archives.prerequisite: The Bones of a Giant Shark

requirements.name: The Bones of a Giant Shark

discovery.name: Bone of a Giant Penguin
discovery.description: A bone of a creature like a giant penguin found in central North America.

01901033.name: Bizarre Stone Map
01901033.description: Outside the gate of Tacoma. Proceed inland to the Rocky Mountains. Head North from the gate.

discovery.name: Stone of a Spiny Bug
discovery.description: A strange-looking stone found in the Burgess Shale located in the northwest region of North America. It looks like a spiny bug, but its identity is unknown.

01901034.name: Map of a Bizarre Fish
01901034.description: On the sea south of Anping.

discovery.name: Shark Ray
discovery.description: A marine animal that inhabits in and around the Indian Ocean. Its appearance and way of swimming resemble to those of a shark, but it's considered as a stingray. It has a wide, flat head.

01901036.name: Unfinished Map
01901036.description: Outside the gate of Tacoma. Proceed inland to the Rocky Mountains. Head East from the gate.

discovery.name: Mount Elbert
discovery.description: The highest peak of the Rocky Mountains located in the west of the North American continent. It rises 4,400m above the sea level.

01901037.name: Unfinished Map
01901037.description: On the sea north of the Newfoundland North Coast.

discovery.name: Red Bay
discovery.description: A bay located in the northeast part of the North American continent. It's a natural harbor once used as a base for whale hunting.

01901040.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01901040.description: Observe from the East Caroline Sea Basin.

discovery.name: Fornax
discovery.description: A constellation named by Lacaille. It's modeled after a furnace heating a flask.

01901042.name: Map of a Stone Sculpture
01901042.description: Land at the Black Sea Northwest Coast. Head North.

discovery.name: Cumans Stone Statue
discovery.description: Stone statues created by nomadic people whom inhabited the wide grasslands north of the Black Sea and the Caspian Sea. It has been said that perhaps they may have been modeled after their ancestors.

discovery.name: Uranometria
discovery.description: A star atlas published in the early 17th century by a German lawyer, Johann Bayer. It contains records of all constellations in the sky. The star atlas features Greek and Roman letters, making it easier to reference.

01901044.name: Unusual Bird Map
01901044.description: The Kamchatka Peninsula Shores. East of the peninsula.

discovery.name: Spectacled Cormarant
discovery.description: A large bird that inhabits Bering Island, east of Kamchatka Peninsula. Its white skin is exposed around the eyes as there is no fur located in the area around the eyes.

01901045.name: White Bird Map
01901045.description: The coast area in the Sea of Okhotsk. To the North.

discovery.name: Gyrfalcon
discovery.description: A bird that inhabits the alpine belt of the North American continent and the northern part of the Eurasian continent. It has a length of approximately 50 cm and when spreading its wings, its width exceeds 1 meter.

01901047.name: Unfinished Map
01901047.description: Land at the Black Sea East Coast. To the North.

discovery.name: Volga River
discovery.description: A large river that flows over western Russia that reaches over 3,500 kilometers in length. The fertile river valleys provide large quantities of wheat.

01901048.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01901048.description: Observe from Cape of Good Hope, open sea.

archives.location: Cape of Good Hope, Open Sea

discovery.name: Spiral Glaxy in Hydra
discovery.description: A spiral galaxy located in the South of the constellation Hydra. The central part is brighter than its rim. Has very well defined 3 spiral arms stretching from the center.

discovery.name: Ceres
discovery.description: An astronomical object located in the asteroid belt on the outer side of the orbit of Mars. Although it shows similar movements to planets, it is an astronomical object which is smaller than planets.

01901050.name: Map of Bones of a Strange Lizard
01901050.description: Land at the Africa North Coast. Head South.

archives.discovery: Bone of a Lizard with Upward Spine

discovery.name: Bone of a Lizard with Upward Spine
discovery.description: The bone of a large lizard-like creature, discovered in northern regions of the African continent. It has a length of about 15 meters, and features a protrusion extending upwards from the spine.

01901051.name: Map of a Cat Inhabiting the Deserts
01901051.description: Land at the Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea. Head South.

archives.location: Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea

discovery.name: Sand Cat
discovery.description: Small animals which inhabit the desert extending from the Sahara to southwest Asia. Their body size is around 50 centimeters. They have large ears that are covered with hair inside to prevent sand from entering.

01901052.name: Unfinished Map
01901052.description: Land at the Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea. South of the mammal bones.
