archives.location: Africa North Coast South Mediterranean Sea

discovery.name: Guelta d'Archei
discovery.description: A valley located in the southern region of the Sahara. Wetlands which inhabit crocodiles are formed from the groundwater flowing out. Additionally, as it was a location in which people have made use of in ancient times, there are also ancient murals remaining in the area.

01901053.name: Unfinished Map
01901053.description: Land at the Morocco West Coast. To the South.

discovery.name: Todra Gorge
discovery.description: A majestic valley located in northwest Africa. It features a stunning landscape with cliffs lined up together.

discovery.name: Pallas
discovery.description: An astronomical object located in the asteroid belt on the outer orbit of Mars. It is said to have a size larger than the astronomical object, Ceres.

discovery.name: Meteor Shower of Ganymede
discovery.description: A meteor shower which appear from the direction of the right leg of Aquarius. This activity can be seen for approximately 1 month each year. As there are other meteor showers which occur around the same time, it is rarely spotted by itself.

01901057.name: Unfinished Map
01901057.description: Land at the Bay of Bengal North Coast. To the South.

01901059.name: Plants Habitat Map
01901059.description: Land at the Bay of Bengal North Coast. Near the pointed boulder.

01901071.name: Map of a Sharp Stone Tool
01901071.description: Land at the Sea of Okhotsk West Coast. Head North.

discovery.name: Microlith
discovery.description: A type of chipped stone tool. Combined with a handle, it is treated as a tool with interchangeable ends. Widely excavated all around the world.

01901072.name: Map to a Stone with Carved Writings
01901072.description: Land at the Bay of Bengal North Coast. Near the Giant Dead Tree.

discovery.name: Mani Stones
discovery.description: Stones with sutras and mantras carved in them. Can be found in regions with believers of Tibetan Buddhism. It is said that when walking pass these stones, it is better to walk with your right shoulder facing the stones.

01901073.name: Map of a Frozen Beast
01901073.description: Land at the Siberia. Near the large boulder in the Southwest.

discovery.name: Frozen Lion
discovery.description: A frozen lion cub. Without reports of finding other lions of the same species within the area, it is unknown when this cub traveled to Siberia and fell into slumber.

01901074.name: Map of a Transparent Fish
01901074.description: Land at the Sea of Okhotsk West Coast. Proceed inland to Lake Baikal. Near the Large Ice.

discovery.name: Comephorus
discovery.description: Deep sea fish inhabiting Lake Baikal. These fish do not have scales or bladders, but it is capable of floating due to its abundant amount of fat.

01901075.name: Map of a Fish Inhabiting a Lake
01901075.description: Land at the Sea of Okhotsk West Coast. Proceed inland to Lake Baikal. Near the stacked boulders.

discovery.name: Omul
discovery.description: A salmon-like fish inhabiting Lake Baikal. During spawning season, it swims up to the river to lay its eggs and returns to the lake afterwards. This fish is quite delicious when eaten.

01901076.name: Unfinished Map
01901076.description: Land at the Bay of Bengal North Coast. Near the Stacked Boulders.

discovery.name: Kathmandu Valley
discovery.description: A valley within the Himalayas. Within the area exists three kingdoms which have developed some sort of complicated political situation with each other.

01901077.name: Unfinished Map
01901077.description: Land at the Sea of Okhotsk West Coast. Proceed inland to Lake Baikal. Near the stacked boulders.

discovery.name: Shaman's Rock
discovery.description: A rock mountain worshipped by nearby shamans. It is said that you can prove your innocence by praying within that area for an entire day without being frozen to death.

01901078.name: Map of a Beautiful Box
01901078.description: Land at the Baltic Sea North. Proceed inland. Near the Upturned Boulder.

discovery.name: Beresta
discovery.description: An accessory case made in Russia. It's made with the skin of white birch. It is highly valued as a work of art due to its delicate decorations.

01901079.name: Map to a Mongolia History Book
01901079.description: Land at the Black Sea East Coast. Head North.

discovery.name: Jami' al-tawarikh
discovery.description: A history book compiled under the orders of the king of Ilkhanate. Contains the history of the development of the Mongol empire as well as other ethnic groups. Its other name is the Compendium of Chronicles.

01901080.name: Map of a Bird with a Great Sense of Smell
01901080.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Near the Red Flowers.

discovery.name: Turkey Vulture
discovery.description: Large bird inhabiting Central South America. As a bird species, it has a rare strong sense of smell, and is able to search for the corpses of its prey from afar.

01901081.name: Map of a Quick Rabbit
01901081.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. Near the Stacked Boulders to the North.

discovery.name: Jackrabbit
discovery.description: A large rabbit with a body length exceeding 40cm that inhabits in North America. As its legs are quite developed, it is capable of running at speeds greater than 30km per hour.

01901082.name: Unfinished Map
01901082.description: Land at the Bay of Bengal North Coast. Proceed inland to the Himalayas. To the Northwest.

discovery.name: Rongbuk Glacier
discovery.description: A glacier flowing at the base of the Himalayas. By going up this glacier, you may be able to climb quite high up Chomolungma... Maybe...

01901083.name: Unfinished Map
01901083.description: On the seas, South of Kokkola.

discovery.name: Kvarken Archipelago
discovery.description: An archipelago located in the Baltic Sea. Due to the melting of glaciers that had once existed, the topography has changed and has risen in a complicated manner.

01901084.name: Map of Middle Eastern Pottery
01901084.description: Outside the gate of Basra. Near the Ruins.

discovery.name: Garrus Pottery
discovery.description: Islamic pottery made using the Sgraffito technique. It features a distinctive pattern that is layered with a green glaze.

01901085.name: Map of an African plant
01901085.description: Land at the Africa West Coast. Near the Large Boulder.

discovery.name: Guinnea Pepper
discovery.description: Plant inhabiting places such as West Africa. Another name for it is melegueta. Its dried seeds are considered hot spices and are used instead of pepper in some areas.

01901086.name: Map of a Trading Post Island
01901086.description: On the seas southeast of Cabo Verde.

discovery.name: St. Andrew's Island
discovery.description: An island located in a river that flows in western Africa. The Europeans who settled there built a fortress and developed it as a trading post. Various countries fought over the territory, causing the name to change each time the ownership of the island changes.

01901087.name: Map of a North American Basket
01901087.description: Near the Item Shop in Boston.

discovery.name: Nantucket Lightship Basket
discovery.description: Traditional crafted baskets passed down by fishermen in Nantucket Island in North America. Traditionally made with techniques used for making barrels for whale oil. It features a symmetrical shape and contains pattern that one would not imagine that it's made with wood. A lid was not included during the early creations of the basket.

01901088.name: Map of an East Asian Plant
01901088.description: Land at Japanese Archipelago Southeast. Proceed inland to Omi. Near the White Flowers.

discovery.name: Cape Jasmine
discovery.description: A plant that can be found in Japan, China, Taiwan, and the Indo-China Peninsula. Mainly found in clusters within forests, these white flowers bloom and release a strong fragrance between early summer and summer. Its fruits are used for traditional Chinese medicine, as well as food and dyes.

01901089.name: Old Egyptian Relic Map
01901089.description: Outside the Gate of Cairo. Near the river to the South.

discovery.name: Amarna Letters
discovery.description: Diplomatic correspondence of ancient Egypt from the period of the pharaoh, Amenhotep IV. Contains mostly diplomatic correspondences from the officials of neighbouring countries and countries under the rule of Egypt addressed to the pharoah written in Akkadian which was the official language of the time.

01901090.name: Holy Man's Note
01901090.description: A clergy's memo indicating a certain location inside the Salonika Church.

discovery.name: Panagia
discovery.description: A necklace containing an icon of the Theotokos, Mary and Jesus Christ. Its name is also one of the titles of Mary and means 'Perfect Saint" in Greek, and is said to be worn by priests whom have obtained a status higher than bishop within the Orthodox church.

01901091.name: Map to a Luxurious Bestowed Gift

discovery.name: Dragon Robe
discovery.description: Robes worn in the royal court by emperors throughout the history of Chinese dynasties. These robes are covered with writings of prayers for happiness and longevity. It also contains nine embroideries of a dragon with five fingers which is only permitted for emperors.

01901092.name: Map of a Small Bird of Prey
01901092.description: Land at the North America East Coast. Near the Table Boulder to the West.

discovery.name: Northern Saw-whet Owl
discovery.description: An owl which inhabits North America. It features a small body and gold eyes. They can be spotted near villages and in shrubs and bushes. It's favoured by humans as it catches and preys on rodents.

discovery.name: Chamaeleon
discovery.description: One of the constellations of the southern sky. It was established based on the records left by Pieter Dirkszoon Keyser who created the star chart for the souther sky. The constellation was named after the chamaeleon which was discovered in the Southern Hemisphere during the same period of time.

discovery.name: Dongpo Red Cliffs
discovery.description: The location in which Su Dongpo, a man of literature and art of the Northern Song dynasty, was said to have written the first and second 'Chibifu' at during the period in which he was sent to Hangzhou, which is not far from the location of the famous Red Cliffs mentioned in the Romance of the Three Kingdoms. It is said that people sometimes confuse this with the Ancient Chibi Battlefield written in the work by Du Mu, a poet of the late Tang dynasty.

01901095.name: Ancient Burial Map
01901095.description: Land at the Yellow River Downstream. By the Pointed Boulder to the North.

discovery.name: Changxin Palace Lamp
discovery.description: A lamp created in the shape of a court lady; one of the burial goods discovered in Liu Sheng, Prince of Zhongshan and his wife's tomb. It burns oil to create light. Within the bronze statue exists empty space, designed to keep the smoke and soot inside.

01901096.name: Holy Man's Note
01901096.description: A clergy's memo indicating a certain location inside the Nantes Church.

discovery.name: Biblia Pauperum
discovery.description: A block-book illustrating the events that appear in the Bible. When it was established in southeast Germany and Austria during the mid-13th century, it spread throughout Europe together with the popularity of letter press printing. It was produced based on the pretype theory which was mainstream for churches at the time.

discovery.name: Psaltery
discovery.description: An instrument containing 24 strings stretched over a thin trapezoidal resonance box that is played with either fingers, feathers, or sticks. It is thought that the instrument had originated from the ancient Greek instrument, psalterion, and has now been brought to Europe. Even Hildegard of Bingen was said to have learned how to play the instrument from a nun.

discovery.name: Carta Pisana
discovery.description: The first portolan chart said to have been made in Pisa during the 13th century. It's a map used for sailing which graphically depicts ports and coasts, and was heavily produced up until the 14th century.One of its features is that it does not contain references of other portolan charts, and was made without the consideration that the earth is in the shape of a sphere.

01901099.name: Map of a South American Plant
01901099.description: Land at the South America Southeast Coast. Near the Large Boulder to the North.

discovery.name: Shy Plant
discovery.description: A plant native to South America. It's other name is 'Mimosa Pudica'. When stimulated by hands, wind or heat, the leaflets will close, hence the name of 'Shy Plant'. It's quite rare for people to refer to these plants by their official name.

01901100.name: Map of an Indian Bird
01901100.description: The sea of India, West Coast. Island to the West of Calicut.

discovery.name: Great Frigatebird
discovery.description: A seabird belonging to the frigatebird family, inhabiting mainly in the Pacific and Indian Ocean. When spread open, its wings have a length exceeding 2 meters. However, they are quite light. Although both the male and female feature a black body, they are easy to distinguish as the male features a red gular sac, while the female features a white gular sac.

01901101.name: River Shark Map
01901101.description: Near the river mouth of the Yangtze River.

discovery.name: Chinese Sturgeon
discovery.description: A type of sturgeon that has inhabited various places throughout China since ancient times. Many can be seen in the Yangtze River, and during spawning season, they can even be found upstream in the Jinsha River. According to the 'Compendium of Materia Medica', they are very nourishing, but it is rare for someone to catch them, and their population is unclear.

01901102.name: Unfinished Map
01901102.description: Northeast of the island, North of mainland Japan.

discovery.name: Cape Chashikotsu
discovery.description: A cape located in the northern parts of Japan. Named after the land 'Utoro', there's a fort named Utorochashi. According to the local language, 'chashi' refers to a fort or meeting place, as such, the ruins of such a place is called 'chashikotsu'. Although it was first used as a sanctuary or meeting place, it later had functions to act as a fort.

01901103.name: Map of a Trading Post
01901103.description: South of Bahia, along the coastline.

discovery.name: Porto Seguro
discovery.description: A region in which Cabral, a knight of the Order of Christ had landed in. Cabral had succeeded Gama in leading an expedition to India and is the first Portuguese person to step foot into South America. Regardless of it having the name of 'Safe Port', it is a lively Port City with many great coasts.

01901104.name: Map of Indigenous People's Holy Grounds
01901104.description: Land at Australia Northwest Coast. Proceed inland to Uluru. To the West.

discovery.name: Kata Tjuta
discovery.description: Large rock formations considered sacred to the local people along with Uluru. It means 'many heads' in the local language. Various rituals seem to be performed at night in the area, including penalizing criminals.

01901105.name: Prehistoric Sites Map
01901105.description: At the northeastern edge of North Beirut.

discovery.name: Gobekli Tepe
discovery.description: Remains called 'Potbelly Hill' in the local language. A number of giant stone pillars are arranged in circles. Some of them have the sculpture of animals. They seem to have been made quite a long time ago, but it is unknown who made them and what they were made for.

01901106.name: Map of a South American Instrument
01901106.description: Within the town of Rio de Janeiro.

01901107.name: Plants Habitat Map
01901107.description: Land at the British Isles East Coast. Near the Mammal Bones.

discovery.name: Mistletoe
discovery.description: A hemiparasite on several species of trees. It has always been surrounded by a number of myths and legends in Europe. In the ancient Celt, it was considered sacred especially when growing on oak trees.

01901109.name: Map of an Ancient Indian Relic
01901109.description: Land at the Arabian Sea Northeast Coast. Proceed inland to Sindh. At the northeast corner.

discovery.name: Kalibangan Seal
discovery.description: A cylinder seal found further past Mohenjo-Daro, near Karlibangan. It closely resembles the one found at the Indus ruins. Cows are engraved on it, which suggests that they were highly valued within the area.

01901114.name: Map of a Defense Base
01901114.description: On the sea north of Lisbon.

discovery.name: Fort of the Berlengas
discovery.description: A fort located on the island of Berlenga Grande, north of Lisbon. It's also known as the 'Fort of Sao Joao Baptista.' It was constructed from the remains of a pre-existing monastery, and was subject to repeated attacks from the Barbary pirates.

01901117.name: Map of a Blue Bird
01901117.description: Outside the gate of Tacoma. To the west.

discovery.name: Steller's Jay
discovery.description: A bird native to western North America, particularly seen more often in the forested areas. Being omnivorous, it eats fruits and insects as well as other birds' eggs. It has a pronounced black crest, however, its lower body is bright blue. Its vocalizations are quite loud.

01901118.name: Map of a Golden Cat
01901118.description: Outside the gate of Malacca. Near the Stacked Boulders.

discovery.name: Asian Golden Cat
discovery.description: A medium-sized wild cat native to the northeastern Indian subcontinent and Southeast Asia. In China, it's thought to be a kind of leopard. Its fur is much-prized and its bones are believed to have medicinal effects.

01901119.name: Map of a Trading Post
01901119.description: The island where the town of the Azores is located on.

discovery.name: Terceira Island
discovery.description: An island in the Azores archipelago. It was called 'the island of Brasil' when it was first discovered. It's drawn on the Pizzigano Map as well. There is a town called Angra do Heroismo meaning 'Port of Hero' and a number of fortresses were built in case of a pirate attacks.

discovery.name: Solomon Islands
discovery.description: An archipelago in the western South Pacific Ocean. The first European to visit the islands was the 16th-century Spanish navigator Alvaro de Mendana de Neira. It was named after the wealthy biblical King Solomon by Mendana.

discovery.name: Greek Anthology
discovery.description: A collection of poems, compiled by a 10th century Byzantine scholar, Constantine Cephalas. It contains roughly 4,500 epigrams and songs made by more than 300 poets from the 7th century B.C. to the 10th century. It's been highly valued as an excellent poem collection for a long time.

01901122.name: Map of an Ancient Civilization
01901122.description: Outside the north Gate of Lima. Near the Stacked Boulders.

discovery.name: Huaca Pucllana
discovery.description: Ancient ruins in central Lima with a pyramid made with sun-dried bricks. It was once a city that dominated the whole surrounding area and it served as an important ceremonial and administrative center.

01901123.name: Map of a Slim Hunting Dog
01901123.description: Outside the Gate of Yuntaishan. Near the Lone Cedar.

discovery.name: Chinese Saluki
discovery.description: A Chinese dog breed. Characterized by its slim body. It appears on ancient art and murals as a hunting hound.

01901124.name: Unfinished Map
01901124.description: Outside the Gate of Wanganui. Near the Large Boulder.

discovery.name: Mount Maunganui
discovery.description: An extinct volcano located on the North Island of New Zealand. It is considered very important and sacred by the local Maori.

01901125.name: Unfinished Map
01901125.description: Land at the North America West Coast. Near the Stacked Boulders.

discovery.name: Badlands
discovery.description: A vast wilderness area located in central North America. Its unique-looking terrain is made with sharply eroded buttes and pinnacles.

01901126.name: Unfinished Map
01901126.description: The coastal area, southwest of Wanganui.

discovery.name: Piopiotahi
discovery.description: A fiord located on the Tasman Sea side of New Zealand's South Island. It is surrounded by sheer rock faces that rise 1,000 meters or more. Known as the wettest place in New Zealand, rainfalls create dozens of temporary waterfalls.

01901127.name: Map of Animal-shaped Goldwork
01901127.description: Cusco, the inland of North Lima. Near the gate.

discovery.name: Gold Llama
discovery.description: A gold statue of llama. Its eyes, nose and ears are elaborately made. In the Inca Empire rituals, it seems that llamas were occasionally used as sacrifices.

01901128.name: Map of an Incan History Book
01901128.description: Cusco, the inland of North Lima. In front of the gate where pots are displayed.

discovery.name: The Letter of Indios
discovery.description: A letter written by native people in North America. It records the history of the Andean civilization and the Inca Empire as well as colonial policies and thoughts along with many illustrations.

01901129.name: Map of an Indus Stone Statue
01901129.description: In Calicut. Near the Audience Chamber of the Viceroy.

discovery.name: The Statue of Moenjo-Daro
discovery.description: A stone statue discovered in South Asia. It is said that it is modeled after a person from the upper class. The clothes worn by the statue have an elaborate pattern on them, which seems to be a result of the influence of Western culture.

discovery.name: Mount Damavand
discovery.description: The tallest volcano in Asia. Since it is a volcano with a beautiful peak, it appears in the scriptures of Zoroastrian that admires fire. It is believed that the three-headed dragon, Azi Dahaka, has been imprisoned deep underground below the mountain.

01901131.name: Map of an Arch Bridge
01901131.description: Land at the Persian Gulf North Coast. Proceed to the western edge of the Land.

discovery.name: Allahverdi Khan Bridge
discovery.description: A 300-meters long bridge built in the Middle East, popularly known as Si-o-se-pol. It has 33 arches and is built in the style of Safavid, one of the Islamic architectural styles.

01901133.name: Map of Stone Spheres in Jungle
01901133.description: Land at the South America Northwest Coast. Proceed East.

discovery.name: The Diquis Spheres
discovery.description: Stone spheres found in dense forests in Central America. The size varies, with the largest being over 2 meters in diameter. The purpose and method of production are unknown.

discovery.name: Elephanta Cave Temples
discovery.description: A temple on Elephanta Island located in the northwestern part of the Indian Ocean. It's rock-cut architecture, predominantly dedicated to the Hindu god Shiva. Most of the stone statues are heavily damaged as the site was used as a firing range and for target practice in the 17th century.

01901135.name: Map of Joyful Stone Monuments
01901135.description: Land at the South America Northwest Coast. Head West from the Diagonal Boulder.

discovery.name: Stone Monuments of the Dancers
discovery.description: Stone monuments found in South America, engraved with pictures of people who seem to be dancing. However, the current mainstream theory is that they represent tortured, sacrificed war prisoners.

01901136.name: Map of Ruins on a Mountaintop

discovery.name: Monte Alban
discovery.description: The center of the Zapotec civilization that flourished in southern North America. The site is located on a low mountainous range rising above the plain and includes an astronomical observatory and a ballpark. Although it has developed greatly, it is said to have declined as the population declined.

01901138.name: Map of a Large Ancient Temple

discovery.name: Ggantija
discovery.description: A megalithic shrine on a Mediterranean island. According to folktales, it was built by giants. There is evidence that there were roofs and doors and it appears that animal sacrifices were done on the alter.

01901139.name: Map of a Graceful Flower
01901139.description: Land on the Japanese Archipelago West Coast. Southwest of Giant Dead Tree.

discovery.name: Astilbe
discovery.description: A kind of flower that is mainly found in Asia. It is a perennial plant that first blooms in early summers. It grows fluffy spikes along the stem and the flowers range in red, pink, and white colors. Strong against the cold, it grows best in moist soil.

01901140.name: Map of a Fish with Lined Patterns
01901140.description: The river basin south of Cayenne.

discovery.name: Pencil Fish
discovery.description: A fresh water fish that is found in rivers in South America. It has a thin body and small mouth, and eats moss in the water. There are some kinds of pencil fish that swim along the surface of the water with its body at an angle like a pencil, hence its name.

01901141.name: Map of a Temple on the Cliff
01901141.description: Land at the Yellow River Downstream. To the West from the Upturned Boulder.

discovery.name: Hanging Temple
discovery.description: A wooden monastery built on the cliffs in southeast China. Notable for combining Buddhism, Taoism and Confucianism, there are sculptures of each religion's founder next to each other. It's said that when the poet Li Bai visited this place, the wrote 'spectacular' on a stone.

01901142.name: Map of Bones of a Strange Lizard
01901142.description: Land at the North America East Coast. To the East from the Table Boulder.

archives.discovery: Bones of a Reptile with a Flat Head

discovery.name: Bones of a Reptile with a Flat Head
discovery.description: Bones of a lizard-like creature found in eastern North America. It has a unique quality of having a flat skull. Sharp teeth can be found on it.

01901143.name: Map of a Plant with Bizarre Leaves
01901143.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. To the East from the Giant Dead Tree.

discovery.name: Monstera Deliciosa
discovery.description: A perennial herb that is distributed around Central America, also known simply as 'Monstera'. Holes develop on the leaves according to its growth. These holes connect to create a large divide. Its fruits are edible but if eaten unripe they leave strong sensations in the mouth.

01901144.name: Map of a Tree-climbing Dog
01901144.description: Land at the Gulf of Mexico Southwest Coast. To the Northeast from the Giant Dead Tree.

discovery.name: Gray Fox
discovery.description: A fox spread from North America to South America. It has a unique characteristic of a gray fur. They are known to be good at climbing trees. Because they are nocturnal, they spend their time during the day in their burrows.

discovery.name: White Cliffs of Dover
discovery.description: White cliffs that face the Strait of Dover, which are white because they are formed from limestones. It acts as the gates and stronghold of England. The alternative name of the island of Great Britain, Albion, is derived from Latin meaning white, and it's believed be inspired from these cliffs.

discovery.name: Ptolemy Cluster
discovery.description: Cluster of stars near Scorpius that are so bright that they can be seen with naked eyes. Because it was recorded by Claudius Ptolemy who classified 48 constellations, it is also known as the 'Ptolemy Cluster'.

01901168.name: Astronomer's Observation Record
01901168.description: Observe on the sea of Icelandic Ocean Basin.
